物进入发电系统；引流束堤尾端阻滤筛网的筛网孔径阻挡中、小型海洋生物及杂物进入水轮机，引流束堤尾端阻滤筛网与流道成倾斜角度；斜角最前端设置鱼道，阻滤筛网前聚积的中、小型海洋生物从鱼道游出系统。 6. 如权利要求1所述的一种海洋潮汐能离岸流发电系统，其特征在于引流束堤末端与泄流口连接端采用扩径形式，采用拉瓦尔喷管技术将引流束堤内的流体提速，为机组提供最大冲击动能。 7. 如权利要求1所述的一种海洋潮汐能离岸流发电系统，其特征在于离岸流发电单元与海水接触部件采用抗海水腐蚀材料；水轮机组与海水接触部件的表面涂防污剂或包装防污胶带材料。 8. 如权利要求1所述的一种海洋潮汐能离岸流发电系统，其特征在于离岸流发电单元发电机及机组辅助系统置于水轮机上部的厂房内，隔绝与海水直接接触。 9. 如权利要求1所述的一种海洋潮汐能离岸流发电系统，其特征在于离岸流发电单元与多组离岸流引流单元组合匹配，扩大离岸流发电机组装机规模；每组离岸流引流单元采用所述对侧双向流道。

CN112802669.title: Novel dry-type RIP alternating-current transformer bushing wiring terminal structure
CN112802669.abstract: The invention relates to a novel dry-type RIP alternating-current transformer bushing wiring terminal structure. The wiring terminal structure is arranged at the end part of an insulator bushing, the end part of the insulator bushing is provided with an end part cover plate which is connected with the insulator bushing through a bolt, and the end part cover plate is provided with a through hole for allowing a primary penetrating wiring terminal to penetrate through; the wiring terminal structure comprises a conductive tube and a one-time penetrating wiring terminal; the penetrating-out structure of the one-time penetrating-out wiring terminal is simple, electrical connection with the one-time penetrating-out wiring terminal is achieved through a spring contact finger, and the one-time penetrating-out wiring terminal is fastened to the end cover plate through the bolt; the structure is high in electrical connection reliability, simple in structure and low in material cost; and problems of unreliable electrical connection between the military cap and the conductive tube, increased contact resistance and serious product heating caused by failure of the mode of matching the military cap and the spring are avoided.

CN110706455.title: Rip current prediction and alarm device
CN110706455.abstract: A rip current prediction and alarm device belongs to the field of ocean safety early warning, and comprises a fixing plate and a wind power generation device; wherein the wind power generation devicecomprises a wind wheel and a tower, the wind wheel is arranged at the top of the tower; the bottom of the tower is fixed on the fixing plate; the tower is provided with a first current meter; a loudspeaker and a data processing and control module are arranged over the fixing plate; a fixing device and a paint box are arranged under the fixing plate; and the data processing and control module is connected with the loudspeaker, the first current meter and the paint box separately through lines. The rip current prediction and alarm device of the invention is sensitive in measurement, convenient in use, and capable of timely discovering the occurrence of a rip current and giving warning, in addition, the rip current prediction and alarm device has a good warning effect by adopting various modes such as red pigment indication and loudspeaker broadcast, so as to guide a swimmer to escape in time and guide a lifeguard to perform rescue in time.

US10449433.title: Wave Energy and Rip Current Control System for Surf Pools
US10449433.abstract: The invention relates to a Surf Pool wherein a portion of the beach is provided with a wave catch basin. With the wave catch basin extending along the length of the beach, the wave catch basin will allow water to go over an infinity edge and settle in the wave catch basin, wherein wave energy backflows are eliminated and rip currents are avoided. With the wave catch basin extending along the beach side of the surf pool, the water that is collected in the wave catch basin and by pumping water out of pipe fittings or creating positive suction into pipe fittings, alters the flow of the rip current, thereby altering the wave formation characteristics. As the rip currents enter the rip current flow channels on both sides of the surfing reef, water can be suctioned down through return pipes or pumped in any direction along the surf pool bottom to stop the rip currents in the rip current flow channels, which helps the breaking waves from becoming distorted as they break.

CN110185017.title: Mobile platform for piling in rip current and supporting propulsion positioning device thereof
CN110185017.abstract: The invention discloses a mobile platform for piling in a rip current and a supporting propulsion positioning device thereof. The mobile platform comprises an insertion pile composed of a suspension arm, an operation platform, an upper platform, a lifting system and the like, an operating system for installing a pile driver, a pile guiding positioning system composed of a slide rail, a pile guideframe, guide rollers and the like and the platform propulsion positioning device composed of a bracket, a push rod, guide wheels, pulleys, a load cable and the like. Due to the special design of the slide rail and the bracket, it is convenient to install the bracket, easy one-man operation can be realized, and an original anti-rolling device is eliminated. Since the platforms are mounted on the outer side of the slide rail, the operation is safe and smooth. Due to the installation of the platform propulsion positioning device, the construction speed is increased and the labor intensity is reduced.

CN109797702.title: Pearl spring model based on rip current cause of pressure-bearing aquifer
CN109797702.abstract: The invention discloses a pearl spring simulation and demonstration experimental device formed by a discharge point of a pressure-bearing aquifer due to a rip current effect. The pearl spring simulation and demonstration experimental device comprises an overflow tank capable of controlling height and water flow, a water flow movement and bubble generation device and a pearl spring phenomenon observation device. When the device is used, the water flow speed and the bubble generation condition can be controlled by adjusting the water quantity and the height of the overflow tank capable of controlling the height and the water flow. The water flow movement and bubble generating device can be filled with coarse sand to simulate the medium of the aquifer, chemical change of the aquifer can be simulated between pulling type chemical reactions, and an air injector can ensure sufficient air in water to generate bubbles conveniently. Finally, a pearl spring phenomenon can be observed in the pearl spring phenomenon observation device. A production mode of the pearl spring in practice is simulated, and the formation process of the pearl spring can be restored and demonstrated well.

CN109035708.title: Rip current warning device
CN109035708.abstract: The invention provides a rip current warning device, composed of vertical posts, a cross beam, a cross beam spindle hole, a top beam, a first rotation shaft hole, an impeller, an impeller shell, a spindle hole, a spindle, a first bevel gear, a second bevel gear, a first rotation shaft, a heavy hammer, a swing rod, a warning board and a second rotation shaft. When rip current occurs, in a rip current area, the impeller drives the warning board to carry out large-angle tilt under the effect of the rip current, in an adjacent non-rip current area, the warning board is basically vertical and stable, and after tourists in the rip current area observe that the warning board carries out the large-angle tilt at close distance, the tourists can swim out of the rip current area rapidly along a direction (vertical to a rip current direction) pointed by the large-angle tilt of the warning board and can swim to the non-rip current area; after the tourists in the non-rip current area observe that the warning board carries out the large-angle tilt, the tourists can go ashore rapidly; and lifeguards stop the tourists on the shore from entering the rip current area and rescue the tourists in the rip current area rapidly. The device is very important for the tourists to avoid risk and carry out self rescue and is very import for the lifeguards to carry out rescue.
CN109035708.assignee: UNIV ZHEJIANG WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

CN105389468.title: Rip current forecasting method
CN105389468.abstract: The present invention discloses a rip current forecasting method. The method comprises the following steps of: (1) based on a mesoscale marine weather operational forecasting system, acquiring wind fields and pressure fields of a target sea area and surrounding sea areas of the target sea area; (2) establishing a Delft3D hydrodynamic numerical model, and simulating to obtain tidal current fields of the target sea area and the surrounding sea areas of the target sea area; (3) establishing an SWAN wave spectral model, and simulating to obtain wave fields of the target sea area and the surrounding sea areas of the target sea area; (4) extracting boundary conditions from the wave fields, using the tidal current fields as background current fields, establishing an SWASH wave analysis model, and simulating to obtain a time sequence of a water particle velocity of the target sea area; and (5) accounting intensity of a rip current. In order to consider the dynamic characteristics of coupling of multiple physical mechanisms and coexistence of multiple spatial and temporal scales of the rip current, the method comprehensively utilizes various models to respectively stimulate different physical processes, considers the interactions between various models by using data exchange and coupling, and achieves real-time forecasting of the rip current of a bathing beach so as to provide references for beach rescue.

WO2014192529.title: DISPOSITIF, PROCÉDÉ ET PROGRAMME D'ESTIMATION DE POINTS DE CHANGEMENT DE DIRECTION DE COURANT, DISPOSITIF D'ESTIMATION DE RIDE DE COURANT ET DISPOSITIF RADAR
WO2014192529.abstract: [Problem] To estimate, in a short time period, a distribution state of current-direction change points. [Solution] A device (10a) for estimating current-direction change points is configured, which is provided with: a derivation unit (11) for deriving wave-crest velocity vectors, i.e. velocity vectors of wave crests on a water surface at each point within a prescribed range; and a unit (12) for estimating current-direction change points which estimates a plurality of current-direction change points by comparing angular differences between neighbouring wave-crest velocity vectors among the wave-crest velocity vectors at each point that are derived by the derivation unit (11), and, in cases when the angular difference is at least a prescribed value, estimating a position between the neighbouring wave-crest velocity vectors to be a current-direction change point.

US2013181842.title: RIP CURRENT SENSOR AND WARNING SYSTEM WITH ANCHOR
US2013181842.abstract: [0000]    A rip current can include a dangerous flow of water from an area proximate to a beach out to deeper water. An apparatus for generating a rip current warning indication includes an anchor device situated in the water, a flow sensor affixed to the anchor device and monitoring a water current speed, and a warning device in signal communication with the flow sensor. The warning device includes a control module comparing the monitored water current speed to a water current speed threshold. The warning device generates the rip current warning indication based upon the comparing.

AU2012101879.title: Ripline - Life saving device placed in the current or "Rip" of Ocean, River or other water medium to allow people to avoid drowning.
AU2012101879.abstract: The Ripline is a device innovation that is unique in that it is specifically designed to save lives by way of a buoyancy system that floats in the current of a marine environment where there is a risk of drowning. Allows the Victim or person(s) caught in a "Rip" or water current to try and save themselves The victim or person(s) can swim with the current to the Ripline to conserve energy The victim or person(s) can rest on the Ripline to Recuperate The victim or person(s) and rescuer can use the Ripline as a rest stop to await further help The victim or person(s) can actually work their way back along the Ripline to safety. The Ripline is goodfor multiple rescues where many people are washed away at once, and they can methodically be rescued dependent on the severity of conditions. E.G. Age, Health ect. The Ripline requires minimal attention during operation, as it flows with the Rip, and adjusts according to the current. Quality materials ensure low cost for installation and low maintenance Putting out the Ripline for installation and retrieval is simple and quick Storage area required for the device is minimal. WO2013147473.title: PROCÉDÉ DE GÉNÉRATION D'AVERTISSEMENT DE COURANT SAGITTAL
WO2013147473.abstract: A method for generating a rip current warning generates a rip current warning for a target region in real time by comprising the steps of: (S1) calculating a speed of ocean current by simulating the generation of a rip current in a target region using geographic information on the target region in which the generation of the rip current is monitored, and a virtual marine condition scenario; (S2) calculating a rip current generation index by quantifying a degree generated by the rip current as an index in the target region according to the virtual marine condition scenario on the basis of speed information on an ocean current derived from a result of the simulation; (S3) creating a database by changing the virtual marine condition scenario and calculating the rip current generation index; and (S4) determining whether the rip current warning is generated through a correlation between the presently measured marine condition and the rip current index information on each marine condition previously calculated with the creation of a database by understanding the real-time-measured marine condition in the target region.

US2005271266.title: Automated rip current detection system
US2005271266.abstract: A system substitutes digitized images for human vision, in determining the presence or absence of rip tides among sea water wave patterns at a public swimming beach. Computer analysis of these images involves image pre-filtering that enhances the telltale signs of rip tides, before the digital data is processed for classification as NORMAL or RIP TIDE. The classification itself can proceed along by expert systems which mimic the manner in which a human observer performs the detection; or by building a neural network, that determines its own classification criteria for identifying rip tides.

CN122636917.title: Dynamic grid method based on Delaunay graph and quaternion spatial interpolation
CN122636917.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of dynamic grid generation in computational fluid mechanics, and discloses a dynamic grid method based on a Delaunay graph and quaternion spatial interpolation, which comprises the following steps: reading geometric information of an initial computational grid, and obtaining node coordinates before and after deformation; carrying out Delaunay subdivision on the boundary nodes of the object plane to generate a background Delaunay graph covering a computational domain; establishing a mapping relation between computational grid nodes and Delaunay units in combination with a relative volume coefficient and shortest path method; calculating a rotation quaternion and a translation vector of each boundary unit based on node coordinates before and after deformation of the boundary units, and performing interpolation to obtain a rotation quaternion and a translation vector of each boundary node; and performing linear interpolation on the rotation quaternion and the translation vector of the internal node, and updating the coordinates of the internal node to obtain a deformation grid. According to the method, the dynamic mesh deformation with high calculation efficiency and high mesh quality can be realized.
CN122636917.assignee: COMPUTATIONAL AERODYNAMICS INST OF CHINA AERODYNAMICS RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT CENTER

CN122631100.title: Ship robust heave estimation method based on spatial-temporal feature perception factor graph optimization
CN122631100.abstract: The invention discloses a ship robust heave estimation method based on spatial-temporal feature perception factor graph optimization, relates to the field of ocean engineering state estimation, is used for estimating the heave displacement of a ship, and comprises the steps of constructing a nonlinear observation model and outputting an attitude rotation matrix; calculating the vertical motion acceleration, mapping the GNSS antenna elevation into equivalent vertical observation at the reference point, and obtaining GNSS vertical observation information; constructing a space-time joint adaptive weight, and dynamically modulating a GNSS observation information matrix by using the space-time joint adaptive weight; calculating a kinematics residual error and a GNSS observation residual error, combining the kinematics residual error and the GNSS observation residual error, and constructing a combined optimization objective function for iterative solution; and after iterative convergence, extracting an optimal state of a window center epoch as a current heave displacement estimated value, and outputting a final heave result according to lever arm mapping of a task mounting point. According to the invention, the phase delay of traditional high-pass filtering is eliminated, and the precision and robustness of ship heave estimation are improved.
CN122631100.assignee: SHANDONG UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

CN122347442.title: Rental price optimization method based on house rent dynamic adjustment
CN122347442.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and particularly discloses a house rent dynamic adjustment-based lease price optimization method, which comprises the following steps of: extracting a long-term trend component from a daily listed rent price data sequence, and determining a rent change trend quantitative index; in combination with a preset reference price calculation rule, determining a market rent price reference of the target house at the current time point; inputting a house geographic position and a house facility condition of a target house into the trained regression model to obtain a house rent price of the target house, and then determining an individual feature adjustment coefficient; selecting a corresponding preset price comprehensive adjustment function based on a relationship between a preset threshold value and the individual feature adjustment coefficient; and calculating to obtain a target rent price. The rental price optimization method based on house rent dynamic adjustment solves the complex business problem of how to comprehensively consider the market trend, the geographic position, the facility condition and the individual feature difference in the house rent price evaluation.
CN122347442.assignee: FOSHAN DAMAI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

CN122290528.title: Remote content updating method and system for electronic screen house price board
CN122290528.abstract: The invention discloses a remote content updating method and system for an electronic screen house price board, relates to the technical field of electronic display and electronic paper refreshing control, and is suitable for a scene of collaborative updating of a price key area and a pricing aperture area in the electronic paper house price board. According to the method, based on the current display content and the target housing price content of the same display slot position, the price ghosting amount and the pricing aperture lag amount are determined respectively, and a price key area strong refreshing task, a price key area and pricing aperture area synchronous refreshing task or a whole slot refreshing task are generated according to the condition combination of the price ghosting amount and the pricing aperture lag amount. Therefore, the refreshing task is matched with the digital ghost shadow risk and the pricing aperture synchronization risk, the housing price reading confusion is reduced, and the unnecessary whole slot refreshing frequency is reduced.

CN121146801.title: Ant colony algorithm and neural network combined house price data prediction technology
CN121146801.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of real estate, and discloses an ant colony algorithm and neural network combined house price data prediction method, which comprises the following steps: S1, multi-source data acquisition, S2, data preprocessing, S3, ant colony algorithm parameter optimization, S4, neural network dual-stage training and S5, adaptive optimization feedback. According to the house price data prediction technology combining the ant colony algorithm and the neural network, neural network model parameters are optimized by adopting the ant colony algorithm; in the house price prediction model, the parameters are combined to form a path, and ants traverse different parameter combination paths; along with iteration, pheromones on a better parameter combination path are continuously accumulated and enhanced, and ants are guided to explore more; in this way, the parameter space can be fully traversed, local optimum caused by parameter random initialization of a traditional neural network is avoided, and therefore the model can obtain a better parameter combination, and the prediction precision is remarkably improved.

CN120996840.title: House price automatic evaluation data anomaly detection method and system
CN120996840.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data anomaly detection, in particular to a house price automatic evaluation data anomaly detection method and system, and the method comprises the following steps: dividing a city geographic space into a plurality of geographic units, and collecting house property data to the corresponding geographic units according to the geographic positions of house properties; calculating a holding cost change index and a market price change index of the real estate in the corresponding geographic unit; judging whether the holding cost change index and the market price change index of the real estate in the geographic unit simultaneously present a rising trend in the same analysis period and the respective change amplitudes reach a preset threshold or not; quantizing the contradiction degree according to a judgment result; based on the contradiction degree, identifying and expanding an overall abnormal region influenced by the contradiction; and adding an abnormal mark to the real estate data in the overall abnormal area, and adjusting a real estate evaluation process according to the abnormal mark. The accuracy and reliability of housing price evaluation are improved.
CN120996840.assignee: SHENZHEN GUOFANG LAND REAL ESTATE ASSET EVALUATION CONSULTING CO LTD

CN120931051.title: MPC and time-of-use electricity price coordinated secondary water supply pump house energy-saving scheduling method and system
CN120931051.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent water supply, in particular to a secondary water supply pump house energy-saving scheduling method and system based on MPC and time-of-use electricity price collaboration, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, collecting the operation data of pump house equipment in real time, including the equipment health state, load demand and external environment data, and preprocessing the collected data; and S2, based on the real-time operation data of the equipment, utilizing the health assessment model to assess the health state of the equipment, generating an equipment health index, and taking the equipment health index as the input of an optimization scheduling strategy. According to the invention, by collecting equipment data in real time and combining health assessment, load and electricity price prediction and robust MPC controller optimization scheduling, optimal start-stop and load distribution of the equipment are realized, so that the problems that a traditional scheduling method mostly adopts artificial experience or a fixed mode, and the equipment health and load fluctuation are not considered, so that the power consumption of the equipment is reduced are solved. And therefore, the problems of equipment overload and high energy consumption are solved.

CN120598585.title: Improved multi-scale geographically weighted regression second-hand house price influence assessment method
CN120598585.abstract: The invention discloses a second-hand house price influence evaluation method based on eigenvector spatial filtering multi-scale geographically weighted regression (ESFMGWR). The precision and efficiency of second-hand house price influence evaluation are improved. Firstly, real estate sample data are preprocessed; thirdly, constructing a spatial weight matrix by using a K-nearest neighbor algorithm, and extracting a feature vector with significant spatial autocorrelation through feature vector spatial filtering; the feature vector set is further simplified by adopting methods such as Lasso regression or stepwise regression. And then, the screened feature vectors and the original independent variables are integrated and incorporated into an MGWR model for modeling analysis, the bandwidth of the independent variables is optimized by using a golden section method, and finally, an influence evaluation result of the second-hand house price is obtained. According to the method, the complexity of the model is effectively reduced, the endogenous problem of the model is relieved, and the explanation strength and precision of the model are improved.

CN120471636.title: Multi-agent network big data city house price analysis and calculation method
CN120471636.abstract: According to the multi-agent network big data urban housing price analysis and calculation method, network big data is obtained through a crawler mode, feature construction is performed based on the network big data to quantify commercial development, traffic, infrastructure, location, education, environment and resident consumption level housing price influence factors, and a multi-agent non-linear feature importance evaluation model is utilized to analyze and calculate housing price values. The influence degree of the house price image factors is quantified; a partition non-linear characteristic price model based on spatial heterogeneity is constructed, different housing price distribution rules and calculation methods existing in different regions of a city are provided, the superiority of the model is verified through experimental comparison, and a detailed urban housing price market space structure is obtained by performing local spatial autocorrelation analysis on a model result. The abnormal result is further analyzed to provide suggestions for old city renovation and high-grade community site selection of real estate manufacturers, and the second-hand house price fine calculation is efficient and accurate.
CN120471636.assignee: ANHUI KERUI ENGINEERING PROJECT MAN CO LTD

CN120450808.title: House reservation bargaining method combined with multi-platform price comparison recommendation
CN120450808.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of interconnection big data and artificial intelligence, in particular to a room reservation bargaining method combined with multi-platform price comparison recommendation, which comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring a hotel reservation demand and an initial bid of a user; s2, performing hotel matching according to the hotel reservation demand of the user to obtain a target hotel and a corresponding target room type; s3, obtaining real-time quoted prices of a plurality of hotel room reservation platforms for the target room type of the target hotel; s4, calculating a comprehensive price comparison recommendation price according to the real-time quoted price of each hotel room reservation platform for the target room type of the target hotel; s5, when the initial bid of the user is lower than the comprehensive price comparison recommendation price, the comprehensive price comparison recommendation price is sent to the user; and S6, when the user accepts the comprehensive price comparison recommendation price, automatically booking the target room type of the target hotel for the user based on the comprehensive price comparison recommendation price. According to the invention, objective and reasonable benchmark and reference are provided for user bidding and hotel pricing, so that the effectiveness of room reservation bargaining and the matching success rate are improved.
CN120450808.assignee: CHONGQING HUIYINGKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

CN120182049.title: Machine learning-based house price variable weight fusion evaluation method
CN120182049.abstract: The invention discloses a machine learning-based house price variable weight fusion evaluation method, which relates to the technical field of urban planning, and comprises the following steps of: constructing an influence variable index system of a geographic location where a house property is located, constructing a house price evaluation and prediction basic database, and setting two scales of a global space and a local area space; and building a house price prediction model for predicting the house price based on a machine learning algorithm. According to the invention, different machine learning regression methods are used to simulate the contribution degree of each facility in the whole domain to the house price; the precision of the house price prediction model is finally improved by constructing an adjacent matrix, applying a rare principle and a label principle and combining weight adjustment and optimization of independent variables. By minimizing a root-mean-square error (RMSE) and adjusting an independent variable weight, the model is ensured to better reflect the contribution of different influence variables to the house price on the basis of conforming to spatial proximity and facility characteristics.
CN120182049.assignee: WUHAN PLANNING & RESEARCH INSTITUTE WUHAN TRANSP DEVELOPMENT STRATEGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE

CN119991226.title: House price prediction method, electronic device, medium and program product
CN119991226.abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to a house price prediction method, electronic equipment, a medium and a program product. The method comprises the steps of performing vector conversion on target house source information of a to-be-predicted house and reference house source information of a plurality of reference houses in response to a trigger operation acting on a price prediction control, and generating a target house source vector and each reference house source vector; inputting the target house source vector and each reference house source vector into a linear transformation layer in a first attention module for vector mapping processing to obtain a first query matrix, a first key matrix and a first value matrix; inputting the first query matrix, the first key matrix and the first value matrix into at least one first attention head in a first attention module for attention processing, and generating a first candidate price feature; and generating a predicted price of the to-be-predicted house based on the first candidate price feature, and displaying the target house resource information and the predicted price of the to-be-predicted house. According to the technical scheme, the accuracy of predicting the house price is improved.
CN119991226.assignee: BEIKE ZHAOFANG BEIJING TECH CO LTD

CN119494670.title: House price analysis and evaluation method and system based on software system
CN119494670.abstract: The invention discloses a house price analysis and evaluation method and system based on a software system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the house information of a to-be-evaluated house in a set time interval before a starting point and the house transaction data of a region where the to-be-evaluated house is located, and carrying out the comprehensive evaluation of the data, thereby obtaining a similar transaction unit price and a recent transaction unit price; and the similar transaction unit price and the recent transaction unit price are summed according to the weight to obtain the predicted housing price, so that the information of the similar housing price and the recent market trend is integrated, the scientificity and the accuracy of prediction are improved, a more reliable housing price evaluation result is provided for the user, and the problems that the prior art mostly depends on the subjective experience of an evaluator, and the cost is low are solved. And the evaluation process consumes long time while objectivity exists.
CN119494670.assignee: CHANGZHOU ZHONGWU CONSTRUCTION TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

TWM664040.title: Patent Specification TWM664040U
TWM664040.abstract: Patent publication covering industrial methods and systems in TWM664040U.

CN119047744.title: House building project quantity and price integrated management system
CN119047744.abstract: The invention discloses a housing construction project quantity and price integrated management system. The system comprises a PM system, a BIM5D system and a mobile terminal, wherein the BIM5D system and the mobile terminal are in communication connection with the PM system; the BIM5D system comprises a design progress planning module and a scene module connected with the design progress planning module; the mobile terminal comprises a construction progress acquisition module and a material consumption acquisition module; the PM system comprises a construction simulation module respectively connected with the design progress planning module and the construction progress acquisition module, and an image progress display module connected with the construction simulation module; the PM system further comprises a material demand quantity generation module connected with the scene module, a material display module connected with the material demand quantity generation module and the material consumption acquisition module, a pricing file storage module, and an output value calculation and display module connected with the pricing file storage module and the material display module. According to the invention, fine management of the housing construction project price can be realized.
CN119047744.assignee: THE 3RD ENG CO LTD OF CHINA RAILWAY 18TH BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

CN118569892.title: Second-hand house price prediction method based on deep learning
CN118569892.abstract: The invention provides a deep learning-based second-hand house price prediction method. The deep learning-based second-hand house price prediction method comprises the following steps of obtaining a second-hand house training data set of each platform; performing data exploratory analysis on the sample by using the obtained training sample to obtain importance, functionality and mutual relation of each feature in the sample; performing feature selection on the processed sample features, and performing training by using an extreme random forest model based on a priori chi-square principle and a mixed feature selection algorithm to obtain an extreme random forest model; performing hyper-parameter optimization on the random forest algorithm by adopting a Hyperopt technology to obtain an improved training model of the extreme random forest algorithm; and inputting the collected second-hand house data into the final model to obtain a detection result. According to the method, aiming at the problem that feature extraction is not easy, a multi-feature fusion method is provided, the accuracy of an extreme random forest algorithm is effectively improved, and the prediction effect is also improved.

CN118134522.title: House resource price prediction method and device, electronic equipment and readable medium
CN118134522.abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a house resource price prediction method and device, electronic equipment and a readable medium. A specific embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring listing information of a target housing resource; performing data preprocessing on the listing information to obtain preprocessed data; performing feature extraction on the preprocessed data to obtain target features; and inputting the target feature into a pre-trained price prediction model to obtain a predicted house resource price of the target house resource. According to the embodiment, more accurate house price prediction can be provided, the user can be assisted to make a more intelligent house purchase or investment decision, and the problem of inaccurate prediction of house resource price fluctuation in the existing real estate market can be solved; the method plays a role in improving housing resource value evaluation accuracy, optimizing market price dynamic monitoring, supporting investment decision making and the like.
CN118134522.assignee: ZHUGE QIHANG SUZHOU TECH CO LTD

CN117670384.title: House price prediction method based on community light index inversion of YOLO algorithm
CN117670384.abstract: The invention discloses a housing price prediction method based on community light index inversion of a YOLO algorithm, belongs to the field of data processing models, and aims to reflect the occupancy rate of a residential district by using the number of lighted residents in the residential district at night to carry out housing price research based on the authenticity characteristic of light data. According to the prediction method, on one hand, the actual lighting data is added in the house price statistical data research to serve as the most real and effective data source to serve as the reference basis, on the other hand, the YOLO algorithm based on deep learning is used for lighting extraction and recognition, low efficiency and heavy workload of manual lighting data statistics are avoided, and the method is suitable for popularization and application. The method provides operability and innovativeness of technical means, explores a new thought for studying the house price, directly predicts the house price interval, provides reference value for residents to purchase houses, masters the most real and effective data information such as urban population and house supply and demand conditions, has important guiding significance for urban construction and planning, and has a wide application prospect. The method has important market value.

CN117610708.title: Building method, device and equipment of house rental price prediction model and storage medium
CN117610708.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, and discloses a building method and device of a house rent price prediction model, equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a plurality of pieces of house resource data and the actual rent price of a house resource corresponding to each piece of house resource data in a sales cycle; and inputting the plurality of pieces of housing resource data into a preset coding model to obtain a code corresponding to each piece of housing resource data. And in the current iteration period, inputting the code corresponding to each piece of housing resource data and the actual rent price corresponding to each piece of housing resource data into a to-be-trained housing rent price prediction model, and obtaining a predicted rent price corresponding to each piece of housing resource data. And when it is determined that a training stopping condition is met according to the predicted rent price and the actual rent price corresponding to the multiple pieces of house resource data, determining the trained house rent price prediction model as a target rent price prediction model. And when it is determined that the training stopping condition is not met according to the predicted rent price and the actual rent price corresponding to the multiple pieces of housing resource data, entering a next round of iteration period. According to the invention, the accuracy of house rental price prediction can be improved.
CN117610708.assignee: BEIJING ZIROOM INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

CN117217783.title: Multi-task learning-driven house price prediction method
CN117217783.abstract: The invention discloses a multi-task learning-driven house price prediction method, which comprises the following steps of: giving house transaction data of a quarter before a time node t, dividing each class cluster through K-means clustering and based on house characteristics to obtain a plurality of partitions, defining each partition as a task, the method comprises the steps of capturing correlation among partitions by designing different regularization items, defining a multi-task learning objective function according to the correlation, obtaining a house price prediction model based on multi-task learning through a gradient descent optimization algorithm, inputting house data appearing one month after a time node t, firstly performing task definition, and then obtaining a house price prediction model based on multi-task learning; and then the predicted housing price is output based on the established model, the input data is changed along with the change of the time node t, the modeling and prediction processes are executed circularly, and the rationality and prediction precision of housing price prediction are improved.

CN116862543.title: Target house price tag determination device and method, equipment and storage medium
CN116862543.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of big data, and discloses a target house price tag determination device, method and equipment and a storage medium. The comparison module is used for comparing the real-time model price factor with the offline model price factor, comparing the real-time flow data with the offline flow data, and comparing the real-time check-in data with the offline check-in data; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring a first price tag, a first price coefficient, a second price tag and a second price coefficient; the data calculation module is used for determining a first target price tag and a second target price tag; and the target price tag determination module is used for determining the first target price tag as a target price tag according to the fact that the first target price tag is smaller than the second target price tag. The target price tag is determined according to comparison of the model price factor, the flow data and the check-in data, influence factors are comprehensively considered, and the obtained target price tag is more objective.
CN116862543.assignee: BEIJING ZIROOM INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

CN116777487.title: House price evaluation method and system based on semi-supervised data cleaning and feature price method
CN116777487.abstract: The invention discloses a housing price assessment method based on semi-supervised data cleaning and a feature price method, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining to-be-assessed data, and carrying out the desensitization processing of the to-be-assessed data, and obtaining the desensitization assessment data; and S2, performing evaluation processing on the desensitization evaluation data by adopting a semi-supervised data cleaning and feature price method to obtain an evaluation result. And S3, checking the evaluation result, if the checking is passed, sending the evaluation result, and if the checking is not passed, marking information and returning to the step S2 for re-evaluation. Meanwhile, the invention also discloses an evaluation system capable of executing the housing price evaluation method. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the personnel participation degree during data cleaning is effectively reduced, so that the objectivity, stability and accuracy of data cleaning are guaranteed to the greatest extent. In addition, the evaluation system has correction capability, and can perform self-correction and manual auditing on the evaluation result, so that the accuracy of the finally submitted evaluation result is further guaranteed.
CN116777487.assignee: YUNNAN YUNFANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

TW202329014.title: Presenting device based on selected house price index including an object database, a search module, a computing module and a transfer module
TW202329014.abstract: The present invention provides a presenting device based on selected house price index, including an object database, a search module, a computing module and a transfer module. The object database is configured to store object position information and object information of a plurality of objects. The search module is configured to receive a regional house price index for the region covered by a user, and search for multiple target objects whose object position information fall within the covered region according to the region covered by the regional house price index. Thereafter, the computing module acquires the object information related to the target objects from the object database according to the search result of the search module, and then calculates the regional house price index in the covered region based on the transaction price and time of the target objects. The user device of the user can display the selected regional house price index through the transfer module.

CN116308441.title: House price prediction method with variable selection capability
CN116308441.abstract: The invention provides a house price prediction method with variable selection capability, and belongs to the technical field of house price prediction based on a computer model. The problem that an existing house price prediction method lacks variable selection capacity is solved. Comprising the following steps: house data collection: acquiring house transaction information and house characteristics of each community in a given range to form a data set; house data arrangement and standardization processing: arranging the collected house data; dividing the data set into a feature data set X and a house price data set Y, and performing standardization processing; constructing a regression model based on quantiles: constructing a robust regression model suitable for an abnormal point, and adding a regularization item so as to restrain a regression coefficient; training the model: training the constructed model by using the sorted house data, estimating a regression coefficient, and determining a house characteristic variable coefficient; a house price prediction result is given through the feature data set and the model; the method is applied to house price prediction.

CN116308437.title: Method for evaluating surrounding house price and land value in underground urban sewage treatment plant
CN116308437.abstract: The invention discloses a method for evaluating surrounding house price and land value by underground urban sewage treatment plants, which comprises the following steps of: collecting and processing surrounding house price data by taking overground and underground sewage treatment plants as research objects; a double difference model is adopted to analyze the change difference of the house price, the growth amount and the growth rate before and after the underground treatment of the urban sewage treatment plant, the influence of the underground treatment of the urban sewage treatment plant on the surrounding house price is determined, and the model is inspected and analyzed; and the value of increasing the price of surrounding real estate and releasing land resources after underground transformation of the sewage treatment plant is analyzed. The method has guiding significance on planning and design of urban underground sewage treatment plants.

CN116188162.title: House price influence factor analysis method considering visual environment
CN116188162.abstract: The invention discloses a visual environment-considered house price influence factor analysis method. The method comprises the following steps of obtaining multi-source geographic big data and preprocessing the data; extracting the structure, location, neighborhood and visual environment characteristics of the housing from the data processed in the step 1; constructing a feature price model and a random forest regression model for predicting the house price according to the features extracted in the step 2; comparing the precision of the two house price regression models by using model evaluation indexes; and 4, selecting a model with high precision from the step 4 as a house price prediction model, predicting the house price by adopting the prediction model, and analyzing the size, direction and mode of the influence of each characteristic variable on the house price based on the SHAP value in the SHAP interpretability framework. The urban visual environment is identified and quantified by using the deep learning technology, the contribution of each factor to the housing price is analyzed, and the problem that the contribution of the urban visual environment to the housing price cannot be quantitatively evaluated in the prior art is solved.

TWM640737.title: Patent Specification TWM640737U
TWM640737.abstract: Patent publication covering industrial methods and systems in TWM640737U.

CN115730956.title: House price prediction model training method and house price prediction method
CN115730956.abstract: The invention relates to the field of computers, in particular to a house price prediction model training method and a house price prediction method. Comprising the following steps: acquiring house market prices and house attribute information of each market house corresponding to each current market house; according to the position information of each current market building, determining a target building standard price corresponding to each current market building; and training to obtain a target house price prediction model according to the target house standard price and the corresponding relationship between the house attribute information and the house market price. And the accuracy of the target house price prediction model obtained through training is ensured. Therefore, the accuracy of the house price predicted by using the target house price prediction model can be ensured, and the house price does not need to be evaluated manually. And the time cost and the labor cost are saved.
CN115730956.assignee: BEIJING ZIROOM INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

CN115660723.title: House price prediction system and method
CN115660723.abstract: The invention discloses a house price prediction method, and belongs to the technical field of real estate value prediction, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting a test set through a first data collection module; the first data processing module carries out data processing on the received test set to obtain processed test set data; inputting the processed test set data into a housing price prediction model through a first data input module; predicting a corresponding house price based on the test set after data processing through a house price prediction model to obtain a house price prediction result; and finally, the housing price prediction result is output to the client for reference research through the first data output module. The method provided by the invention not only has high prediction accuracy, but also has wide applicability.

KR20220148695.title: Method for predicting house price with hierarchical prediction structure
KR20220148695.abstract: A house price prediction method with a hierarchical prediction structure is disclosed, comprising the steps in which: first-level sales value time-series data, obtained by time-serially acquiring representative values of the sales prices of houses actually measured in a first administrative district according to a first-level administrative district hierarchy level on a monthly basis for a first predetermined period, is prepared; first-level sales value time-series data is input to the first-level predictor, and the first-level predicted sales value time-series data predicted and output by the first-level predictor is generated; second-level sales value time-series data, obtained by time-serially acquiring representative values of the sales prices of houses actually measured in a second administrative district according to a second-level administrative district hierarchy level, as the second administrative district belonging to the first administrative district, on a monthly basis during the first period, is prepared; by inputting the second-level sales value time-series data and the first-level predicted sales value time-series data into a second-level predictor, second-level predicted sales value time-series data predicted and output by the second-level predictor is generated; third-level sales value time-series data, obtained by time-serially acquiring representative values of the sales prices of houses actually measured in a third administrative district according to a third-level administrative district hierarchy level, as the third administrative district belonging to the second administrative district, on a monthly basis during the first period, is prepared; and by inputting the third-level sales value time-series data and the second-level predicted sales value time-series data into a third-level predictor, third-level predicted sales value time-series data predicted and output by the third-level predictor is generated.

TW202238503.title: Display device analyzing owner's personal information including an area plan database, a house number database, a display module, a real estate price registration database, a second-class transcript database, and an analysis module
TW202238503.abstract: A display device analyzing owner's personal information in the present invention includes an area plan database, a house number database, a display module, a real estate price registration database, a second-class transcript database, and an analysis module. The display module is used to display the house number of a plurality of house number information on the area plan based on coordinates of a plurality of house numbers in the house number database. The analysis module finds out the transaction time of the real estate registration data that is similar to the registration time of the second-class transcript data. At the same time, the floors, housing ages, building types, and current building patterns between the two are the same, but the house numbers between the two are partially the same. The owner's partial name, partial ID card number, household registration address, coordinates in the real estate price registration database, transaction price, and transaction time in the second-class transcript data are written into the house number database together.
TW202238503.assignee: JU YING ENTERPRISE MANAGEMENT CONSULTING CO LTD [TW]

TWI773575.title: Patent Specification TWI773575B
TWI773575.abstract: Patent publication covering industrial methods and systems in TWI773575B.

US20260322638.title: Network aware power management
US20260322638.abstract: In one embodiment, a system for managing network devices comprises a power management subsystem to allocate power budgets to the network devices, a network traffic control subsystem to manage network traffic among the network devices, and a communication interface between the power management subsystem and the network traffic control subsystem, wherein the power management subsystem is to send power allocation decisions to the network traffic control subsystem, and the network traffic control subsystem is to adjust network traffic control based on the received power allocation decisions.

US20260323391.title: TECHNIQUES FOR ENERGY AWARE DISTRIBUTED RELAYING
US20260323391.abstract: Example implementations include a relay node for wireless communication systems. In one implementation, the relay node may identify buffer status information including a current buffer state and a future buffer state associated with a forwarding link with a peer node. The relay node may further transmit, to one of the peer node or another node, an indication including one or both of the current buffer state and the future buffer state for energy aware traffic routing. In another implementation, a relay node identify a current energy usage and an additional energy usage associated with a forwarding link with a peer node, wherein the additional energy usage is further associated with traffic information. The relay node may further transmit, to one of the peer node or another node, an indication including one or both of the current energy usage and the additional energy usage for energy aware traffic routing.

US20260319981.title: SWITCHING AWARE DATA ENCODING FOR DATA TRANSFERS
US20260319981.abstract: A method for data processing includes creating a bit selection mask and partitioning input data sequences with the bit selection mask into clusters. Each cluster has an original cluster identifier (ID). The method further includes calculating majority bit patterns for each cluster. The method still further includes remapping the original cluster IDs into new cluster IDs based on Hamming weights and a quantity of data sequences within each cluster. The method also includes generating code patterns by modifying each majority bit pattern of each cluster based on the respective new cluster ID. The method includes calculating codewords for each cluster based on the data sequences in the respective cluster and the respective code pattern. The method further includes replacing the input data sequences with the codewords to create a code.

US20260318895.title: CONTEXT-AWARE CLOUD SEEDING FOR WATER CARBON SEQUESTRATION
US20260318895.abstract: In some implementations, a device may receive satellite observation data comprising optical and microwave spectral reflectance data for a body of water. The device may determine a salinity, a pH, and a water carbon sequestration potential of the body of water using the satellite observation data and a geospatial foundation model. The device may determine one or more hotspots of potential carbon sequestration in the body of water based on the salinity, the pH, the water carbon sequestration potential, a phytoplankton turbidity saturation profile, and a marine species oxygen threshold profile. The device may output, based on the salinity, the pH, and the water carbon sequestration potential, an indication of an optimal set of hotspots of the one or more hotspots and an optimal mixture of alkaline substances for cloud seeding for the optimal set of hotspots.

US20260320361.title: GRADIENT-AWARE SINGULAR VALUE DECOMPOSITION FOR NEURAL NETWORK COMPRESSION
US20260320361.abstract: [0000]    According to an implementation, a gradient-aware neural network compression technique reduces model size while maximizing output quality preservation. The method evaluates partial derivatives of a loss function with respect to pre-activations through backpropagation on calibration data without updating weights. A diagonal gradient matrix is generated based on these derivatives, and singular value decomposition is applied to a product of this gradient matrix, the weight matrix, and a scaling matrix derived from input activations. Truncated decomposition components are produced by removing columns and rows based on a truncation parameter that balances information loss against compression. Two smaller consecutive layers replace each original layer, with weights corresponding to component matrices derived from the truncated decomposition. In a variant implementation, a power factor approach partitions neurons from each layer among two groups, where the smaller group is responsible for most of the magnitude of the error term vector, creating a salience matrix.

WO2026216633.title: CHAMP ACOUSTIQUE NEURONAL SENSIBLE À LA DIRECTION POUR MODÉLISATION DE RÉPONSE IMPULSIONNELLE D'UNE PIÈCE À RÉSOLUTION SPATIALE
WO2026216633.abstract: An audio system and method are disclosed for performing spatial audio tasks using direction-aware neural modeling of room impulse responses (RIRs). The audio system includes a direction-aware neural acoustic field (DANF) module that is configured to receive a spatial configuration comprising a position of an acoustic source, a position of a listener, and an orientation of the listener within a three-dimensional environment. The DANF module is also configured to generate an Ambisonic-format RIR representing directionally resolved acoustic energy. An audio processing module is operatively coupled to the DANF module and is configured to perform an audio task — such as rendering, synthesis, or localization — based on the Ambisonic-format RIR. The use of Ambisonic representation enables consistent directional encoding, and the neural field architecture supports flexible and efficient spatial modeling for immersive audio applications.

US20260321041.title: UTILIZING A MASK-AWARE VISION-LANGUAGE CAPTIONING MODEL TO GENERATE IMAGE CAPTIONS
US20260321041.abstract: [0000]    The present disclosure relates to systems, non-transitory computer-readable media, and methods for generating captions for a digital image at multiple granularity levels utilizing a mask-aware vision-language captioning model. In particular, the disclosed systems receive, by at least one processing device, a text prompt and a digital image with a binary mask indicating a region of interest in the digital image. Additionally, the disclosed systems generate, utilizing a mask-aware vision-language captioning model, an image caption for the digital image describing the region of interest based on the text prompt.

US20260323240.title: Direction-Aware Neural Acoustic Field for Spatially Resolved Room Impulse Response Modeling
US20260323240.abstract: An audio system and method are disclosed for performing spatial audio tasks using direction-aware neural modeling of room impulse responses (RIRs). The audio system includes a direction-aware neural acoustic field (DANF) module that is configured to receive a spatial configuration comprising a position of an acoustic source, a position of a listener, and an orientation of the listener within a three-dimensional environment. The DANF module is also configured to generate an Ambisonic-format RIR representing directionally resolved acoustic energy. An audio processing module is operatively coupled to the DANF module and is configured to perform an audio task—such as rendering, synthesis, or localization—based on the Ambisonic-format RIR. The use of Ambisonic representation enables consistent directional encoding, and the neural field architecture supports flexible and efficient spatial modeling for immersive audio applications.

US20260321292.title: CONTEXT-AWARE TECHNIQUES FOR VIDEO HIGHLIGHT EXTRACTION INTEGRATING AUDIO ANALYSIS, AND SYSTEMS OF USE THEREOF
US20260321292.abstract: A method automatically creating a highlight video from video data captured at a head-wearable device is described. The method includes, in response to a capture command, receiving image data captured at cameras of the head-wearable device and receiving audio data captured at microphones of the head-wearable device. The method further comprises causing the image data to be divided into a plurality of image segments, causing the audio data to be divided into a plurality of audio segments, each audio segment of the plurality of audio segments corresponding to a respective image segment of the plurality of image segments, and generating a respective transcription of each audio segment. The method 300 further includes, in accordance with a determination, based on the respective transcription, that a respective audio segment is a highlight segment, add the respective audio segment and a corresponding image segment to a highlight video.

US20260320714.title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR POLICY-AWARE AI-DRIVEN ALLOCATION OF ASSET OWNERSHIP AND USAGE WITH TRANSACTION COMPRESSION, MULTILATERAL NETTING, AND AUDIT-GRADE RECEIPTS
US20260320714.abstract: [0000]    A computing platform allocates ownership of an asset for maximized collective economic benefit while preserving user usage rights. The platform ingests asset-utilization transactions, user profiles, and supplemental datasets, and trains and executes an AI/ML categorization engine on a hardware accelerator using quantization and sparsity-preserving updates. The platform predicts a most-efficient-use vector, detects ownership inefficiency, selects a specialized ownership entity that maximizes expected benefit under policy constraints, and executes a retitling transaction comprising a conveyance plus a usage agreement. Optional embodiments generate audit-grade, hash-linked receipts and compress obligations via graph-based multilateral netting, geospatial shard migration, and intermediary internalization to reduce settlement legs, latency, and attack surface.

US20260322630.title: STATE-BOUND AUTHORITY CERTIFICATES, SEMANTIC-DELTA ENVELOPES, DERIVATION-GRAPH AUTHORIZATION, DELEGATED SUB-CAPABILITIES, DRIFT-AWARE REAUTHORIZATION, AND SECRET-FIREWALLED EXECUTION FOR AUTONOMOUS AI SYSTEMS
US20260322630.abstract: [0000]    A control-plane architecture for autonomous AI execution receives a proposed action, canonicalizes it into a canonical action descriptor, and binds a signed authority certificate to a canonical action digest with state, policy, environment, derivation, and semantic-delta values. Execution is gated on certificate validation and may be delayed, transformed, rerouted, queued, or suppressed. Channel-binding records may identify primary and alternate source-analysis, GUI, browser, operating-system, mobile, or programmatic channels, switch predicates, verifier sufficiency profiles, environment classes, and non-expansion constraints. Upon drift or channel failure, a continuity capsule may link predecessor and successor authority artifacts with checkpoint and digest values. Replay bundles, delegated sub-capabilities, secret-firewalled execution, graph fusion, and cyber-defense evidence bundles are also supported.

EP4823058.title: ÜBERLASTUNGSBEWUSSTES MULTIPATHING FÜR KOLLEKTIVE NETZWERKKOMMUNIKATION (NCC)
EP4823058.abstract: [0001]    A system providing congestion aware communications in a collective communication networking environment includes receiving a message for communication from a sender to a receiver, the message comprising a chunk of data having a first amount of data. A slicer divides the chunk of data into smaller portions of data, or quanta. For each quanta, a scheduler module iteratively checks each of a plurality of queue pairs, a queue pair representing a dedicated communication pathway between the sender and receiver. Each QP is checked for a number of outstanding bytes associated with the QP. A QP is selected, the selected QP having the minimum number of outstanding bytes among the plurality of queue pairs. The quanta are scheduled for sending on the selected QP. The outstanding bytes associated with a QP, provides an estimate of the level of congestion experienced by the QP. A quanta may be configured to contain 64 KB.

US12763966.title: Method and system for browser-based processing of encrypted documents with paragraph-aware segmentation and cryptographic audit trail generation
US12763966.abstract: A method and system for processing encrypted documents using artificial intelligence within web browser environments while maintaining end-to-end encryption boundaries. The system decrypts documents in isolated browser memory, extracts text using multi-pass paragraph-aware segmentation comprising visual, linguistic, semantic, and domain-specific analysis passes with aggregator and voting logic for boundary determination, processes content through domain-specific AI modules with quantized neural network weights, and generates cryptographic audit trails using chained hashing. Security measures include side-channel attack mitigation and cryptographic memory clearing with verification. The paragraph-aware segmentation algorithm preserves semantic coherence across processing boundaries, improving accuracy compared to naive chunking methods. The system supports legal, medical, and financial document processing using domain-optimized BERT variants executing via WebAssembly with optional WebGPU acceleration, all within browser boundaries without server communication.

US20260311710.title: Source-Aware Unified Neural Audio Codec
US20260311710.abstract: Embodiments disclosing systems and methods for source aware audio coding are provided. An audio coding system includes an input encoder that is configured to receive an input audio signal comprising a mixture of two or more sound sources. The encoder also generates a latent representation of the input audio signal. A conditional feature extractor is also provided that is configured to receive the latent representation and one or more prompts indicative of one or more of the sound sources in the mixture. Based on the prompts separated latent features corresponding to the one or more sound sources are generated. A quantizer discretizes the separated latent features into one or more sequences of codes. Further, a decoder is configured to reconstruct, from the one or more sequences of codes, one or more audio signals corresponding to one or more of the one or more sound sources indicated by the prompts.

US20260310450.title: CONTEXT-AWARE BUG GROUPING AND PRIORITIZATION SYSTEM
US20260310450.abstract: Provided herein are systems, methods, machine-readable media, and the like, for bug mitigation in a software application. A method includes receiving a bug report associated with a bug, the bug report including a title, reproduction steps, and a description, generating, by a transformer model, respective embeddings of the title and the description resulting in a title embedding and a description embedding, generating a functional intent signature (FIS) of the bug based on the reproduction steps, clustering the bug based on the FIS, the title embedding and the description embedding, determining the bug belongs to a highest priority cluster, and mitigating the bug responsive to determining the bug belongs to a highest priority cluster resulting in an updated software application.

WO2026210402.title: PROCÉDÉS ET APPAREIL DE RAG/LLM ADAPTÉS AU DISPOSITIF
WO2026210402.abstract: A RAG/LLM-based method for appliance-device diagnosis and/or remediation (DD-DR) is disclosed. In some embodiments, the method comprises performing one or more data-access operations to provide access to device-state data specific for a given multi-state appliance device (e.g. smartphone, tablet, laptop, or router). In some embodiments, device-state-specific and given-device-specific (DSS-GDS) 5 augmentation-information, which is specific to a particular device instance, is retrieved by feature- comparison between the content of a DD-DR prompt and DSS-GDS candidate state-data accessible as a result of the data-access operations. In some embodiments, LLM receives a DSS-GDS-device-state- data-augmented DD-DR prompt generated from both the original DD-DR prompt and the retrieved DSS-GDS augmentation-information. In some embodiments, LLM generates a response to the 0 augmented prompt that is informed by the device-instance-specific state data, thereby enabling accurate and context-aware device diagnosis and/or remediation.

US20260310212.title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR SEMANTICALLY-AWARE NAVIGATION
US20260310212.abstract: Various embodiments of an autonomous mobile robot operable within a facility and methods of operating the autonomous mobile robot are described herein. The autonomous mobile robot includes one or more sensors configured to collect environmental data characterizing an environment of the autonomous mobile robot and receive user prompts representative of mission instructions. The user prompts include natural directions. The autonomous mobile robot also includes one or more processors, which are configured to determine an operational purpose of the autonomous mobile robot, initiate a planning component to evaluate the user prompts to define a mission goal for the autonomous mobile robot with reference to the operational purpose of the autonomous mobile robot and the environmental data and generate a mission plan for accomplishing the mission goal. The processor(s) then initiate an execution component functionally separate from the planning component to operate the autonomous mobile robot to execute the mission plan.

US20260310503.title: Phase-Aware Resource Tuning Using Behavioral Inference
US20260310503.abstract: [0000]    Technologies are disclosed for tuning resources of a processing unit based on behavioral phase-of-execution determinations. A phase-of-execution of code executing on a processing unit is inferred from processor-level execution events detectable at an architectural level. A tuning controller applies phase-specific adjustments to one or more hardware resources in real time with execution of the code. In some embodiments, tuning prepares for a predicted subsequent phase-of-execution and is applied prior to commencement of the predicted phase. Expected performance benefit may be evaluated by estimating the probability that a predicted phase is correct, the performance improvement if correct, and potential degradation if incorrect, with tuning applied only when an overall expected benefit is positive. Phase-specific adjustments may include modifying power gating, voltage or frequency levels, cache configuration, prefetching behavior, branch prediction parameters, or speculative-execution mechanisms. These techniques enable adaptive, phase-aware optimization of processing-unit resources without reliance on static knowledge of code structure.

US20260310855.title: Efficiency-Aware Performance Bounds in SoC Design
US20260310855.abstract: [0000]    Techniques and apparatuses are described for implementing efficiency-aware performance bounds in system-on-chip (SoC) design. In aspects, a decision module receives one or more target values from a policy coordinator, the one or more target values based on one or more intellectual property (IP) parameters of one or more IP agents. In further aspects, the decision module receives one or more performance state recommendations from one or more processing modules. In some examples, the decision module generates a performance state change command, the performance state change command configured to change the one or more IP performance states of the one or more IP agents. The decision module outputs the performance state change command to the one or more IP agents. In this way, a system-on-chip can dynamically manage multiple operations concerns for the one or more processors, such as balancing performance, temperature, and power concerns to realize a tailored user experience.

US20260310665.title: EARLY STOPPING SCHEME FOR BUDGET AWARE INDEX TUNING
US20260310665.abstract: An early stopping checking and verification process includes deriving a workload lower bound and a workload upper bound on what-if cost for an index tuning curve for a workload as what-if calls are being made. The index tuning curve represents a function that maps a number of what-if calls allocated to a percentage improvement of a best index configuration found so far. Early stopping checks are performed to identify a predetermined characteristic of the index tuning curve to determine if early stopping verification should be performed. A difference between the workload lower bound and the workload upper bound is compared to a threshold when the predetermined characteristic is detected. What-if calls for the workload are terminated based at least in part on the comparison between the difference between the workload lower bound and the workload upper bound and the predefined threshold.

WO2026213273.title: PRÉVISION DE SÉRIE CHRONOLOGIQUE DE MÉMOIRE LONGUE À COURT TERME SENSIBLE AUX TRANSITIONS
WO2026213273.abstract: This disclosure presents a computer-implemented method and system for forecasting time-series data using advanced neural network techniques involving converting historical data into structured time-series representations to facilitate pattern recognition. The method dynamically adjusts weight assignments in a neural memory model, utilizing transition-based reweighting to optimize computational efficiency and prediction accuracy. A transition-aware long short-term memory (LSTM) model captures long-term dependencies, while a prediction module generates future values. The system enhances accuracy by selectively updating memory buffers and weight assignments based on historical transitions and detected events. This approach minimizes redundant memory modifications and improves sequence prediction, making it suitable for applications like traffic networks and transaction forecasting. The system's architecture supports distributed computing environments, allowing for efficient processing of long sequences and real-time adaptation to sequence variations, ultimately refining predictive capabilities.

The method comprises i) collecting, for a wireless communication device (220), device related and/or application (224) related requirements and performance metrics as well as hardware and/or computation capability information of O-RAN entities related to the wireless communication device (220); ii) using semantic modules (222, 226, 232, 236) to jointly process the collected information, wherein processing includes interpreting semantics and their requirements from the applications (224) running at the wireless communication device (220), applications (234) running at the Edge/MEC platform (230) and/or applications (235) running in O-RAN's O-Cloud (216); iii) determining, by one or more xApps (203) running at O-RAN's Near-RT RIC (202) and/or by one or more rApps (205) running at O-RAN's Non-RT RIC (204), based on the result of the joint processing, semantic-aware optimization policies for configuration of the wireless communication device (220), applications (224) running at the wireless communication device (220), applications (234) running at the Edge/MEC platform (230), applications (235) running in O-RAN's O-Cloud (216), and/or one or more O-RAN entities; and iv) enforcing the optimization policies by causing configuration of one or more target entities, including the wireless communication device (220), the applications (224), and one or more O-RAN entities, in accordance with the derived optimization policies. Furthermore, a wireless communication system including an O-RAN is disclosed.
