US20260310657.title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR CONTEXT-AWARE QUERY INTERPRETATION USING GENERATIVE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE MODELS
US20260310657.abstract: Systems and methods for context-aware query interpretation using Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) models is disclosed. The system receives a request for generating a response corresponding to a domain from user. The system identifies entities and an intent of the request received. Also, the system determines candidate tables, fields, metrics, and/or dimensions. The system generates candidate executable database query followed by validating the candidate executable database query. The system generates output data by executing the validated executable database query. Moreover, the system computes a confidence score for the validated executable database query. The system generates a response based on the computed confidence score and the generated output data. Consequently, the system outputs the response on a user interface of a user device.

US20260310387.title: CONVERSATIONAL GENERATIVE UI COPILOT USING DESIGN COMPONENT LIBRARIES AND INTENT-AWARE DATA BINDING
US20260310387.abstract: [0000]    Deterministic user interface generation using a storage system copilot, including: receiving, from a client device, a request for an artificial intelligence (AI) copilot of a storage system comprising a natural language description of a task associated with the storage system; generating, using the AI copilot and based on the request, a user interface facilitating a user of the client device in performing the task, including: selecting, using the AI copilot, one or more user interface components from a user interface component library; generating the user interface comprising the one or more user interface components; and presenting the user interface to the client device.

US20260311871.title: Emotion-Aware AI System with Cyclical Feedback Architecture for Adaptive User Experience.
US20260311871.abstract: The Emotion-Aware AI System is a modular, cross-device framework that detects, classifies, and responds to emotional, somatic, and physiological states in real time. It captures multimodal signals, including facial expressions, vocal tone, heart rate variability, glucose levels, and skin response via sensors, wearables, and APIs. These inputs, combining both external expressions and internal somatic cues, are fused into a unified state vector and classified using deep learning. An embedded SIAOAIR AI Co-Pilot enables agentic intelligence, orchestrating proactive, context-aware actions using reinforcement learning, behavioral feedback, and real-time adaptation with or without user input. Post-intervention data is evaluated locally and securely transmitted (encrypted) to a Federated Aggregation Server for ongoing model refinement. A dedicated privacy layer enforces encryption and differential privacy. Oversight is maintained through an AI Governance and Mission Control layer, ensuring transparency, explainability, and ethical, compliant human-AI interaction.

US20260313718.title: METHODS, ARCHITECTURES, APPARATUSES AND SYSTEMS FOR ENERGY-AWARE UE-TO-NETWORK RELAYING SERVICES
US20260313718.abstract: Procedures, methods, architectures, apparatuses, systems, devices, and computer program products for energy-aware UE-to-network relaying. A relay device establishes a connection with a remote device, monitors energy consumption related to data traffic forwarded through the relay device for the remote device, and, in response to detecting an energy-related event affecting an ability of the relay device to respect an energy criterion negotiated with the remote device, sends, to the remote device, information indicative of a request to alter the connection, and alters the connection.

US20260313051.title: System and Method for Identity-Weighted Access Token Generation and Capability-Aware Delivery
US20260313051.abstract: A system and method for identity-weighted access token generation and capability-aware delivery, to dynamically adjust token parameters based on accumulated verification history and trust context. The system maintains longitudinal identity records that compound contextual intelligence across multiple verification events, computing identity confidence scores that weight token entropy, privilege levels, and temporal validity constraints. A multi-state opt-in model governs both messaging protocol eligibility and physical access entitlement tiers, enabling graduated consent progression from basic access to enhanced Rich Communication Services delivery to loyalty-augmented expedited entry. The system coordinates capability negotiation with consent-gated channel eligibility determination, maintaining seamless session continuity across protocol transitions when delivery failures occur. Enriched ledger entries record identity confidence scores, opt-in states, messaging protocols, and loyalty tiers alongside generated tokens, creating auditable trust evolution records that enable adaptive policy learning and differentiated access experiences for established users with proven engagement patterns.

WO2026212483.title: PROCÉDÉ ET DISPOSITIF POUR FOURNIR UN SERVICE DE DUPLICATION D'ÉCRAN À L'AIDE D'UNE COMMUNICATION SENSIBLE AU WI-FI
WO2026212483.abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method and device for providing a screen mirroring service in a neighbor awareness networking (NAN)-based communication system. The method performed by a first electronic device in a neighbor awareness networking (NAN)-based communication system, according to an embodiment of the present disclosure, may comprise the steps of: transmitting, to a second electronic device, a first frame for service discovery in a first period for unsynchronized service discovery (USD); and receiving, from the second electronic device, a second frame for service discovery in response to the first frame, wherein at least one among the first frame and the second frame includes NAN pairing information and service-related information for a screen mirroring service between the first electronic device and the second electronic device.
claims:
1. NAN(neighbor awareness networking) 기반 통신 시스템에서 제1 전자 장치가 수행하는 방법에 있어서,
제2 전자 장치로, USD(unsynchronized service discovery)를 위한 제1 구간에서 서비스 디스커버리를 위한 제1 프레임을 전송하는 단계; 및
상기 제2 전자 장치로부터, 상기 제1 프레임에 응답하여 서비스 디스커버리를 위한 제2 프레임을 수신하는 단계;를 포함하고,
상기 제1 프레임 또는 상기 제2 프레임 중 적어도 하나는 상기 제1 전자 장치 및 상기 제2 전자 장치 간 스크린 미러링 서비스를 위한 서비스 관련 정보 및 NAN 페어링 정보를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법. 2. 제1항에 있어서, 상기 스크린 미러링 서비스는,
상기 NAN(neighbor awareness networking) 기반 통신에 관련된 미라캐스트(Miracast) 서비스를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법. 3. 제1항에 있어서,
상기 제1 프레임 및 상기 제2 프레임은 상기 제1 전자 장치와 연결된(associated) 액세스 포인트(access point, AP)가 운용하는 제1 채널에서 전송 및 수신되는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법. 4. 제3항에 있어서, 상기 제1 전자 장치와 상기 액세스 포인트(AP)는 DFS(dynamic frequency selection) 채널 또는 6GHz 대역의 채널을 포함하지 않는 채널에서 연결된 것을 특징으로 하는 방법. 5. 제3항에 있어서,
상기 제1 프레임 및 상기 제2 프레임은 상기 제1 채널 및 2.4GHz의 채널 6에서 전송 및 수신되는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법. 6. 제1항에 있어서, 상기 제1 프레임 및 상기 제2 프레임은 2.4 GHz의 채널 6에서 전송 및 수신되는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법. 7. 제1항에 있어서, 상기 제1 구간 이전에 상기 NAN 기반 통신을 위한 채널 정보 및 트리거 정보 중 적어도 하나를 포함하는 블루투스 저전력(Bluetooth low energy, BLE) 메시지를 상기 제2 전자 장치로 전송하는 단계;를 더 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법. 8. 제1항에 있어서, 상기 제1 전자 장치와 액세스 포인트(AP)가 연결되지 않은 경우, 상기 제1 프레임 및 상기 제2 프레임은 2.4GHz의 채널 6 및 5GHz의 채널 149 중 적어도 하나에서 전송 및 수신되고, 또는
상기 제1 전자 장치와 액세스 포인트(AP)가 DFS(dynamic frequency selection) 채널 및 6GHz 대역의 채널에서 연결된 경우, 상기 제1 프레임 및 상기 제2 프레임은 2.4GHz의 채널 6에서 전송 및 수신되는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법. 9. 제1항에 있어서, 상기 제1 구간에서 와이파이 다이렉트(Wi-Fi Direct) 통신의 청취(Listen) 동작을 수행하고,
상기 제1 전자 장치와 액세스 포인트(AP)가 연결되지 않은 경우, 상기 와이파이 다이렉트(Wi-Fi Direct) 통신의 청취(Listen) 동작은 2.4GHz의 채널 6에서 수행되고, 및
상기 제1 전자 장치와 액세스 포인트(AP)가 연결된 경우, 상기 와이파이 다이렉트(Wi-Fi Direct) 통신의 청취(Listen) 동작은 상기 액세스 포인트(AP)가 운용하는 제1 채널, 또는 상기 제1 채널 및 2.4GHz의 채널 6에서 수행되는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법. 10. 제1항에 있어서, 상기 NAN(neighbor awareness networking) 페어링 정보는,
NIRA(NAN identity resolution attribute), NPBA(NAN pairing bootstrapping attribute), CSIA(cipher suite info attribute), 또는 DCEA(device capability extension attribute) 중 적어도 하나를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법. 11. 제1항에 있어서,
상기 제2 전자 장치로, 상기 제2 프레임의 수신에 대한 응답으로 데이터 경로 요청을 위한 제3 프레임을 전송하는 단계; 및
상기 제2 전자 장치로부터, 상기 제3 프레임에 대한 응답으로 제4 프레임을 수신하는 단계;를 포함하고,
상기 제3 프레임 및 상기 제4 프레임 중 적어도 하나는 스케줄 정보를 포함하고, 및
상기 스케줄 정보는,
상기 제1 전자 장치가 특정 시간 구간 및 주파수 대역에서 사용 가능(Available)한지를 나타내는 정보 요소인 NAN 가용성 속성(NAN availability attribute)에 포함되는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법. 12. 제1항에 있어서, 상기 제1 프레임 및 상기 제2 프레임 중 적어도 하나는,
상기 제1 전자 장치 및 상기 제2 전자 장치 간 상기 서비스 디스커버리 이전에 수행된 인증에 관련된 정보, 또는 미라캐스트 연결 설립을 위한 인증(certificate) 정보 중 적어도 하나를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 방법. 13. 제1항에 있어서,
상기 제2 전자 장치로, 상기 제1 구간 이전에 와이파이 다이렉트(Wi-Fi Direct) 통신을 이용하여 장치 발견의 요청을 위한 제5 프레임을 전송하는 단계; 및

WO2026213597.title: APPLICATION DE POLITIQUE EN TEMPS RÉEL PAR ÉVALUATION DE RISQUE SENSIBLE À UNE SÉQUENCE ET INTERVENTION POUR DES INTERFACES LOGICIELLES TIERCES
WO2026213597.abstract: A computer-implemented system performs policy enforcement for third-party software interfaces. Processors obtain action data indicative of a proposed action within a workflow, generate structured observations identifying an action type, a context of the proposed action, and one or more interface or system elements associated with the proposed action, and retrieve sequence context associated with the proposed action from prior workflow activity across one or more applications or services. The processors evaluate the proposed action against policy constraints using the structured observations and the sequence context to generate a risk output, select an intervention modality based at least in part on the risk output, and cause performance of the intervention modality. The intervention modality includes a user-interface intervention associated with a target interface element. In some embodiments, the intervention modality includes a machine-readable intervention response that alters, delays, denies, or redirects execution of the proposed action by an artificial intelligence agent.

US20260311832.title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR CONTEXT-AWARE RADIOLOGY REPORT GENERATION USING A JSON-BASED ENGINE AND LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
US20260311832.abstract: [0000]    The present technology relates to methods and systems for context-aware report generation using a JSON-based engine and large language models, particularly for use in the practice of radiology. According to certain embodiments, the method comprises: receiving a dictation; selecting a JSON template; extracting one or more keywords from the dictation; wherein, when at least one keyword is identified, populating at least one section of the JSON template based on the at least one keyword, and when no keyword is identified, retaining a default version of the JSON template; assembling a dynamic prompt based on the JSON template and any populated section; and generating a report based on the dynamic prompt and the dictation.

US12637191.title: System and method for varying boat speed to increase fish catch rate
US12637191.abstract: A marine propulsion system comprises an electric marine drive having an electric motor in torque-transmitting relationship with a propulsor, a controller configured to vary a speed of the electric motor, and a feedback device configured to provide an input to the controller. The controller is configured to vary the speed of the electric motor according to a set of operating parameters so as to periodically vary a speed of the propulsor. The controller is configured to update the set of operating parameters in response to receiving the input from the feedback device.

CN121970711.title: Fish catch sorting mechanism and method
CN121970711.abstract: The invention provides a fishery catch sorting mechanism and method. The fishery catch sorting mechanism comprises a rack; the rolling sorting structure is arranged on the upper portion of the rack and comprises a plurality of pin rollers which are sequentially arranged in the conveying direction and arranged in parallel, sorting gaps are reserved between the adjacent pin rollers, and the rolling sorting structure is used for conducting size-based first-stage sorting on the catches; the vibration sorting structure is arranged at the lower part of the rack, is positioned below the rolling sorting structure, and is used for receiving the fishery catches sorted by the rolling sorting structure and carrying out second-stage sorting; and the visual sorting structure is arranged at the discharging end of the vibration sorting structure, comprises an image acquisition device and an execution part capable of being controlled to act, and is used for identifying and sorting out the target catches. According to the fishery catch sorting mechanism, the three sorting principles of gap screening, vibration screening and image recognition screening are innovatively integrated in a compact device, and high-precision and high-efficiency sorting of fishery catches of multiple categories and multiple specifications is achieved in a limited space.

CN121278408.title: Intelligent fish catch identification method and system
CN121278408.abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent fish catch identification method and system, and belongs to the technical field of fishery resource management. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a fish catch variety multi-source identification vector containing multi-source data, then constructing a spatial weight matrix according to a fishing site, determining fish catch weight gradient distribution through autocorrelation analysis, further determining a weight propagation path, constructing a weight propagation region link, and finally determining a weight propagation region based on the fishing time and the fishing site. According to the method, the spatial movement mode of the fish catch nodes is obtained, so that a fishing propagation time sequence link is constructed, and a multi-source propagation time sequence link is generated by fusing the weight propagation region link and the fishing propagation time sequence link, so that the generated fish catch multi-source data relation graph can comprehensively couple the fishing operation mode and the fish catch living characteristics; the method achieves the intelligent recognition of the fish catches through the image feature extraction, improves the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the recognition of the fish catches, and enables the recognition of the fish catches to provide a basis for the making of fishery resources such as a no-fishing period and a fishing quota.

CN121191198.title: Typical water area fish catch statistical method and system
CN121191198.abstract: The invention discloses a typical water area fish catch statistics method and system, and is applied to the field of fish catch statistics, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining typical fish catch data in a typical water area; performing resolution gradient reduction on a first image data set in the typical fishing data; identifying feature information of each target object in all the to-be-identified images; determining a motion track of each target object; performing similarity judgment on each target object according to the motion trail and the feature information; marking according to a similarity judgment result to obtain a second image data set; performing re-marking processing on all the second image data sets; integrating all the images with the remarks to form a third image data set; and determining catch data of the typical water area based on a catch statistical result of the third image data set. According to the typical water area fish catch statistical method and system provided by the invention, the fish catch statistical efficiency and accuracy are remarkably improved, and then the typical water area fish catch result is obtained more quickly and accurately.

LU600778.title: A fish catch economic benefit prediction method based on fishery acoustic data and multi-source data
LU600778.abstract: The present invention relates to the field of fishery data analysis and forecasting, and discloses a method for predicting the economic benefits of fish catches based on fishery acoustic data and multi-source data. The method includes the following steps: collecting relevant fishery data while obtaining a specific type of fish catch; performing spatiotemporal alignment of the fishery data to obtain spatiotemporally aligned fishery data; and based on the spatiotemporally aligned fishery data, constructing and updating a fish catch economic benefit prediction model and updating a fish species quantity prediction model for generating a fishing plan for the specific type of fish catch. This invention is included in the National Key R&D Program Project, Offshore Fishery Resource Assessment and Ecological Fishery Technology, No.: 2024YFD2400403. It can optimize fishing vessel operation plans through accurate prediction, achieve the purpose of increasing economic benefits, improving fishermen's income, and reducing overfishing of sensitive species.
LU600778.assignee: SOUH CHINA SEA FISHENES RES INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF FISHERY SCIENCES [CN]

CN120430500.title: Method and device for evaluating recovery potential of spotted seal population for controlling fish catch
CN120430500.abstract: The invention discloses a seal population recovery potential assessment method and device for controlling fish catch, and relates to the field of marine ecological protection and restoration, and the method mainly comprises the four steps: modeling, predation rate calculation, fishing amount reduction stage determination, and seal population recovery potential assessment. Based on the Ecopath model, the predation rate parameter is introduced, the seal feeding habit matrix is dynamically adjusted, the data requirement of modeling is reduced, quantitative evaluation of fishing control measure protection benefits is achieved, and a practical method tool is provided for seal population recovery potential evaluation. Therefore, the seal population recovery potential assessment method and device based on fish catch control provided by the invention have good seal population recovery potential assessment ability, and can be popularized and applied to the field of marine organism population resource recovery potential assessment.
CN120430500.assignee: FIRST INSTITUTE OF OCEANOGRAPHY MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES

CN119908331.title: Fish catch cold transportation device and use method
CN119908331.abstract: The invention discloses a fishery catch cold transportation device and a using method.The fishery catch cold transportation device comprises a box body, a containing frame, a movable ice spreading assembly, an ice block supplementing assembly and a backflow assembly.In the transportation process, fishes are placed in the containing frame, ice is continuously spread on the surfaces of the fishes in the containing frame through the movable ice spreading assembly, and the ice blocks are continuously spread on the surfaces of the fishes; in the moving process of the movable ice laying assembly, melted ice water is conveyed to the ice block supplementing assembly, new ice blocks are supplemented into the movable ice laying assembly through the ice block supplementing assembly after the movable ice laying assembly moves for a fixed number of times, ice can be continuously laid on the surfaces of the fishes in the long-line transportation process, the temperature in the box body can be kept, and the ice laying efficiency is improved. The fish can be prevented from waking up in advance due to temperature rise, the body surface of the catch can be kept moist through ice block melting, and the catch is prevented from death due to oxygen deficit caused by dry gills in the long-line transportation process.
CN119908331.assignee: SHANDONG MARINE RESOURCE AND ENVIRONMENT RES INSTITUTE SHANDONG MARINE ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING CENT

CN119329690.title: On-board fish catch conveying device
CN119329690.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of fishing boat fish catch conveying, in particular to an on-board fish catch conveying device which comprises a conveying belt, a sliding way and a frozen fish cabin. A plurality of baffles are arranged on the two sides of the conveying face of the conveying belt in the conveying direction of the conveying belt, and at least part of the baffles are movably arranged on the conveying belt. The feeding end of the sliding way is in lap joint with the position, movably provided with the baffle, of the conveying belt, and the feeding end of the frozen fish cabin is in lap joint with the discharging end of the sliding way. According to the invention, the manpower dependence can be reduced, and the conveying and transferring efficiency is improved.

CN118749545.title: Fish catch sorting equipment
CN118749545.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sorting devices, in particular to fishery catch sorting equipment which comprises a mounting frame, a sorting channel is mounted on the surface of the mounting frame and used for flowing and conveying fishery catches, a feeding hopper is mounted at one end of the sorting channel, and a plurality of groups of sorting mechanisms are mounted on the mounting frame. The multiple sets of sorting mechanisms are linearly distributed on the surface of the sorting channel at equal intervals. The sorting mechanisms are arranged on the sorting channel, the sorting mechanisms are used for sorting the fishery catches according to body types and automatically weighing the fishery catches after sorting, the weighed fishery catches are conveyed into the flow dividing mechanism, and the fishery catches are separated and conveyed according to the weight; the sorting body sizes of the multiple groups of sorting mechanisms are gradually reduced according to the conveying direction of the fishery catches in the sorting channel, the fishery catches are further sorted according to the body sizes and then are further weighed and sorted, and effective sorting operation of the fishery catches is achieved.

CN118683690.title: Fish catch storage device based on ocean fishing boat
CN118683690.abstract: The invention discloses a fish catch storage device based on a marine fishing boat, and relates to the field of marine fishery, the fish catch storage device comprises a storage bin and a bin adjusting movable wallboard, the top of the storage bin is provided with a bin inlet, the side face of the storage bin is provided with a bin outlet door, and the bin adjusting movable wallboard is installed in the storage bin; the warehouse adjusting movable wall plate divides the interior of the storage warehouse into two independent areas, the area close to the warehouse inlet is a pre-storage area, the other area is a storage area, the warehouse adjusting movable wall plate can move in the storage warehouse to change the effective volume of the storage area, and a conveying belt is installed at the position, below the warehouse adjusting movable wall plate, in the storage warehouse. According to the invention, proper space allowance can be always kept in the storage area for storing the fish catches, so that when the ship body runs joltly, as the space allowance of the storage area is limited, the shaking amplitude of the fish catches is greatly reduced, the quality of the fish catches is ensured, and the damage to the ship body is reduced.

CN117819156.title: Fish catch transporting device
CN117819156.abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of fishery catch transportation, and discloses a fishery catch transportation device which comprises a transportation base body, a conveying belt and a power assembly are arranged on the transportation base body, the transportation base body comprises a lifting section and a placing section, the transportation base body further comprises a conveying base, a first lifting assembly is arranged on the conveying base, and the first lifting assembly is connected with the bottom side of the lifting section; a buffering assembly is arranged at the top end of the first lifting assembly and comprises a buffering base plate, a buffering base part is arranged on the buffering base plate and comprises a buffering shell, a buffering base body is coaxially arranged in the buffering shell, a first elastic assembly is coaxially arranged in the buffering shell, and the first elastic assembly and the buffering base body are arranged in a matched mode. A second elastic assembly surrounds the buffering base body, the other end of the second elastic assembly is connected with the buffering shell, and a flexible buffering plate is arranged on the side, away from the first elastic assembly, of the buffering base body. The invention aims to provide the fishery catch transportation device which can measure the weight of fishery catches and is good in transportation effect.
CN117819156.assignee: ZHEJIANG DAYANG BIHAI PLANNING AND DESIGN CO LTD

CN117761670.title: Hydroacoustics and catch combined fish resource quantity grading quantitative evaluation method
CN117761670.abstract: The invention discloses a hydroacoustics and catches combined fish resource quantity grading quantitative evaluation method. The method comprises the following steps: setting a hydroacoustics underway route according to characteristics of an investigated water area; underway is carried out according to the hydroacoustic underway route, and hydroacoustic signal data and position information are collected by using an echo detector during underway; preprocessing the hydroacoustic signal data by adopting a cross filtering method to obtain preprocessed hydroacoustic signal data; setting a catch sampling point according to the characteristics of the investigated water area, and investigating catches at the position of the catch sampling point to obtain a catch investigation result; grouping the fishes based on the survey result of the catches, and counting the number of echo signals of the fishes in different groups by using the hydroacoustic signal data to obtain an acoustic signal data set; carrying out statistical analysis on the acoustic signal data set by adopting an echo integral method, and estimating signal densities and mantissas of fishes in different groups; and calculating the fish resource quantity based on the catch survey result and the fish mantissa.
CN117761670.assignee: YANGTZE RIVER FISHERIES RES INST CAFS

CA3246534.title: COMPOSITION ET PROCÉDÉ D'APPLICATION DE CELLE-CI POUR AUGMENTER LA SURVIE D'UN POISSON APRÈS DES SITUATIONS DE PÊCHER - RELÂCHER
CA3246534.abstract: The invention relates to a composition and method to increase survival of fish following catch-and-release events. The composition comprises an energy substrate and a hydrocolloid. The composition may comprise an application-safe buffer. The energy substrate may be a glycolysis metabolite, a Krebs cycle metabolite, an amino acid, a nitric oxide donor, a triglyceride, and mixtures thereof. The hydrocolloid may be a polysaccharide. The composition may include an oxygenated substrate, a trophic hormone, a stress reducing additive, a chelating agent, an antimicrobial preservative, and a color additive, and mixtures thereof. The method comprises after catching the fish, applying the composition to the fish and releasing the fish back into the wild. The composition may alternatively be mixed with a flotant or a cured polymer in the shape of a lure such that composition may be dispersed onto the oxygen exchange tissue of the fish when it is caught.

CN116671546.title: Fish catch sorting method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
CN116671546.abstract: According to the fishery catch sorting method provided by the embodiment of the invention, integrity identification is performed on fish bodies on a sorting line in a first sorting mode to obtain a first fish body integrity identification result, the first sorting mode corresponds to a first integrity curve, and the first sorting mode performs sorting based on the first fish body integrity identification result; if the first fish body integrity identification result in the first preset time does not comply with the first integrity curve, determining a second integrity curve according to the first fish body integrity identification result in the first preset time; and a second sorting mode is determined according to the second integrity curve, integrity recognition is conducted on the fish bodies on the sorting line in the second sorting mode, a second fish body integrity recognition result is obtained, and sorting is conducted based on the second fish body integrity recognition result in the second sorting mode. According to the method, the fish bodies on the sorting line are subjected to integrity identification, sorting is carried out according to the integrity identification result, the integrity of the fish does not need to be evaluated manually, and the sorting efficiency can be improved.

KR20230126986.title: Selection system by size and type of mixed catch fish
KR20230126986.abstract: A selection system by size and type of bycatch, according to an embodiment of the present invention, may comprise: an earlier fish type selection unit which selects fish of a preset first size or more among caught fish to transfer the same to the outside, and selects fish under the first size to transfer the same; an earlier size selection unit which is connected to the earlier fish type selection unit and selects fish transferred from the earlier fish type selection unit by size; a main fish type selection unit which is connected to the earlier size selection unit and selects a main fish type among fish classified as the largest volume and transferred from the earlier size selection unit; and a main fish type size selection unit which is connected to the main fish type selection unit and selects the main fish type selected by the main fish type selection unit by size again. According to the present invention, the selection system can improve the accuracy and efficiency of the selection work of bycatch.

CN115953632.title: Fish catch identifying and recording device
CN115953632.abstract: The invention discloses a catch identification and input device, and relates to the technical field of catches. The catch identifying and recording device comprises an FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) chip and a camera connected with the FPGA chip, the camera is used for shooting catches to obtain a to-be-recognized image; and the FPGA chip is used for acquiring the to-be-identified image, inputting the to-be-identified image into the trained Yolo network model, obtaining the types of all catches in the to-be-identified image, and storing the types. On the basis of ensuring the catch identification precision and the processing speed, the cost of the system can be reduced, and the operation stability of the system can be improved.
CN115953632.assignee: FISHERY MACHINERY & INSTRUMENT RES INST CAFS

CN115843760.title: Fish catch storage fishing box capable of automatically and circularly changing water
CN115843760.abstract: The invention discloses a fishery catch storage fishing box capable of changing water automatically and circularly, which comprises a water storage tank, a neck bush is fixedly mounted on the end face of one side of the water storage tank, the side wall of the neck bush is sleeved with a movable box in an attached manner to form a volume adjusting structure, and the end face of the movable box is attached to the side wall of the water storage tank; the upper face and the lower face of the moving box are flush with the corresponding faces of the water storage tank, first guide blocks which are symmetrically distributed are fixedly installed on the inner wall of the moving box, and the two first guide blocks are embedded in guide grooves formed in the side wall of the neck bush to form a sliding limiting structure. According to the catch storage fishing box capable of automatically and circularly changing water, a catch and water rapid separation structure is arranged in the catch storage fishing box, the convenience of the device is improved, the water in the device can be automatically changed, the water fluidity is better, the activity of catch can be kept for a long time, and the size of the internal containing space can be freely adjusted according to the requirements of a user.

CN115739671.title: Fish catch sorting system and method
CN115739671.abstract: The fishery catch sorting system is characterized in that the fishery catch sorting system comprises a fishery catch recognition device, a type sorting device and a fishery catch storage device; the type sorting device is used for sorting the catches to the first conveying devices corresponding to the types according to the identification result; the received catches are conveyed to a weight sorting device through a first conveying device, the conveyed catches are weighed through a weighing device arranged on the first conveying device, and a weighing result is sent to the weight sorting device; and the weight sorting device is used for sorting the catches to the catches storage device corresponding to the weight range according to the weighing result. According to the technical scheme, the manual sorting cost is effectively reduced, and the sorting efficiency is improved.
CN115739671.assignee: FISHERY ENG INST OF CHINESE ACADEMY OF FISHERY SCIENCES

CN115574903.title: Fish catch weighing and measuring system and weighing and measuring method thereof
CN115574903.abstract: The invention provides a fishery catch weighing and measuring system and a weighing and measuring method thereof.The fishery catch weighing and measuring system comprises a lifting device, an electronic scale driven by the lifting device to move vertically and a transparent weighing and measuring groove obliquely supported through a fixed supporting plate at the top of the lifting device, and a temporary culture pond is arranged below the bottom end of the weighing and measuring groove in the inclined state; the top and the two ends of the weighing and measuring groove are open, a left baffle and a right baffle with the edges attached to the inner wall of the weighing and measuring groove are axially arranged in the weighing and measuring groove in a sliding mode, and openings allowing the left baffle and the right baffle to move out of the weighing and measuring groove are formed in the two ends of the weighing and measuring groove respectively. A left background plate and a right background plate which are provided with length scales are arranged on the opposite side walls of the left baffle and the right baffle respectively, the left background plate and the right background plate are arranged in a staggered mode, and a mounting base used for weighing is arranged at the top of the electronic scale. According to the invention, the service life of the electronic scale is prolonged, the pulling strength of workers is reduced, and fishes are prevented from death after leaving water for a long time.
CN115574903.assignee: THREE GORGES MAT TENDERING MANAGEMENT CO LTD

JP2023001841.title: UNIVERSAL CROSS FISHING TACKLE FOR BIG CATCH (100 TIMES MORE FUN BY CATCHING 10 TIMES MORE FISH)
JP2023001841.abstract: To provide a universal fishing tackle having high functionality, being efficient, having a high possibility of catching fish and allowing a user to have fun by effectively utilizing an eco-friendly cross wooden ball and accommodating to fishing tackles for wide variety of target fish species using a Sabiki fishing rib.SOLUTION: Rigid vinyl pipes are inserted into four through-hole parts of a cross wooden ball to a central part of the wooden ball, projected to an outside of the wooden ball and fixed. Two Sabiki rib leaders are respectively diagonally and alternately passed through the rigid vinyl pipes, projected to the outside of the rigid vinyl pipes, with upper Sabiki rib leaders projected short and lower Sabiki rib leaders projected long, adjusted to the lengths so as to retain a horizontal floating state, held the balance and intervals so as not to entangle the left/right and fixed, with the Sabiki ribs lined upward. Bait is put on the upper Sabiki ribs and the lower Sabiki ribs are set free. Alternatively, the bait may be put on four portions so as to hide a fishing tackle. A fishing line attachment link is attached to an upper part of the cross wooden ball and a multi-functional attachment link is attached to the lower part of the wooden ball.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

JP2022115252.title: FISH-CATCH PREDICTION GENERATION DEVICE, INFORMATION PRESENTATION TERMINAL, FISH-CATCH PREDICTION SYSTEM, AND FISH-CATCH PREDICTION GENERATION PROGRAM BASED ON CONTINUOUS DATA COLLECTION
JP2022115252.abstract: To provide a catch prediction generation device, an information presentation terminal, a catch prediction system, and a catch prediction generation program that can generate prediction information that leads to a fish-catch regardless of a level of experience and presence or absence of intuition of an angler while continuously collecting information on actual good or poor fish-catch from a user, and displaying a level of contribution to the user to improve motivation thereof to provide data.SOLUTION: A catch prediction generation device 100 includes: an environment information reception unit 10 that receives environmental information in a fishing spot where an aquatic organism that can be caught live in water; a fish-catch information reception unit 20 that receives actual fish-catch information from a user at a fishing spot; a reliability determination unit 30 that compares environment information at the fishing spot and the actual fish-catch information, and determines reliability of the actual fish-catch information; and a fish-catch prediction information generation unit 40 that generates fish-catch prediction information based on the reliable data at the a fishing spot on the basis of a determination result of the reliability determination unit 30.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

JP2022037953.title: FISH CATCH UNLOADING APPARATUS
JP2022037953.abstract: To provide a fish catch unloading apparatus capable of being utilized in a space-saving manner and capable of efficiently unloading fish catch while constantly checking the fish catch stored in a fishery warehouse.SOLUTION: A fish catch unloading apparatus 10 includes a frame 12 that is installed near a fishery warehouse opening during unloading, and an operation arm part 14 that has a support part for supporting a handle part 108 of a landing net 106 at its tip, the base end of which is oscillatably supported by the frame 12 and which can be tilted to the opposite side of the fishery warehouse 112 during the unloading.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

CN113973785.title: Fish catch transfer system
CN113973785.abstract: A fishery catch transfer system comprises a control cabinet and a vacuum fish suction pump, the vacuum fish suction pump is connected with a plurality of vacuum cylinders through vacuumizing pipelines, one end of each vacuum cylinder is connected with a farm through a fish suction pipeline, and the other end of each vacuum cylinder is connected with a cargo hold through a fish discharging pipeline; a vacuumizing valve is arranged on a vacuumizing pipeline connected between the vacuum fish suction pump and the vacuum cylinder; a fish suction valve is arranged on the fish suction pipeline connected between the farm and the vacuum cylinder; a fish discharging valve is arranged on the fish discharging pipeline connected between the cargo hold and the vacuum cylinder; a pressure and liquid level sensor is arranged in the vacuum cylinder; the control cabinet is electrically connected with the vacuum fish suction pump, the vacuumizing valve, the fish suction valve, the fish discharge valve and the pressure and liquid level sensor. The control cabinet monitors the pressure and the liquid level in the multiple vacuum cylinders in real time so as to control work of the vacuum fish suction pump, all the valves and other components, and the fish suction action is kept continuous.
CN113973785.assignee: JIUJIANG PRECISION MEASURING TECH RES INST

WO2021199624.title: SYSTÈME D'ASSISTANCE À LA CRÉATION D'UN RAPPORT D'ENREGISTREMENT DE CAPTURE DE POISSONS, DISPOSITIF DE TERMINAL D'ASSISTANCE À LA CRÉATION D'UN RAPPORT D'ENREGISTREMENT DE CAPTURE DE POISSONS, ET PROGRAMME D'ASSISTANCE À LA CRÉATION D'UN RAPPORT D'ENREGISTREMENT DE CAPTURE DE POISSONS
WO2021199624.abstract: Provided are a system for assistance in creating a fish catch record report, a terminal device for assistance in creating a fish catch record report, and a program for assistance in creating a fish catch record report that provide assistance in creating a fish catch record report so that even a small-scale fishery operator can easily create a fish catch record report. According to a system 10 for assistance in creating a fish catch record report, when a terminal device 20 for assistance in creating a fish catch record report is incapable of transmission to a server 30 for assistance in creating a fish catch record report via a relay station R of a cellular company, the terminal device 20 for assistance in creating a fish catch record report stores positional information and start date information in a storage means 27 and waits. Then, in response to establishing communication with the relay station R, the terminal device 20 for assistance in creating a fish catch record report transmits the positional information and the start date information to the server 30 for assistance in creating a fish catch record report. Therefore, even when working at sea, the fishery operator can transmit the positional information and the start date information to the server 30 for creation assistance upon communication recovery.

KR20210070495.title: Giveaway arcade game device to harpoon catch fish on the screen
KR20210070495.abstract: The present invention relates to a giveaway arcade game device for catching a fish by a harpoon on a screen, which comprises: a display device (10) which displays an under-the-sea background where sea creatures and a diver with a harpoon swim on the screen; a diver control device (20) which controls the swimming direction of the diver; a launch device (30) which launches the harpoon toward the swimming sea creatures; a giveaway provision device (40) which provides a giveaway when a gamer controls the diver control device (20) and the launch device (30) and hits a sea creature; and a control unit (100). The present invention is able to allow a user to directly use a button or lever, allow the user to let the diver with the harpoon on a fishing ship floating on the sea on the screen hit a fish which jumps over the sea surface by launching the harpoon, provide a score and a giveaway to the user, increase the interest in the game, and improve concentration.

WO2021065850.title: DISPOSITIF DE GESTION DE VOLUME DE PRISE DE POISSONS ET PROGRAMME DE GESTION DE VOLUME DE PRISE DE POISSONS
WO2021065850.abstract: Provided are a fish catch volume management device and a fish catch volume management program with which it is possible to contribute to the conservation of fishery resources by enabling an exact fish catch volume to be reported, even when the operation of a fisherman for one day extends over a plurality of fishery zones. The fish catch volume management device first acquires, for each operation in the same operation day, a fishery zone in which the operation is performed, the fish catch ratio of fish species caught by the operation, and a total number of boxes indicating the fish catch volume of all fish species. Next, the fish catch volume management device computes, for each fishery zone on the basis of the total box number and fish catch ratio per fish species in the same operation day shown in steps S10 and S20, the weight per fish specifies indicating the fish catch volume per fish species shown in step S50 from the weight per fish specifies indicating a fish catch volume per fish species in the same operation day written in an itemized invoice from a production market shown in step S30.

KR20200024622.title: A tool to selectively catch fish
KR20200024622.abstract: The purpose of the present invention is to expand the size of an entrance of a main body to the same or similar size as a main body to expand the size of a captured fish relatively compared to the size of a conventional cone-shaped fish tank, thereby improving amusement, and to form a closing means, a photographing means, and a control means on the main body to selectively select a fish captured inside the main body from the outside, thereby capturing a desired fish. To this end, a fish tank for luring and capturing fish by hanging or fixing bait on one side of a main body, and then immersing the main body in water, comprises: a main body (10) consisting of at least one entrance (12), an opening/closing door (14) for opening/closing the entrance (12), and a returning spring (16) for providing an elastic force to the opening/closing door (14), wherein the entrance (12) of the main body (10) is formed to have the same or similar size as the size of one side surface of the main body (10); an opening/closing means (20) for selectively closing the entrance (12) through the opening/closing door (14) by providing a control force to the opening/closing door (14) on one side of the main body (10); a photographing means (30) formed on one side of the main body to photograph a fish lured and introduced into the main body (10); and a control means (40) for receiving an image photographed through the photographing means (30) and providing a closing signal to the opening/closing means (20) to selectively control capture of a fish in the main body (10).

CN110367212.title: Fish catch net hauling machine of large fishery and net hauling method thereof
CN110367212.abstract: The invention discloses a fish catch net hauling machine of a large fishery and a net hauling method thereof. The fish catch net hauling machine comprises a cylindrical shell, a plurality of strip-shaped grooves in parallel distribution are formed in the side face of the shell, a roller is mounted inside the shell, an input shaft and an end shaft are arranged at two ends of the roller respectively, and a plurality of hook claw groups equal to the strip-shaped grooves in quantity are arranged on the side face of the roller; each convex tooth group comprises multiple convex teeth uniformly distributed in a circumferential direction of the side face of the roller, the roller is arranged eccentrically relative to the shell, in other words, a central line of the roller is parallel to that of the shell, and a distance between the roller and shell is eccentric distance h, so that the convex teeth of each convex tooth group are enabled to extends outwards periodically along the corresponding strip-shaped groove when the roller rotates; the net hauling machine further comprises a connection support fixedly connected on the shell and a driving mechanism providing power to the roller. The nethauling machine can be used independently and is easy-to-control in net hauling position and high in net hauling efficiency.
CN110367212.assignee: SOUTH CHINA SEA FISHERIES RES INST CHINESE ACAD FISHERY SCIENCES

CN109436750.title: Shore-based fish catch conveying device
CN109436750.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of conveying devices, in particular to a shore-based fish catch conveying device. The shore-based fish catch conveying device comprises a mounting frame, an inlet conveying belt, a transition conveying belt, a labeling conveying belt and an outlet conveying belt, wherein a limited guardrail in the length direction of a bearing plate is arranged on one side of the top ends of the transition conveying belt and the labeling conveying belt, and overturning devices for saving space are separately arranged at the bottom ends of the inlet conveying belt and the outlet conveying belt. According to the shore-based fish catch conveying device, fish plates are turned over on the inlet conveying belt and conveyed towards the transition conveying belt firstly; the fish plates are guided by a guiding device and the limited guardrail when the fish plates pass through the inlet conveying belt and the transition conveying belt to facilitate labeling work; and the speed of the inlet conveying belt and the transition conveying belt is lower than that of the labeling conveying belt and the outlet conveying belt, interval between the fish plates is automatically pulled to a proper distance through the speed difference, and the reason for pulling the distance is that two fish plates are not squeezed together during labeling.

CN109398858.title: Smart shore-based fish catch labelling machine
CN109398858.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of labelling machines, in particular to a smart shore-based fish catch labelling machine, comprising a base, a control device, a fish dish position sensor,a granulated slag impurity cleaning device, a label printing and transferring device, a labelling device and a label pressing device, wherein the control device, the fish dish position sensor, the granulated slag impurity cleaning device, the label printing and transferring device, the labelling device and the label pressing device are fixedly mounted on the base; the control device comprises anindustrial computer and PLC; working ends of the granulated slag impurity cleaning device, the labelling device and the label pressing device all face one side of the base, and are arranged from one end of the base to the other end of the base sequentially; the label printing and transferring device is arranged beside the labelling device; the fish dish position sensor, the granulated slag impurity cleaning device, the label printing and transferring device and the labelling device are in electric connection with the control device. Granulated slag impurity on the side of the fish dish can becleaned before labelling of the labelling machine, and the labelling machine is adaptable to fish dishes having different width and radian.

CN109278946.title: Fish-catch collecting operation boat for aquaculture
CN109278946.abstract: The invention provides a fish-catch collecting operation boat for aquaculture, and belongs to the technical field of boats. The technical problem that freshness of fish-catch is hard to guarantee by an existing fish-catch collecting operation boat is solved. The fish-catch collecting operation boat comprises a fish sucking pipe, a vacuum fish sucking tank and an insulation box. The vacuum fish sucking tank is arranged on the fish sucking pipe, the outer end of the fish sucking pipe can extend out of the operation boat, and the inner end of the fish sucking pipe can be connected with the insulation box. The operation boat further comprises an ice slurry storage bucket which communicates with the insulation box. According to the fish-catch collecting operation boat, ice slurry and fish-catchare mixed to achieve the good freshness keeping effect, and the fish-catch collecting operation boat is high in operation automation degree and can reduce manual operation and greatly improve work efficiency.

US20260321364.title: EXPLAINABLE MACHINE LEARNING SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR DATA DISCOVERY AND INSIGHT GENERATION
US20260321364.abstract: [0000]    An example method comprises receiving multimodal analysis data including chemical data and sensory data, generating an n-dimensional feature space representation of the multimodal analysis data, projecting the feature space into a manifold embedding using a similarity metric, performing recursive hierarchical decomposition of the manifold embedding using non-overlapping coverings to generate a connected-component network including branch points, performing a local transform operation for leaf nodes of the connected-component network to generate local object embeddings, computing co-enrichment scores between features of different modalities based on co-localization within the local object embeddings, generating a unified multimodal representation based on the co-enrichment scores, and generating a visualization of the unified multimodal representation, the visualization including nodes and relationships representing correlations between the modalities.

WO2026212602.title: SYSTÈME DE RÉPONSE GÉNÉRATIVE EXPLICABLE AVEC MODULE INTERACTIF VISUEL
WO2026212602.abstract: Apparatus and associated methods relate to automatically generate an artificial intelligence generative response based on a visualized and transparent decision model. In an illustrative example, in response to receiving a user input signal comprising a user prompt for a generative response, dynamically generate an artificial intelligence (Al) generative response based on the user input signal. For example, a transparent decision manifest may be generated to interactively and visually display decision relevant information associated with user-configurable decision parameters and receive a decision-related input. Based on the decision-related input received from the transparent decision manifest, an updated transparent decision manifest and an updated artificial intelligence generative response corresponding to the updated transparent decision manifest may be generated. Various embodiments may advantageously provide explainable and personalized iterative user-AI interactions with a dynamically visualized multidimensional decision space.

US20260311269.title: Adaptive Preference Engine with Soft-Ranking and Explainable AI for Travel Recommendations
US20260311269.abstract: [0000]    The present invention relates to a travel planning system and method that enables users to customize trip recommendations through real-time, soft-ranking of personal preferences and dynamically generated explanations. Unlike traditional itinerary generators that rely on fixed parameters or opaque algorithms, this system allows travelers to indicate relative importance for various factors such as budget, luxury, pace, interest type, and proximity via an interactive user interface. An adaptive AI engine ingests the soft-ranked preference weights and applies them to a dynamic scoring matrix that generates a prioritized set of recommended options across accommodations, activities, dining, and transit. Each recommendation is accompanied by a transparent, real-time explanation that clarifies why it was selected, referencing the user's weighting decisions and the trade-offs made. This invention improves traveler trust, decision-making clarity, and itinerary satisfaction by enabling nuanced control over preferences and making AI decision logic fully visible to the user.

US20260301007.title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR GENERATING EXPLAINABLE TASK-BASED OPTIMIZATION
US20260301007.abstract: [0000]    The present disclosure relates to a method for explainable task-based optimization. The method includes receiving a target decision variable that is of interest to the user and an auxiliary dataset associated with a decision-making problem. Further, the method includes generating a prediction of the target decision variable using a forecasting machine learning (ML) model. Furthermore, the method includes determining an optimal decision variable for the decision-making problem with uncertain parameters and variables. Furthermore, the method includes executing the optimal decision variable and determining an actual cost outcome. Furthermore, the method includes updating the forecasting ML model using a rolling window technique based on the actual cost outcomes. Furthermore, the method includes evaluating the actual cost outcome of an executed decision based on comparing with the optimal performance and updating optimization parameters based on the actual cost outcome to refine the forecasting ML model.

US20260300533.title: ADAPTIVE NEURO-SYMBOLIC CONTEXT FABRIC FOR EXPLAINABLE INTEGRITY IN AI-AGENTIC ENTERPRISE DATA OPERATIONS
US20260300533.abstract: A computer-implemented system and method providing a four-term Graph-Enhanced Semantic Density Scoring (G-SDS) formula for reducing LLM context window consumption by 60-80% in enterprise master data management (MDM) operations, combined with a SPDZ-protocol federated secure multi-party computation (SMPC) mechanism for binary compliance-vote aggregation across distributed MDM silos, wherein individual silo veto votes remain cryptographically hidden under zero-knowledge proof guarantees while the global veto/approve decision is revealed. The system further comprises a Logical Neural Network (LNN) with AND/OR/NOT/IMPLIES/EQUIV gate neurons maintaining real-valued truth bounds [L, U], integrated with a PPO reinforcement learning policy network that dynamically adapts soft-constraint thresholds to minimize false-positive vetoes. A hard symbolic veto gate permanently blocks any transaction violating governance constraints.

US20260301014.title: REAL-TIME DATA QUALITY ASSURANCE BY INTEGRATING AI-DRIVEN ANOMALY DETECTION, EXPLAINABLE AI, AND AUTOMATED ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS FOR SUPERIOR DATA QUALITY IN THE ETL PIPELINES
US20260301014.abstract: Methods, system, and non-transitory processor-readable storage medium for an ETL anomaly detection system are provided herein. An example method includes receiving, by an Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) anomaly detection system, source data for processing through an ETL pipeline. The ETL anomaly detection system detects anomalies in the source data using a trained machine learning model. The ETL anomaly detection system analyzes the detected anomalies using Shapley Additive Explanations (SHAP) values to determine contributing factors to the anomalies. The ETL anomaly detection system validates quality of the source data based on the detected anomalies and SHAP analysis. The ETL anomaly detection system loads validated data into a target system while maintaining application continuity.

WO2026194493.title: PROCÉDÉ ET SYSTÈME EXPLICABLES POUR LA MISE EN CORRESPONDANCE D'IMAGES BIOMÉTRIQUES
WO2026194493.abstract: There is provided a method and system of identifying a subject. A probe image is generated by extracting a region from an image depicting a physical trait in an anatomical region of a subject. A target image is generated by extracting a region from an image selected from a library comprising stored images of the same anatomical region of a plurality of subjects. The similarity or otherwise of a probe derived from the probe image and a target derived from the target image using one or more trained neural networks is determined. The likelihood of a match between the probe image from which said probe is generated and the selected stored image from which said target is generated is evaluated.

WO2026192211.title: SYSTÈME DE CLASSIFICATION D'HYPERTENSION ET DE MESURE DE PRESSION ARTÉRIELLE UTILISANT UNE IA EXPLICABLE ET UN APPRENTISSAGE AUTOMATIQUE, ET SON PROCÉDÉ D'UTILISATION
WO2026192211.abstract: Proposed in the present invention are a hypertension classification and blood pressure measurement system using explainable AI and machine learning, and a method for using same, the system comprising: a data pre-processing unit that performs data analysis on data collected for hypertension classification and blood pressure measurement by random sampling; a hypertension classification unit that performs learning by dividing pre-processed data, on which the data analysis has been performed through the data pre-processing unit, into normal blood pressure and hypertension; and a blood pressure prediction unit that calculates importance with SHapley Additive exPlanation (SHAP) learned through the hypertension classification unit, and predicts blood pressure according to the importance. Accordingly, it is possible to check a change in blood pressure value corresponding to a change in waistline of a healthy woman after menopause, and manage and predict blood pressure of a menopausal woman according to the change in blood pressure value.

수집된 데이터는 폐경기 이후 여성의 고혈압의 유병률에 따른 고혈압을 분류하고 예측하기 위해 BP(저혈압 제외)를 제외한 건강한 55-79세의 여성을 대상으로 하는 것을 특징으로 하는, 설명 가능한 AI와 머신 러닝을 활용한 고혈압 분류 및 혈압 측정 시스템의 이용 방법.
12. 제9항 내지 제11항 중 어느 한 항에 있어서, 상기 데이터 전처리부(110)는,
수집된 대상자의 데이터를 정상 혈압과, 고혈압으로 분류하고, 무작위 표본 추출의 수행으로 분석하되, 피어슨 상관계수(Pearson correlation coefficient) 분석을 수행하는 것을 특징으로 하는, 설명 가능한 AI와 머신 러닝을 활용한 고혈압 분류 및 혈압 측정 시스템의 이용 방법.
13. 제12항에 있어서, 상기 데이터 전처리부(110)는,
고혈압 분류 및 혈압 측정을 위한 알고리즘의 강화를 위해, 5-겹 교차 검증(5-fold cross-validation)과, 모델 매개변수 최적화(optimizing model parameters)를 수행하는 것을 특징으로 하는, 설명 가능한 AI와 머신 러닝을 활용한 고혈압 분류 및 혈압 측정 시스템의 이용 방법.
14. 제13항에 있어서, 상기 고혈압 분류부(120)는,
상기 데이터 전처리부(110)를 통해 데이터 분석이 수행된 전처리 데이터를 정상 혈압과 고혈압으로 나누어서 학습을 수행하되, 정상 혈압과 고혈압을 나누어서 XGBoost(eXtreme Gradient Boosting), SVM(Support Vector Machine), ANN(Artificial Neural Network)을 수행하는 것을 특징으로 하는, 설명 가능한 AI와 머신 러닝을 활용한 고혈압 분류 및 혈압 측정 시스템의 이용 방법.
15. 제13항에 있어서, 상기 혈압 예측부(130)는,
상기 고혈압 분류부(120)를 통해 학습된 SHAP(SHapley Additive exPlanation)로 중요도를 계산하여 SHAP로 계산된 중요도를 시각화로 해석하여 나이(Age)와 허리둘레(Waist Circumference)에 따른 혈압 수치 변화를 보여주는 것을 특징으로 하는, 설명 가능한 AI와 머신 러닝을 활용한 고혈압 분류 및 혈압 측정 시스템의 이용 방법.
16. 제15항에 있어서, 상기 혈압 예측부(130)는,
XGBoost를 활용한 알고리즘으로 구현되어, 건강한 여성의 폐경기 이후 허리둘레의 변화에 따라 변하는 혈압 수치로 폐경기 여성의 능동적 혈압 관리가 가능하도록 기능하는 것을 특징으로 하는, 설명 가능한 AI와 머신 러닝을 활용한 고혈압 분류 및 혈압 측정 시스템의 이용 방법.

WO2026188576.title: PROCÉDÉ ET SYSTÈME DE CONSTRUCTION D'UN MODÈLE DE PRÉDICTION DE PRONOSTIC DE CANCER COLORECTAL EXPLICABLE MULTIMODAL
WO2026188576.abstract: The present application relates to the technical field of rectal cancer prediction, and discloses a method and system for constructing a multi-modal explainable colorectal cancer prognosis prediction model. The method comprises: acquiring gene expression data and a digital pathology image of colorectal cancer; using a class association embedding method to process the digital pathology image to extract a class association encoding of the image; fusing the class association encoding of the image with an encoding of the gene expression data to obtain a fused encoding; training a multi-modal model on the basis of the fused encoding, performing classification prediction after training, and using an explainability analysis method to explain the classification prediction result, so as to obtain a target multi-modal explainable colorectal cancer prognosis prediction model. By constructing a multi-modal explainable artificial intelligence model and fusing tertiary lymphoid structure-related RNA-seq gene expression data and digital pathology images, classification accuracy is improved, and genes significantly associated with colorectal cancer prognosis and treatment response are identified.

构建包含重建损失、对抗损失和分类损失的损失函数，通过损失函数训练和更新编码器和解码器，使得类关联嵌入框架能够提取图像的类关联编码。 4. 根据权利要求1所述的一种多模态可解释结直肠癌后预测模型构建方法，其特征在于，所述将影像的类关联编码与基因表达数据的编码进行融合得到融合编码，包括：

并结合基因编码信息，识别出与结直肠癌预后和治疗反应显著相关的基因。 7. 根据权利要求1所述的一种多模态可解释结直肠癌后预测模型构建方法，其特征在于，所述基于所述融合编码对多模态模型进行训练中还包括：

US20260257350.title: DEEP DYNAMIC GRAPH NEURAL NETWORKS FOR EXPLAINABLE INTENTION ESTIMATION
US20260257350.abstract: [0000]    A method for intention estimation in robot teleoperation tasks is provided. The method may generate dynamic graphs that show spatial relationships over time to predict user intentions for short-horizontal actions and long-horizon tasks.

US20260252695.title: EXPLAINABLE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE SYSTEM FOR DETECTING MALICIOUS MEMORY
US20260252695.abstract: [0000]    A method includes weighing a feature based on their relevance. The method includes analyzing, by the computing device, the feature. The analyzing includes using decision trees for classification. The decision trees classify one or more processes as being malicious and conducting counterfactual analysis. The method includes determining whether the feature is malicious.

US20260245095.title: EXPLAINABLE FRAUD DECISIONING SYSTEM LEVERAGING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS ("LLMS") AND INTERPRETABLE NEURAL NETWORKS ("INNS")
US20260245095.abstract: [0000]    Methods may provide explainable fraud decisioning and fraud alerting to multiple entities within a distributed ledger environment. Methods may monitor transactions on a DeFi network involving multiple entities, use transaction flag metadata while a transaction is hopping across multiple entities and derive an end-to-end contextual heatmap of a transaction leveraging artificial intelligence (“AI”). Methods may identify transaction metadata within the transactions. Methods may generate, by an INN operating with an LLM, a fraud decision and explanation for the transaction. Methods may propagate the fraud decision to the plurality of entities within the distributed ledger environment. Methods may receive an acceptance or rejection of the fraud decision from each entity. The acceptance or rejection may be based on rules specific to the entity. Methods may auto-decision the transaction based on majority consensus received from the plurality of entities.

CN122595282.title: Explainable Pincare smart contract detection method
CN122595282.abstract: The invention belongs to the field of blockchain smart contract security, and relates to an interpretable Pincare smart contract detection method. The method aims at solving the problems of low detection accuracy and poor interpretability caused by the fact that an existing method is weak in model black box and code obfuscation resistance. According to the scheme, the method comprises the steps that contract embedding is pre-trained and learned through comparative learning clustering, an input code sequence is enhanced to generate a view, the view is converted into a code graph composed of an abstract syntax tree and a data flow graph, GraphCodeBERT is used for extracting features, and contract representation with compact semantics and discrimination is obtained based on K-means clustering center adjustment; training a classifier by using marked data, and inputting the representation into a Transform architecture to output a classification probability; training an interpreter, applying controllable disturbance by disturbing the input code graph, observing the change of the result, and identifying a set of key minimum code lines affecting prediction to generate decision interpretation; and detecting the smart contract based on the training model, and outputting a Pincare or non-Pincare classification result and a corresponding interpretability description.

US12711759.title: Explainable squeeze-excitation multi-scale fusion network system and method for aerial scene and coastal area recognition using remote sensing images
US12711759.abstract: [0000]    A method, and a system for automatic classification of land use and land cover includes capturing remote sensing (RS) images by a sensor on an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). The method includes transmitting the RS images by UAV communication circuitry. The method includes receiving the RS images by server communication circuitry and storing the RS images in memory. The method includes iteratively training, by a machine learning engine, a deep learning network that integrates an input layer, at least one residual block, inception blocks, bottleneck blocks and inverted bottleneck blocks, dense blocks, and at least one squeeze-excitation block. The method includes inputting the RS images, preventing a training gradient from vanishing, extracting features at multiple scales, balancing computational cost, and promoting reuse of the extracted features. The method includes determining, by a softmax layer, at least one class label and a respective confidence score.

CN122570980.title: Sewage COD (Chemical Oxygen Demand) prediction method of explainable neural network based on causal decomposition
CN122570980.abstract: The invention discloses a sewage COD prediction method of an interpretable neural network based on causal decomposition, and belongs to the technical field of sewage treatment and machine learning. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, collecting and pre-treating sewage quality data, and screening water quality characteristics related to effluent COD (Chemical Oxygen Demand); then, executing cause and effect synergy-uniqueness-redundancy decomposition SURD, decomposing the information entropy of the target variable COD into mutual information and conditional entropy, and determining a unique variable set and a synergy variable combination set through feature subset mutual information sorting and incremental distribution; and finally, constructing a collaborative-unique-redundant neural network SURNN, constructing a binary collaborative layer based on collaborative variable combination, constructing a sparse layer according to a variable inclusion relation, splicing the output of the sparse layer and unique variables, accessing the spliced sparse layer and unique variables into a full connection layer, and outputting a COD predicted value. According to the method, causal logic is embedded from a network construction stage, a model decision path can be directly explained, the prediction precision is high, the generalization performance is high, and the method can be deployed in a sewage treatment plant to realize real-time and reliable COD prediction.

US20260236771.title: EXPLAINABLE GRAPH NEURAL NETWORK
US20260236771.abstract: An explainable graph neural network is disclosed. A recommendation system generates a recommendation by using a trained heterogenous graph neural network. A recommendation explainer may generate an explanation for the recommendation. To do so, the recommendation explainer may perturb features of a node of a heterogenous interaction graph. Further, the recommendation explainer may perturb a structure of the heterogenous interaction graph.

US20260236807.title: EXPLAINABLE PREDICTION SYSTEM WITH CATEGORICAL EXPLANATION GENERATION
US20260236807.abstract: [0000]    A method for generating explanations for an outcome probability metric, comprising: maintaining a data record comprising a plurality of data entries; training a regression tree for each segment of plurality of segments to model a segment baseline score as a function of spitters features, wherein the segment baseline score is indicative of an expected baseline contribution to a data entry's outcome probability metric based on the associated segment membership; and generating segment explanations for each of the data entries via the trained regression tree, wherein the segment explanations provide the contribution of splitter features to the segment baseline score assignment for the particular data entry, wherein the segment explanations vary across data entries within a segment.

US20260228644.title: MULTI-SOURCE DATA AND EXPLAINABLE MACHINE LEARNING SYSTEMS AND METHODS
US20260228644.abstract: [0000]    In some implementations, the techniques described herein relate to a method including: receiving data from a plurality of heterogeneous data sources; processing each type of received data through a corresponding type-specific processing pipeline by performing temporal pattern extraction specific to each data type; generating cross-source feature vectors by performing temporal correlation analysis across the processed data from different data sources; training an ensemble machine learning model using the cross-source feature vectors; generating engagement predictions and feature contribution values that quantify an impact of each feature on each prediction; presenting the engagement predictions with natural language explanations based on the feature contribution values; and updating weights of the ensemble machine learning model based on user feedback regarding the natural language explanations.

US20260230843.title: METHODS AND APPARATUSES FOR EXPLAINABLE AI-BASED NETWORK-CONTROLLED SYSTEM OPTIMIZATION
US20260230843.abstract: [0000]    A wireless transmit/receive unit (WTRU) may be configured to determine one or more explainability artificial intelligence (XAI) capabilities of the WTRU. The WTRU may receive XAI configuration information from a network that indicates one or more of an explainability mode, an explainability domain type, a configuration of XAI outcome storage, one or more triggers associated with an XAI report, or an XAI report configuration. The WTRU may determine one or more XAI parameters associated with an XAI model. The one or more XAI parameters may indicate features that have a greatest impact on predictions made by an artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning (ML) inference model. The WTRU may determine to trigger an XAI report based on one or more outcomes of the XAI model. The WTRU may send the XAI report to the network.

CN122509359.title: Artificial intelligence silent evolution control system based on fusible, contractible, audible and explainable edge protocol
CN122509359.abstract: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence silent evolution control system based on a fusible, contractible, audible and explainable edge protocol, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence system safety and reliability management. The system comprises a sideband protocol bus, an interpretable module, a fusible module, a retractable module, an auditable module and a silent evolution management layer. The interpretable module calculates a model output confidence coefficient and a feature attribution path, the fusible module triggers fusing and issues an event according to a confidence coefficient preset condition, the contractible module responds to the fusing event to execute dynamic resource contraction, and the auditable module generates a triple association log of the confidence coefficient, a fusing action and a contraction action; a sideband protocol bus provides standardized event communication, module registration, and version negotiation. The technical problems that an existing AI governance module is isolated, and active defense and thermal evolution cannot be achieved based on output quality are solved, and the method is suitable for high-risk AI application scenes such as finance, medical treatment and automatic driving.

CN122489696.title: Estrus-sharing intelligent customer service system based on multiple agents and explainable distillation
CN122489696.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of human-computer interaction and natural language processing, and discloses a multi-agent and explainable distillation-based common-situation intelligent customer service system, which comprises an input and memory module, an emotion judgment module, a common-situation judgment and attitude determination module, a knowledge retrieval module, a reply generation module and a log and data closed-loop module, when the emotional customer service interaction is carried out, multi-dimensional recognition is carried out on the emotional state of a user through the emotion judgment module, accurate emotion analysis is realized in combination with the emotion type classification unit and the emotion intensity evaluation unit, the problem of emotion misjudgment caused by single-modal analysis of a traditional system can be solved, the accuracy of emotional response is ensured, and the user experience is improved. And meanwhile, by detecting the consistency of the emotion recognition result and the dialogue context in real time, the error of the common-situation interaction is further reduced, and when a response strategy deviates, real-time correction can be carried out through a dynamic adjustment mechanism, so that the rationality and effectiveness of common-situation decision making are ensured.

WO2026161003.title: PROCÉDÉ ET APPAREIL POUR EFFECTUER UN APPRENTISSAGE PAR RENFORCEMENT EXPLICABLE DANS UN RÉSEAU DE COMMUNICATION
WO2026161003.abstract: The disclosure provides methods and apparatus for performing explainable reinforcement learning, RL, XRL, in a communication network (700) The method comprises obtaining (101) a request indicating a type of analysis to be performed on an RL model configured to perform a task associated with one or more communication network cells. The method comprises performing (103) the requested type of analysis, using analysis information, with respect to at least one cell of the one or more communication network cells. The method comprises compiling (104) an explanation information based on analysis results obtained by performing the requested type of analysis with respect to the at least one cell of the one or more communication network cells. The method comprises updating (105) the RL model based on the compiled explanation information.

US20260214451.title: Systems and Methods for Explainable Edge Security for Emerging Radio Access Network Architectures
US20260214451.abstract: [0000]    An example method for explainable security in a wireless network includes receiving, by a network controller, telemetry data generated by a radio access network (RAN) data plane of a network device during runtime. The telemetry data is indicative of communications between a base station and the network device. The method includes detecting, by a detection model, at least one potentially anomalous traffic sequence. The method includes, responsive to the detecting, providing the at least one potentially anomalous traffic sequence to a generative artificial intelligence (gen AI) model different from the detection model. The method includes receiving, from the gen AI model, a security assessment characterizing the at least one potentially anomalous traffic sequence, wherein the security assessment comprises a language explanation of a cause of the at least one potentially anomalous traffic sequence. The method includes providing the security assessment.

US20260204062.title: SECURITY SYSTEM WITH EXPLAINABLE FALSE POSITIVES
US20260204062.abstract: A security system detects objects using a machine learning model. A first object detection model trained to detect a target object is applied to an image. The model also outputs a class activation map (CAM) for the image. An overlay image is generated based on the CAM. If the target object is determined to be depicted in the image, user feedback of a first metric of accuracy of the first object detection model is requested. A CAM score representative of a second metric of accuracy is generated using the user feedback. A model score is determined using the CAM score and used to compare with a model score of a second object detection model. A recommendation is made to apply one of the first or second object detection models based on the comparison.

US20260203374.title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR DETERMINING EXPLAINABLE DOMAIN GAP METRIC
US20260203374.abstract: The present disclosure relates to a method for determining one or more domain gap metrics for time series data. The method includes obtaining a first time series data set and a second time series data set. The method includes determining a first set of features, associated with the first time series data set, with respect to a plurality of perspectives. The method includes determining a second set of features, associated with the second time series data set, with respect to the plurality of perspectives. The method includes determining a plurality of divergence values associated with a distribution of the first set of features and the second set of features, across the plurality of perspectives using a predetermined divergence metric. The method includes determining the one or more domain gap metrics by combining the plurality of divergence values in a predetermined manner.
