US20260188307.title: EXPLAINABLE ATTENTION DECISIONS IN MULTI-SOURCE ENVIRONMENTS
US20260188307.abstract: [0000]    Systems, methods and computer-readable media for providing explainable selective attention in multi-source or multi-speaker environments. A selective attention module receives multimodal sensor data including audio, video, gaze, text, and physiological signals from a plurality of sources. An attention inference engine generates attention distributions over the sources and fuses them into a probabilistic belief state. An explainability module produces interpretable outputs corresponding to the fused belief, including attention matrices, confidence scores, reliability measures, margin-based differentiators, and natural language rationales. The explainability outputs are rendered through visual, auditory, or augmented/virtual reality interfaces to indicate the attended source, suppressed sources, and reasoning for the selection. The system enables user interaction by providing justifications in real time, logging explanations for retrospective analysis, and supporting adaptation of thresholds and model weights based on feedback. The disclosed technology improves transparency, interpretability, and trust in selective attention systems, while maintaining real-time performance in dynamic multi-speaker environments.

WO2026143167.title: SYSTÈME D'IA EXPLICABLE POUR PRÉDICTION DE DIAGNOSTIC DANS UNE UNITÉ DE SOINS INTENSIFS
WO2026143167.abstract: An explainable artificial intelligence system for early prediction of missed severe diagnoses in intensive care unit patients is provided. The system comprises a data processing module configured to receive and process electronic health record data including patient demographics, vital signs, laboratory results, and diagnostic codes. A machine learning module with ensemble, deep learning, and large language models analyzes processed data to predict likelihood of severe diagnoses including acute myocardial infarction, acute pulmonary embolism, bacterial pneumonia, aortic dissection, meningitis, spinal abscess, bacterial endocarditis, and arterial thromboembolism. An explainability module generates feature importance rankings and provides interpretable explanations for predictions.

US20260187994.title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR EXPLAINABLE IMAGE CLASSIFICATION
US20260187994.abstract: A system and method of explainable classification of a target image by at least one processor may include: applying a pretrained classifier on the target image to predict a class according to a classification category; generating a style vector based on the predicted class; applying a first generative model on the target image and style vector to generate an image component that is class-distinct in relation to the predicted class; applying one or more second generative models on the target image and style vector to generate one or more respective image components that are class-agnostic in relation to the predicted class; and presenting the class-distinct image component as explanatory data for the predicted class, wherein the class-distinct image component and the class-agnostic image components are adapted to be additively combined to obtain a reproduction of the target image.

The method may include obtaining a plurality of fraud detection rule combinations, each fraud detection rule combination of the plurality of fraud detection rule combinations having an assigned risk level, wherein each fraud detection rule combination comprises a combination of two or more individual fraud detection rules; receiving transaction data associated with an account; identifying, from the plurality of fraud detection rule combinations, one or more fraud detection rule combinations triggered by the transaction data, and generating a consolidated risk score for the account by aggregating the assigned risk levels of each triggered fraud detection rule combination; and generating a fraud alert when the consolidated risk score exceeds a threshold, wherein the fraud alert includes an explanation identifying the one or more fraud detection rule combinations that contributed to the consolidated risk score.

US20260178946.title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence Framework System
US20260178946.abstract: [0000]    A system and method are provided for generating domain-specific explainable recommendations through interpretable machine learning models. The system features an explainable artificial intelligence (AI) framework that combines decision trees and Bayesian inference for recommendation generation, while leveraging Shapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) values to provide transparent rationales for its decisions. The framework integrates ontological data to enhance recommendation accuracy and implements dynamic adjustment of explanation complexity based on user expertise levels. These techniques advance the field of explainable AI by providing a solution that balances machine learning techniques with interpretable outputs, while adapting explanations to different user expertise categories for improved understanding and adoption.

WO2026135840.title: SYSTÈME DE GESTION D'ONTOLOGIE À INTÉGRATION IA EXPLICABLE
WO2026135840.abstract: A system and method are provided for generating explainable recommendations through an integrated approach combining ontology management and adaptive explanation frameworks. The system includes an ontology management module that maintains consistency while enabling cross-domain integration. The system also includes an explainable artificial intelligence (AI) framework that adapts explanation complexity to user expertise levels. The ontology management module employs semantic similarity algorithms to update and expand a multi-domain ontology, integrating knowledge across diverse domains. This unified ontological foundation supports the explainable AI framework in generating accurate recommendations with contextually appropriate explanations. The system advances the field of explainable AI by addressing the challenges of ontological consistency during updates while making AI recommendations more accessible through expertise-based explanation adaptation.

US20260181001.title: Multi-tier Data Verification System for Explainable Artificial Intelligence
US20260181001.abstract: [0000]    A system and method are provided for generating explainable recommendations through the integration of multi-tier data verification and adaptive explanation frameworks. The system includes a data verification subsystem implementing consensus protocols for conflict resolution. The system also includes an explainable artificial intelligence (AI) framework that adapts explanation complexity. The data verification subsystem employs confidence scoring based on source reliability and applies consensus algorithms to resolve data discrepancies. This verified data foundation, augmented with confidence metrics, enables the explainable AI framework to generate reliability-aware explanations. The system advances the field of explainable AI by addressing the critical challenge of data reliability while providing transparency through confidence-aware explanations, thereby enhancing the trustworthiness of AI-generated recommendations.

US20260178753.title: Inter-component Communication and Synchronization System for Explainable Artificial Intelligence
US20260178753.abstract: [0000]    A system and method are provided for secure orchestration of explainable recommendation components in Artificial Intelligence (AI) environments. The system includes an orchestration layer that implements secure communication protocols between system components while managing data validation across component boundaries. A synchronization mechanism maintains consistency between subsystems and enables secure transmission of explanation data and recommendation context. The system includes an explainable AI framework that implements adjustment of explanation complexity, supported by resource allocation based on component interaction patterns. These techniques advance the field of explainable AI systems by providing a solution for secure component integration and efficient resource management, while ensuring reliable delivery of contextual explanations across system boundaries.

ZA202509091.title: AN EXPLAINABLE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE BASED DIABETIC RETINOPATHY DETECTION AND SEVERITY CLASSIFICATION SYSTEM
ZA202509091.abstract: The present invention is related to an explainable artificial intelligence based diabetic retinopathy detection and severity classification system. The invention pertains to a diagnostic system based on AI that uses Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) for automatic detection and DR severity classification from retinal fundus images. In contrast to conventional black-box models, the system delivers both visual and textual explanations of its predictions, promoting trust and transparency when used clinically. The model categorizes DR into regular stages—No DR, Mild, Moderate, Severe, and Proliferative—while emphasizing prominent pathological characteristics like microaneurysms and hemorrhages. Cloud, local servers, or mobile devices are the target deployment for this system, which facilitates cost-efficient and accessible eye screening, particularly in distant or underserved areas, and facilitates early diagnosis, treatment planning, and public health screening programs.

EP4764919.title: ERKLÄRBARE SCHADPROGRAMMANALYSE
EP4764919.abstract: Systems, methods, and software can be used to detect a malware file. In some aspects, a method includes: obtaining features from a binary file to be classified as either a malware file or a non-malware file; inputting the obtained features to a first trained machine learning model; outputting, by the first trained machine learning model, an encoded vector; inputting the encoded vector to a second trained machine learning model, the second trained machine learning model generating text as output; and outputting, by the second trained machine learning model, a human-understandable text explanation of malicious activities that can be performed by the binary file, the human-understandable text explanation being generated without executing the binary file, the text explanation enabling a classification of the binary file.

US20260171097.title: RELEVANCY-BASED EXPLAINABLE AI FOR AUDIO DEEPFAKE DETECTION
US20260171097.abstract: [0000]    An exemplary method for determining a contribution of different portions of an audio signal to a deepfake detection machine learning model output includes inputting a plurality of tokens into a deepfake detection machine learning model trained to predict whether the audio signal comprises synthetically generated audio; generating, using the deepfake detection machine learning model, a plurality of output tokens; generating, using the deepfake detection machine learning model, a classification output indicating whether the audio signal comprises synthetically generated audio based on the plurality of output tokens; determining a plurality of relevancy metrics associated with the plurality of output tokens for each portion of the audio signal; determining a weighting for each of the plurality of relevancy metrics; and determining a contribution of each of the plurality of portions of the audio signal to the classification output based on a weighted relevancy of each portion.

US20260170304.title: ADVERSARIAL TRAINING OF CLASSIFIERS TO LEARN EXPLAINABLE FEATURES
US20260170304.abstract: [0000]    Various embodiments of the present disclosure provide an improved adversarial training technique that improves the functionality of a computer in various aspects by to removing spurious correlations within machine learning models. The techniques comprise receiving, from an embedding layer of a machine learning encoder, a set of token embeddings associated with a labeled data object. The techniques comprise generating a set of perturbed token embeddings by applying a noise hyperparameter to a portion of the set of token embeddings, providing, to an encoding layer of the machine learning encoder, the set of perturbed token embeddings to generate a perturbed encoded representation of the labeled data object, and providing the perturbed encoded representation for training a classifier model based on the perturbed encoded representation and a label for the labeled data object.

EP4760511.title: EINHEITLICHE ERKLÄRBARE REDUKTION UND KOMPRIMIERTE SPEICHERUNG VON ROH-, ABGETASTETEN UND DISKRETISIERTEN MESSUNGEN
EP4760511.abstract: [0001]    A unified storage format is presented for received observation data records of various formats, including individual observations or histograms and pre-sampled records describing multiple observations. The proposed storage format also supports various data reduction technologies, including coarsening of time and observation value resolutions, where the proposed data reduction technologies retain data describing the quantity of observations. In addition, sampling-based data reduction approaches are described, which at least retain the statistical expectancy value for the number of observations. Further, a definition and storage format for histogram buckets is provided with guaranteed relative error behavior over the whole value range of observation data, that only requires the definition of a number of significant bits for the recording and interpretation of histogram data. The proposed histogram storage scheme is applicable to integer and floating-point observation data. (Fig. 1)

US12651181.title: Dynamic language generation for explainable outputs in conversational language models
US12651181.abstract: [0000]    In some embodiments, a system may enable autonomous reasoning in real-time communications by dynamically generating and executing DSLs based on context. The method includes determining a computational intent specification from messages exchanged in a communication session and accessing knowledge sources relevant to the computational intent specification. The method further includes generating a DSL using a generative language model based on the computational intent, the messages, and the knowledge sources, where the language defines constructs and syntax rules specifying allowable compositions of named entities and relationships. The method further includes executing the constructs to perform reasoning operations and generate an output message responsive to the messages. The method further includes presenting the output message within the real-time communication platform and storing an execution trace mapping the constructs to portions of the output message.

CN122163163.title: Autism diagnosis method and system based on explainable brain sub-graph neural network of multi-teacher distillation
CN122163163.abstract: The invention discloses an infantile autism diagnosis method and system based on a multi-teacher distillation explainable brain sub-graph neural network in the technical field of medical image processing. The method comprises the following steps: preprocessing obtained functional magnetic resonance brain image data of a subject in a resting state to obtain blood oxygen level dependent signal time sequence data of each region of interest of the brain, constructing a brain network BN matrix by calculating a Pearson's correlation coefficient of any two regions of interest, and constructing a brain network diagram according to the brain network BN matrix; inputting the brain network diagram into a trained infantile autism diagnosis model for infantile autism diagnosis to obtain an original score of a prediction category; and converting the original score of the prediction category into a diagnosis result. According to the method, different scales of BN topological knowledge are captured through a plurality of GCN teacher models to guide the brain sub-graph neural network, and information of different sub-graphs is adaptively fused in combination with an attention mechanism, so that the representation learning ability of the models is enhanced, and the judgment of the autism can be effectively realized.

CN122152991.title: Traceable, explainable and verifiable large-model intelligent teaching assisting system and method for nursing education
CN122152991.abstract: The invention discloses a traceable, interpretable and verifiable large-model intelligent teaching assisting system and method for nursing education. The system comprises an input capture and semantic analysis module, a multi-source knowledge retrieval and versioning traceability module, an executable reference and fragment-by-fragment binding module, a causal evidence graph and structural interpretation generation module, an evidence consistency and anti-fact stability verification module and a replayable decoding and evidence storage module. The input analysis module generates a standardized problem template and risk level information; the knowledge retrieval and traceability module outputs a candidate evidence set with source fragment fingerprints; the information binding module binds the answer unit with the evidence fingerprint to generate reference mapping; the causal evidence graph module constructs a structured interpretation graph; the multi-dimensional verification module carries out logic consistency and anti-fact stability testing and outputs a verification result; the decoding evidence storage module stores replayable decoding information. According to the method, answer fragment-level traceability, structured machine verifiable explanation and deterministic result replay are realized by constructing a modular system.

EP4752896.title: VERFAHREN UND SYSTEME ZUR VORHERSAGE EINER ERKLÄRBAREN ARZNEIMITTELDOSIERUNG EINER PERSON
EP4752896.abstract: The disclosure relates generally to methods and systems for predicting explainable drug dosage of a subject. Conventional techniques for advising drug dosage are mostly manual processes and the drug dosage advised by physician may not be effective as such dosages are not validated. The present disclosure solves the technical problems in the art with the methods and systems for predicting explainable drug dosage of the subject. According to the present disclosure, current clinical data and historical data are received from a patient repository. Drug dosage possibilities are generated based on the historical information available in the art. The possibilities and the scenarios are generated and evaluated using a possibility evaluation engine. The possibility score of each drug dosage and a weightage for each treatment decision scenario is computed. An explainability for each of the ranked possibilities is then generated to predict the explainable drug dosage of the subject.

US20260148115.title: COMBINING MACHINE LEARNING AND GENERATIVE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FOR EXPLAINABLE PREDICTIONS
US20260148115.abstract: [0000]    Embodiments of the subject technology relate to systems, methods, and computer-readable media for using an LLM to generate an explanation of an output of an ML model. An input indicative of a scenario associated with an enterprise can be obtained. An output associated with the scenario can be generated based on the input via an ML model. An explanation of the output can be inferred by an LLM based on data associated with the ML model. A graphical representation of the output and the explanation can be generated.

KR20260068789.abstract: 의료용 유방촬영술 및 초음파 영상을 활용한 다중 모달 유방암 하이브리드 설명 가능한 컴퓨터 보조 진단 기술이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 유방암 진단 시스템에 의해 수행되는 유방암 진단 방법은, 유방 초음파를 획득된 초음파 이미지 또는 유방 조영술을 통해 획득된 조영 이미지를 포함하는 유방 이미지를 수집하는 단계; 유방암 진단 모델에 상기 수집된 유방 이미지를 입력하는 단계; 유방암 진단 모델을 통해 상기 입력된 유방 이미지로부터 양성 병변 또는 악성 병변을 탐지하는 단계; 및 상기 탐지된 양성 병변 또는 악성 병변의 위치 영역을 상기 입력된 유방 이미지에 시각화하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

The AC-Powered Chime also includes an Edge computer to provide local Artificial Intelligence, Video Processing and Data Analytics. This replaces the wi-fi doorbell or cloud-based video processing - thereby increasing the performance & speed of the wi-fi doorbell system.

AU2015100351.abstract: Abstract This innovation, 'Animal Be Aware System' (ABAS) is a 'fixed roadside' powered device which will transmit an ultrasonic sound as to alert or deter a wide range of animals, notably kangaroo and deer animals from approaching a road or any area travelled by vehicles. This ABAS system will help prevent road injuries and costly damage from vehicle collisions with animals and depending on individual site land and area circumstances, will operate approximately up to 500 metres away. CN122657723.title: Crop disease and pest monitoring method and system based on machine vision learning
CN122657723.abstract: The invention provides a crop disease and pest monitoring method and system based on machine vision learning, and the method comprises the steps: collecting original images of crops in a target planting region, carrying out the preprocessing, and constructing a to-be-detected image set; inputting the to-be-detected image set into a pre-trained improved YOLOv8 model to obtain category information, position frame information and confidence information of the pest and disease damage target; wherein an attention mechanism module is embedded in a backbone network of the improved YOLOv8 model, the feature fusion network adopts a bidirectional feature pyramid structure, and a detection head is a decoupling detection head for small target detection; calculating a disease and pest risk score based on the detection result of the disease and pest target in the unit monitoring period; and according to a comparison result of the disease and insect pest risk score and a preset grade threshold, determining a disease and insect pest occurrence grade, and outputting a corresponding monitoring result and early warning information. According to the invention, rapid identification, accurate positioning and dynamic monitoring of crop diseases and insect pests in a complex agricultural scene can be realized.
CN122657723.assignee: SHAANXI SCIENCE AND TECH RESOURCES STATISTICS CENTER

ZA202510604.title: A CROP DISEASE DETECTION AND REMEDY SUGGESTION SYSTEM USING IMAGE PROCESSING
ZA202510604.abstract: The present invention is related to a crop disease detection and remedy suggestion system using image processing. This invention belongs to an independent system for providing related treatment guidance to identify crop diseases and operate the use of the Internet. Farmers can enter images of affected plants in the system, which process visual information to determine the disease. Based on the diagnosis, the system refers to a built -in target database to suggest the correct treatment. It is designed for direct use in agricultural areas, which enables timely detection and action to reduce crop damage.

CN122633884.title: Crop disease cross-modal retrieval method based on multi-scale enhancement and domain guidance
CN122633884.abstract: The invention provides a multi-scale enhancement and domain-guided crop disease cross-modal retrieval method, which is characterized in that a feature encoder is improved into a domain knowledge-guided feature encoder, and a scab-health comparison enhancement module automatically generates a scab probability graph on an FPN high-resolution layer, constructs comparison features and integrates cross-modal alignment; the disease type condition modulation module establishes a mapping table of disease types and symptom level activation modes, and realizes adaptive enhancement of features through condition constraints; the weak supervision dimension classification module automatically generates a symptom dimension pseudo label by using a semantic function dictionary, so that text representation has a decomposable dimension capability; by using data-driven symptom co-occurrence prior regular loss, a symptom co-occurrence rule is counted from data, and domain constraints are applied to an alignment process and a dimension activation mode. According to the method, the semantic association relationship between the crop disease image and the text is mined from the global level and the local level, and the direction is to enlarge the inter-class difference and reduce the intra-class difference.

CN122637046.title: Crop disease and insect pest intelligent identification and early warning method based on deep learning
CN122637046.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural informatization models, and discloses a crop disease and insect pest intelligent identification and early warning method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: receiving time sequence environment data acquired by a measurement node in a low-frequency sampling state to form a historical environment matrix, enabling the measurement node to enter a monitoring state and acquire a visible light image frame, generating a visual reasoning result based on deep learning and calculating a form evolution index; determining a data aggregation granularity to extract a continuous environment matrix; generating a habitat suitability index by using a habitat integral formula; generating a final calibration probability by using a probability calibration formula; and controlling to change to a high-frequency sampling state to generate high-frequency environment data and recalculating. According to the method, negative constraint calibration is carried out on the visual confidence through meteorological habitat integral, blind area reverse heavy load feedback control is established, model false alarm is effectively inhibited, and hardware power consumption is reduced.

CN122618400.title: Crop disease identification method and system
CN122618400.abstract: The invention discloses a crop disease identification method and system, and relates to the field of crop disease identification, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a crop image, and carrying out the preprocessing; inputting the preprocessed crop image into an image feature extraction sub-network to generate an initial crop feature map; processing the initial crop feature map by using a preset plant positioning branch to generate a crop plant map, processing the crop plant map by using a preset disease screening branch, extracting a disease related area, and generating a crop disease map; inputting the crop plant graph into a preset plant feature extraction sub-network to generate a plant feature graph, and inputting the crop disease graph into a disease feature extraction sub-network to extract disease features to generate a disease feature graph; classification prediction is carried out according to the plant feature map and the disease feature map, all classification prediction results are fused, a crop disease recognition result is obtained, and the automation level of disease detection in agricultural production is improved.

CN122618478.title: Crop disease and pest early recognition and positioning method based on vision-spectrum-environment multi-mode feature fusion
CN122618478.abstract: The invention provides a crop disease and insect pest early recognition and positioning method based on vision-spectrum-environment multi-modal feature fusion, and relates to the technical field of agricultural intelligent detection, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting three types of modal data of a crop high-resolution RGB image, multi-spectral reflectivity data and real-time environment parameters; constructing a multi-branch parallel feature extraction network, and performing feature extraction on the three types of modal data to obtain visual features, spectral features and environmental context features; performing embedding space alignment and fusion on the three types of modal features through a cross-modal adaptive alignment module; according to the method, visual, spectral and environmental modal features are extracted through three parallel branches respectively, crop macroscopic phenotype, microscopic physiological and biochemical and environmental context information is comprehensively covered, meanwhile, a cross-modal adaptive alignment module is introduced, semantic gaps and scale differences among heterogeneous data are eliminated through mutual information loss and gating attention weight, and the crop quality is improved. And efficient fusion of multi-modal features is realized.
CN122618478.assignee: SHANDONG SHENLAN ZHIPU DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

CN122618444.title: Determination method and application method of crop lodging and disease semantic change double-temporal monitoring model and related device
CN122618444.abstract: The invention discloses a crop lodging and disease semantic change dual-temporal monitoring model determination method, an application method and a related device, and relates to the field of remote sensing monitoring, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a sample data set of a sample region, constructing a crop lodging and disease semantic change dual-temporal monitoring network, and utilizing the sample data set to determine a crop lodging and disease semantic change dual-temporal monitoring model. And carrying out multiple times of training iteration on the dual-temporal monitoring network until a preset convergence condition is met, and obtaining a dual-temporal monitoring model of crop lodging and disease semantic change. According to the method, the elevation data is introduced, and an accurate semantic change tag can be obtained without manual annotation; a third decoding-classification module carries out comprehensive processing and global modeling on the global change features and other features of the sample, and reflects the global expression of the crop abnormal semantic change process; by constructing a bidirectional distillation joint optimization mechanism between semantic segmentation and change monitoring, the collaborative consistency among multiple tasks is enhanced, and the false drop rate and semantic conflicts are reduced.

CN224651215.title: Patent Specification CN224651215U
CN224651215.abstract: Patent publication covering industrial methods and systems in CN224651215U.

CN122597201.title: Crop disease remote sensing image fusion method based on double-flow attention mechanism
CN122597201.abstract: The invention discloses a crop disease remote sensing image fusion method based on a double-flow attention mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of remote sensing image processing. The method solves the problems that an existing remote sensing image fusion method depends on a manual linear fusion rule, a complex nonlinear mapping relation between a multispectral image and a panchromatic image is difficult to express, the fusion result spectrum is distorted or space details are fuzzy, and the field disease recognition precision is restricted. A spectrum-space joint attention mechanism and a space structure attention mechanism are used to carry out refined feature extraction on a multispectral image and a panchromatic image respectively, and then through cross-modal cross attention fusion operation, guidance of spectral information on space detail reconstruction is realized. And finally, the spatial resolution is improved, and meanwhile, the disease-sensitive spectral characteristics are completely reserved, so that the large-area crop disease remote sensing monitoring requirement is met.

CN122597983.title: Pest and disease identification method and device for crop image, equipment, storage medium and program product
CN122597983.abstract: The invention relates to a pest and disease identification method and device for a crop image, equipment, a storage medium and a program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current moment image of a target crop at a to-be-identified place; inputting the current image of the target crop into a pest recognition model, and obtaining a pest recognition result at the current moment output by the pest recognition model; wherein the disease and insect pest recognition result comprises candidate disease and insect pest categories and confidence coefficients of the disease and insect pest categories, and the disease and insect pest recognition model is a multi-classification model generated after training of a training image set; and determining a target pest and disease damage type from the candidate pest and disease damage types in the pest and disease damage identification result according to the region where the target crop is located and the confidence coefficient of the candidate pest and disease damage types. The method can improve the disease and pest identification efficiency.
CN122597983.assignee: DICUI INTELLIGENT TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

CN122571362.title: Crop disease field diagnosis method and device based on multi-modal data fusion
CN122571362.abstract: The invention discloses a crop disease field diagnosis method and device based on multi-modal data fusion. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a sunlight-induced chlorophyll fluorescence feature vector and a hyperspectral reflectivity feature vector; calculating a fusion operator; constructing a first training set based on the sunlight-induced chlorophyll fluorescence feature vector, the hyperspectral reflectivity feature vector, the fusion operator and the disease level, and training a double-branch hybrid CNN-Transformer network according to the first training set; and the trained double-branch hybrid CNN-Transform network outputs the disease level corresponding to the target crop. In the embodiment of the invention, the compound requirements of deep fusion of heterogeneous data and field diagnosis with high early diagnosis sensitivity and strong universality can be well met, and the effect of disease field diagnosis is better.

CN122556499.title: Application of sclerotinia sclerotiorum pathogenicity-free strain DT-8 in prevention and treatment of crop root knot nematode disease
CN122556499.abstract: The invention discloses an application of a sclerotinia sclerotiorum pathogenicity-free strain DT-8 in prevention and treatment of root knot nematode disease of crops. The preservation number of the sclerotinia sclerotiorum pathogenicity-free strain DT-8 is CCTCC (China Center For Type Culture Collection) NO: M2019328. It is found for the first time that the sclerotinia sclerotiorum pathogenicity-free strain DT-8 can be used for preventing and treating the root knot nematode disease through action modes such as resistance induction, and the use amount of chemical pesticides is reduced. The invention provides a new thought and method for prevention and treatment of root knot nematode disease, is helpful for promoting green sustainable development of agriculture, and ensures the yield and quality safety of agricultural products.

KR20260123230.title: Plant Cultivation Support System with Crop and Disease Classification Function
KR20260123230.abstract: [0001a]    [본 발명은 다양한 농작물 재배현장에 설치되어 촬영영상 분석을 통해 농작물의 종류의 파악과 파악된 농작물에 맞는 관리방법의 제공과 및 질병분석을 수행하며 재배의 스마트화 및 자동화를 지원할 수 있는 농작물 및 질병분류 기능을 갖는 식물재배 지원시스템에 관한 것이다.]

CN122536544.title: Crop disease and insect pest detection device and detection method thereof
CN122536544.abstract: The invention discloses a crop disease and insect pest detection device and a detection method thereof, and relates to the technical field of disease and insect pest detection, the crop disease and insect pest detection device comprises an insect situation forecasting lamp, a spore capturing instrument, an insect capturing unit, a detection structure and a discharging structure; the insect catching unit is used for catching and killing insects; the detection structure is used for detecting the captured insects; and the discharging structure is used for discharging the detected insect bodies. A movable rod drives a closing block to move downwards, an outlet of a material collecting plate is closed, insect bodies fall onto a material distributing plate downwards, the span of the far end of a through groove in the upper surface of the material distributing plate is larger than the width of the near end, the insect bodies enter the through groove and slide down along the through groove, small-size insect bodies fall from the near end of the through groove, and large-size insect bodies fall from the far end of the through groove. The insect bodies with different volumes fall to different positions of the bearing plate, uniform distribution of the insect bodies is guaranteed, acquisition of insect body image data is facilitated, and the accuracy of detection data is improved.
CN122536544.assignee: SHAANXI RUNHEYI AGRICULTURAL TECH CO LTD

CN122530800.title: Crop disease and pest detection and environment monitoring system for unmanned mobile platform
CN122530800.abstract: The invention discloses a crop disease and pest detection and environment monitoring system for an unmanned mobile platform, and belongs to the technical field of smart agriculture, and the system comprises a multi-source sensing data acquisition module which obtains crop images, soil physical attribute data and environment meteorological data; the disease and pest recognition module recognizes the crop images and outputs disease and pest categories and severity levels; the environment state evaluation module is used for calculating a crop growth state index based on the data and calculating a geological risk index by combining the ratio of the soil humidity to the heat conductivity coefficient with the terrain gradient, the rainfall capacity and the historical ponding grade; the multi-target fusion decision-making module fuses the severity level, the growth state index and the geological risk index to generate a decision-making instruction, and when the geological risk exceeds a threshold value, drainage and alarm are executed preferentially; and the execution control module is used for controlling and adjusting soil heating and irrigation by adopting PID (Proportion Integration Differentiation), and executing fixed-point spraying by utilizing a scab space position. The system realizes integrated closed-loop control of pest control and environment regulation and control.
CN122530800.assignee: SHAANXI VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL UNIV OF INDUSTRY

CN122510713.title: Crop disease data acquisition and diagnosis device and method based on image recognition and medium
CN122510713.abstract: The invention discloses a crop disease data acquisition and diagnosis device and method based on image recognition and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent agriculture and plant protection. Leaf images are acquired plant by plant along crop rows by using a mobile acquisition platform, and poses and illuminance are synchronously acquired; executing disease detection reasoning at the edge end to obtain disease category, confidence and scab region information, and generating a unified feature vector; constructing a reward function according to the confidence entropy and the feature sparseness, and performing online optimization on exposure, light supplement and holder attitude through reinforcement learning; when the disease spot area proportion exceeds a threshold value, backtracking precise shooting is triggered, and two results are fused; generating severity and a variable drug delivery prescription; and the cloud aggregates the multi-node gradient abstracts to perform conflict analysis and significant channel selection, forms channel-level differential update and issues the channel-level differential update, and maps differential parameters into acquisition strategy weight adjustment amount to realize acquisition and model closed-loop self-evolution.

CN122493296.title: Crop disease cross-scene identification method
CN122493296.abstract: The invention discloses a crop disease cross-scene identification method, and relates to the technical field of computer vision and agricultural information processing, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, respectively inputting shared features extracted from an input disease image by a feature extraction network into a disease feature extraction branch and a scene feature extraction branch; and S2, orthogonality strong constraint is applied to features output by the disease feature extraction branch and the scene feature extraction branch, so that the cross covariance of the disease features and the scene features in the regeneration kernel Hilbert space approaches zero. According to the crop disease cross-scene identification method, information isolation is established from the feature generation level, so that the alignment operation undertaken by the scene feature branch does not affect the discriminative information reserved by the disease feature branch. While environment differences among different scenes are eliminated, integrity of disease essential features is maintained, and key identification information loss caused by global feature drift in an existing migration alignment scheme is avoided.

CN122491521.title: Crop disease and pest reasoning method and system based on time sequence cross-modal knowledge graph
CN122491521.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent agriculture and intelligent diagnosis of crop diseases and insect pests, and provides a crop disease and insect pest reasoning method and system based on a time sequence cross-modal knowledge graph, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining multi-modal fusion features in a crop planting scene, and generating candidate time sequence facts; performing boundary sensing increment updating on the time sequence cross-modal knowledge graph based on the candidate time sequence facts which are accurately written to obtain an updated time sequence cross-modal knowledge graph; reasoning the currently observed candidate pest and disease damage states through a symbol reasoning path based on a logic rule and a representation reasoning path based on map representation learning to obtain an explicit logic reasoning result and an implicit semantic reasoning result; and based on the cognitive uncertainty assessed quantity of the current input data in the reasoning process, calculating a fusion weight to carry out weighted fusion, and outputting a crop disease and insect pest mixed reasoning result. The accuracy and robustness of crop disease and insect pest reasoning are improved through the method.

CN122483982.title: Streptomyces marxianus separated from Hainan rainforest soil and application of streptomyces marxianus in plant disease control and crop growth promotion
CN122483982.abstract: The invention discloses Streptomyces marxianus separated from Hainan rainforest soil and an application of the Streptomyces marxianus in plant disease control and crop growth promotion. The classification name of the strain is Streptomyces malaysiensis, the strain is named as HNM30701, and the preservation number of the strain in the China General Microbiological Culture Collection Center (CGMCC) is CGMCC No. 30028. The strain has an antagonistic effect on pathogenic bacteria such as magnaporthe oryzae, ustilaginoidea virens, botrytis cinerea, phytophthora capsici, common fusarium, fusarium oxysporum, fusarium moniliforme, fusarium oxysporum, fusarium equiseti, fusarium fuji, sweet potato stem rot pathogen, sweet potato basal rot pathogen and the like; the composition can effectively prevent and treat gray mold on tomato in-vitro leaves and fruits, and sweet potato gummy disease and sweet potato basal rot on sweet potato plants, and can promote the growth of the sweet potato plants. According to the invention, two active compounds, i.e., the oxoglycolidin and the Hygrolidin amide, which have a remarkable inhibition effect on pyricularia grisea and rhizoctonia solani are obtained by separating and purifying the crude extract of the S. malasiensis HNM30701, a new scheme is provided for crop planting and biological control of various plant diseases, meanwhile, development and utilization of microbe resources in Hainan can be promoted, and development of tropical ecological agriculture is assisted.
CN122483982.assignee: SANYA RESEARCH INST CHINA AGRICULTURAL UNIVERSITY

CN122473583.title: Training method and system of crop disease and insect pest recognition model and medium
CN122473583.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of image recognition, in particular to a training method and system of a crop disease and pest recognition model and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: shooting a first original image and a second original image of a crop planting area; according to the local gray level change condition in the first original image, identifying and framing candidate insect areas; extracting corresponding pixels of the candidate insect area in the second original image by referring to the candidate insect area; detecting edge contour features of corresponding pixels, and dividing a disease and pest contour and a pest-free contour; performing multi-layer scaling contour sampling on the disease and pest contours and the pest-free contours to generate a training sample set; inputting the training sample set into a preset crop disease and insect pest recognition model to train the model; and verifying performance indexes of the crop disease and insect pest recognition model to execute iterative optimization parameter adjustment. According to the invention, the adaptability and misjudgment inhibition capability of crop disease and pest identification in an actual complex field environment can be improved, and the identification accuracy and robustness of the identification model can be improved.
CN122473583.assignee: AGRICULTURAL RESEARCH INST TIBET ACADEMY OF AGRICULTURAL AND ANIMAL HUSBANDRY SCIENCES

CN122452720.title: Crop disease and pest knowledge base self-learning and incremental updating method and system
CN122452720.abstract: The invention discloses a crop disease and insect pest knowledge base self-learning and incremental updating method and system, and belongs to the technical field of crop disease and insect pest diagnosis and knowledge base management, and the technical scheme is characterized in that the method comprises the steps: constructing a first knowledge network through three-level credibility weighted fusion and graph node matching; obtaining a quality score of the knowledge item and a use frequency after compensation through frequency statistics and a multi-condition threshold value; through attention heat map extraction and attribute node generation, a second knowledge network containing newly added nodes and associated edges is obtained; a third knowledge network and a rollback event record are obtained through semantic version control and rollback condition execution judgment; according to the method, on the basis of knowledge network evolution and feedback driving, knowledge base self-learning and incremental updating are achieved through the technologies of exposure compensation, version control, cross-crop migration and the like; and the knowledge coverage, the updating efficiency and the application reliability are improved.
CN122452720.assignee: CHENGDU XINDU LYUKONG AGRICULTURAL SERVICE CO LTD

CN122454180.title: Color and texture fused crop disease and insect pest stress abnormal region segmentation method
CN122454180.abstract: The invention discloses a crop disease and pest stress abnormal region segmentation method based on color and texture fusion, and relates to the technical field of agricultural remote sensing and intelligent image processing, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a farmland remote sensing image, and carrying out the preprocessing of the image to eliminate noise and distortion; the preprocessed image is converted into an HSV color space to extract color features, a gray level co-occurrence matrix and local binary pattern texture features are extracted, and the color features and the texture features are spliced in channel dimensions to form multi-channel fusion input; inputting the multi-channel fusion input into a semantic segmentation network for training; after training is completed, the model is used for segmenting a new image, and segmentation results are fused and post-processed to generate a disease and pest stress abnormal region distribution diagram. According to the method, the accuracy and robustness of segmentation of the disease and pest stress abnormal region are improved, automatic whole-field distribution mapping is realized, and the use cost and threshold are reduced.

CN122434805.title: Crop disease and pest image enhancement and segmentation method in complex illumination environment
CN122434805.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of digital image processing, and discloses a crop disease and insect pest image enhancement and segmentation method in a complex illumination environment, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an image, removing texture pixels based on local gray variance, and generating an environment light source reflection chromaticity vector; combining the diffuse reflection reference vector to separate the specular reflection component and output a diffuse reflection image, and solving the partial derivative of the specular reflection component to generate a residual gradient field; performing superpixel segmentation on the diffuse reflection image, and fusing color and texture features to construct a joint covariance matrix; constructing a weighted graph by using the superpixel centroid, and fusing a manifold distance and an illumination penalty term generated based on a residual gradient field to generate a composite weight; and calculating a topology duration based on the composite weight, and combining the super-pixel blocks meeting a threshold value to output a disease segmentation mask image. Through physical illumination decoupling and topology continuous homology analysis, the method can peel off strong light reflection interference and inhibit pseudo edges, and realizes accurate segmentation of a disease area under complex natural illumination.

CN122434276.title: Crop disease and pest early warning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
CN122434276.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of crop disease and insect pest early warning, in particular to a crop disease and insect pest early warning method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Performing principal component extraction on a first monitoring vector constructed based on the plurality of first environment monitoring values through a principal component extraction matrix to obtain a second monitoring vector; inputting the second monitoring vector into a risk probability estimation model to obtain a first probability value representing the probability of occurrence of diseases and insect pests; and finally, according to the first probability value and the plurality of historical probability values, determining a first total probability, and according to the first total probability and a probability threshold, determining the occurrence level of the plant diseases and insect pests. According to the method, a full-closed-loop automatic technical process of environmental data acquisition, feature dimensionality reduction optimization, probability intelligent prediction, time sequence fusion correction and self-adaptive grading judgment is formed, manual intervention is not needed in the whole process, and the occurrence probability and risk level of diseases and insect pests can be dynamically output in real time.
CN122434276.assignee: SHIJIAZHUANG VOCATIONAL TECHNOLOGY COLLEGE SHIJIAZHUANG OPEN UNIV

US12769884.title: Privacy-preserving multi-touch attribution system
US12769884.abstract: Aspects of the present disclosure relate to systems and protocols for cross-channel tracking and attribution in software environments. User identifiers may be stitched across devices, sessions, and channels based on network and/or device information. Based on the stitching, the complete history of a user's interactions with the software platform may be tracked. Accordingly, an attribution graph may be generated based on the stitching. The attribution graph may include weights for each channel based on the user's interactions with the software environment. Interventions may be performed with respect to the software environment based on the weights. For example, channels with low weights may be identified, and maintenance may be performed on the channels. As another example, channels with high weights may be deployed at higher frequencies. Because the stitching and attribution is performed without invasive technologies such as cookies, system security may be enhanced.

US12770185.title: Systems and methods for privacy-preserving multi-agent financial crime detection with cross-jurisdictional compliance management
US12770185.abstract: A computer-implemented system for detecting financial crimes while preserving data privacy includes a multi-agent orchestration framework that coordinates autonomous agents configured for ingestion, pattern recognition, investigation, and reporting of financial transaction data. The system applies tokenization, jurisdiction-aware workflow management, and differential privacy safeguards, with a privacy-aware permission model and execution within confidential computing enclaves. These agents collaborate under access constraints to detect suspicious behavior and generate regulatory reports without exposing sensitive information.

US20260322610.title: Privacy Preserving Behavioral Prediction Engine with Federated Cyclehit Scoring, Enclave Bound History Values, Zero Knowledge Compliance Proofs, and IPS Conditioned Compute Monetization
US20260322610.abstract: [0000]    A privacy-preserving behavioral prediction engine enables compliant personalization and verifiable compute monetization across cloud, edge, and GPU-accelerated environments. Behavioral signals are computed locally using federated cyclehit scoring executed inside trusted execution environments (TEEs), producing enclave-bound history values that never expose raw user data. Zero-knowledge proofs verify the correctness of local scoring, model updates, and inference execution, while secure aggregation combines encrypted updates without revealing behavioral information. A compute-value attribution module fuses behavioral importance scores with GPU telemetry, sustainability metrics, and inference-integrity proofs to generate IPS-conditioned compute value scores used for dynamic pricing, routing, and SLA enforcement. A monetization layer issues verifiable IPS tokens encoding provenance, compliance, and compute value, enabling revenue sharing and settlement across AI marketplaces. The architecture provides a unified, regulator-aligned foundation for privacy-safe behavioral prediction, verifiable inference, and sustainable compute orchestration in next-generation AI ecosystems.

EP4822570.title: SYSTEM UND VERFAHREN ZUR BEWAHRBARKEIT, DATENSCHUTZBEWAHRENDEN VERTEILTEN VERFOLGUNG UND KONFORMITÄTSÜBERWACHUNG
EP4822570.abstract: [0001]    A computer-implemented system and method for AI observability, distributed tracing, and privacy-preserving monitoring in Al-driven environments. The system assigns a unique trace identifier to Al-generated requests, enabling seamless tracking across multiple AI processing components. Al logs are enriched with structured metadata, including model execution parameters, inference confidence scores, and processing timestamps, to facilitate trace-to-log correlation. A federated trace management system ensures trace data is distributed across multiple storage locations while enforcing jurisdiction-based compliance regulations. To enhance privacy, the system applies privacy-preserving transformations, such as redaction, tokenization, and homomorphic encryption, preventing exposure of personally identifiable information (Pll) in trace logs. The invention enables scalable Al observability with minimal performance overhead by implementing dynamic trace segmentation policies, selective sampling techniques, and cryptographic trace linking.

US12762273.title: Data clean room with exportable, privacy-preserving labels
US12762273.abstract: Systems, devices, and methods are provided for providing data clean room capabilities that allow for the export of privacy-preserving labels. A data clean room may be provisioned to obtain datasets from various parties. Code executing in the data clean room may select a differential privacy machine-learning model from a plurality of differential privacy machine-learning models train the selected differential privacy machine-learning model to infer noisy labels, determine a set of users of interest for a multi-party collaboration effort, infer, using the differential privacy machine-learning model, a set of noisy labels for the set of users, and determine an exportable dataset that comprises the noisy labels rather than private labels containing sensitive/private information.

WO2026210010.title: CALCUL PRÉSERVANT LA CONFIDENTIALITÉ À L'AIDE D'UN PARTAGE DE SECRET MULTIPLICATIF
WO2026210010.abstract: The invention relates to a cryptographic system (010) for performing a privacy-preserving computation on secret data as a cryptographic secure multi-party computation (MPC) between multiple cryptographic devices The computation involves a carry chain operator, for example, as part of a comparison of two numbers by a binary fold, or an addition of two numbers by a parallel prefix network. An output generate bit is computed as a XOR of a first generate bit and an AND of a first propagate bit and a second generate bit. An output propagate bit is computed as an AND of the first propagate bit and a second propagate bit. The MPC uses multiplicative linear secret sharing. The output generate bit is computed locally as a product share from a share of the first generate bit and regular shares of the first generate bit and the second generate bit.

WO2026213118.title: DONNÉES DE NIVEAU D'ENTITÉ PRÉSERVANT LA CONFIDENTIALITÉ DE DONNÉES À L'AIDE D'UN ÉTALONNAGE BASÉ SUR UNE TRANSACTION
WO2026213118.abstract: Systems and methods for generating projected store-level event-based interaction datasets using calibration techniques by accessing event-based interaction data from a plurality of users, where each event reflects a product transaction at a retail location. Supplemental user activity data is accessed from third-party databases. A projection factor is computed based on discrepancies between the interaction dataset and the supplemental data, the projection factor being indicative of underreporting in the observed data. US12755201.title: Training machine learning models using privacy preserving fairness regularization
US12755201.abstract: [0000]    Devices and techniques are generally described for privacy preserving fairness regularization for machine learning. In some examples, a first machine learning model may be trained for a first predictive task using unrestricted data. First data classified as restricted data may be determined. A second machine learning model may be trained to predict model fairness based at least in part on the first data and further based at least in part on second data representing characteristics of the first machine learning model during training. The second machine learning model may generate third data representing model fairness of a third machine learning model.

US20260301020.title: DATA PRIVACY-PRESERVING ENTITY-LEVEL DATA USING TRANSACTION-BASED CALIBRATION
US20260301020.abstract: [0000]    Systems and methods for generating projected store-level event-based interaction datasets using calibration techniques by accessing event-based interaction data from a plurality of users, where each event reflects a product transaction at a retail location. Supplemental user activity data is accessed from third-party databases. A projection factor is computed based on discrepancies between the interaction dataset and the supplemental data, the projection factor being indicative of underreporting in the observed data. The system applies the projection factor to scale the partial dataset into a projected dataset that estimates full consumer activity at a store or regional level. This projected dataset can be used to enhance targeted content delivery, improve media planning, support marketing mix modeling, or estimate store-level product demand in scenarios where direct point-of-sale data is unavailable. The system enables accurate behavioral insights without requiring data directly from retailers.

US20260300538.title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR HANDLING PRIVACY-PRESERVING CONFIDENTIAL SET INTERSECTION
US20260300538.abstract: A system includes a first-party processing module, a second-party processing module, and a third-party processing module. The first-party and second-party processing modules respectively include encryption modules and encrypted label transmission modules for encrypting and hashing local identifier sets into hashed ID lists using an agreed encryption technique, and for transmitting encrypted identifiers or partial encrypted labels. The third-party processing module includes a computation module configured to receive encrypted identifiers or partial labels from both parties and compute a matching result indicating whether entries correspond to a match, thereby generating a matching table containing real and dummy matches. A subset regrouping module regroups the matching table into subsets selectively distributed to each party to prevent full intersection reconstruction. A result delivery module outputs a pseudo set intersection alignment result, based on the distributed subsets, to the first-party and second-party processing modules for use in privacy-preserving computations.
US20260300538.assignee: HONG KONG APPLIED SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LIMITED [HK]

US20260300713.title: CONSORTIUM MODEL TRAINING AND INFERENCE USING CLIENT-DEFINED PRIVACY-PRESERVING FEATURE TRANSFORMATIONS
US20260300713.abstract: [0000]    A computer-implemented method, comprising obtaining a transformed dataset from a data owner, the transformed dataset comprising a plurality of transformed values derived from a list of transformed summarized features, wherein the transformed dataset is associated with an entity and is devoid of interpretable or reconstructable data regarding the entity; generating a target-related measure based on a target label associated with the transformed dataset, wherein the target-related measure comprises a numerical value that reflects a statistical relationship between a range of the transformed values and associated target label; generating an input feature vector, for the entity, wherein the input feature vector comprises the target-related measures corresponding to the list of transformed summarized features; and training a neural network classifier using a plurality of input feature vectors generated from multiple transformed datasets respectively obtained from a plurality of data owners.

ZA202600644.title: A DUAL-IMU BASED ADAPTIVE ROAD ANOMALY DETECTION AND MAPPING SYSTEM WITH PRIVACY-PRESERVING VISUAL VERIFICATION
ZA202600644.abstract: The present invention is related to a dual-IMU based adaptive road anomaly detection and mapping system with privacy-preserving visual verification. The invention discloses a low-cost, fleet-deployable road anomaly detection system utilizing a dual-IMU architecture to distinguish true road defects from vehicle-induced vibrations. A chassis-mounted IMU and a suspension-mounted IMU work in tandem with an adaptive calibration mechanism employing rolling median filtering and dynamic bias adjustment to minimize false positives across different vehicle types. An event-triggered rear-facing camera is selectively activated upon verified anomaly detection, thereby preserving privacy and reducing bandwidth. On-device TinyML classification enables lightweight anomaly recognition without dependence on smartphones or cloud-only processing. Verified anomaly data is securely transmitted via MQTT over TLS or HTTPS and aggregated into a GIS-based dashboard for visualization and decision-making. The invention enables scalable, privacy-preserving, and accurate road quality monitoring suitable for smart cities, fleet operators, and public authorities.

US20260291741.title: PRIVACY-PRESERVING CREDENTIALING AND PAYMENT
US20260291741.abstract: [0000]    A system may be configured to allow a user to authenticate themselves with a system and/or make digital payments using digital credentials. The digital credentials may allow the user to control their own identification and prove their identity and/or attributes to approved parties while maintaining privacy. Using cryptographic techniques, an approved party may verify the user's digital credentials even in absence of a network connection, allowing the parties to operate when network connectivity is intermittent, unreliable, or otherwise limited. A digital credential may be linked to a particular biometric identification to secure the digital credential to the user and their personal electronic device. In some implementations, the user may obtain a secondary digital credential that is not linked to a particular biometric template. If the primary digital credential is unavailable, the secondary digital credential may allow the user to authenticate themselves on a temporary or limited basis.

US20260289406.title: METHODS AND SYSTEMS FOR PRIVACY-PRESERVING FEDERATED LEARNING FOR RELATIONAL DATA
US20260289406.abstract: Methods, systems, and software for training models configured to detect exceptional data in one or more databases among a plurality of databases including vertical and horizontal partitioning in which the risk of privacy leakage is reduced. Measures are included in some embodiments to protect data record embeddings, sensitive data labels, and descent steps during sharing of information between owners of databases relevant to the model training.

US20260288985.title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PRIVACY-PRESERVING PRINTER SOURCE IDENTIFICATION OF QR CODE LABELS
US20260288985.abstract: In the present invention, federated learning provides a solution by enabling models to be trained using locally distributed data across multiple clients, reducing reliance on a centralized server. Each client, such as each smartphone in a smartphone group, independently trains a local model using its dataset and shares only model parameters with other participants, without transmitting actual QR code image data. The decentralized learning approach enhances data security and privacy, as sensitive information remains on-device, mitigating risks associated with data leakage and unauthorized access. Furthermore, by leveraging cyclic weight transfer, the system allows smartphones to sequentially update model weights, contributing to a continuously improving global model while preserving user privacy.

US20260278144.title: PRIVACY-PRESERVING RESILIENT QUERY PROCESSING
US20260278144.abstract: In various examples, a distributed query engine utilizes a negative cache to detect queries that are likely to fail or otherwise cause an error in execution and returns exceptions. For example, input queries are anonymized by replacing sensitive information with placeholders, and a mapping table is generated to enable the sensitive information to be restored in the exception messages. Continuing this example, a block ratio is used to allow a certain percentage of queries included in the negative cache to be executed, and for compilation and/or execution information to be generated. In some embodiments, this compilation and/or execution information is used to determine whether to update the negative cache—for example, by adding queries to the negative cache.

US20260279598.title: FEDERATED SURVIVAL ANALYSIS WITH PRIVACY-PRESERVING AGGREGATION
US20260279598.abstract: A method and systems for updating a federated survival model and generating personalized treatment recommendations. A plurality of local survival modeling nodes are each deployed at healthcare institutions. Each local survival modeling node trains a local survival model on institution-specific patient data. When the updates exceed a survival performance metric beyond a predetermined value, the local survival modeling nodes inject a calibrated noise into the local model update parameters to generate privacy-preserved model parameters to transmit to the federated learning server. The federated learning server generates feature availability vectors to aggregate the privacy-preserved model parameters into updated global model parameters. During the personalized treatment recommendation, the local survival modeling nodes integrate the updated global model parameters with the embedded feature representations of the patient's data. The local survival modeling node generates ranked treatment options for the patient based on a patient-specific survival prediction and local contextual factors.

US20260278686.title: MULTI-SHARE OF UNIQUE NON-FUNGIBLE TOKENS WITH PRIVACY-PRESERVING TRACKING
US20260278686.abstract: Consumer and/or channel partner behavior regarding tokenized brand rewards is managed, traced, and analyzed by observing and/or controlling token exchanges. Tokenized rewards have unique identifiers and are associated with terms and/or conditions for the exchange and/or use of the tokens. This can include terms and conditions for the minting of new tokenized rewards for other users by a registered holder of a token.

US20260278379.title: Federated Thought Caching with Privacy-Preserving Geometric Abstraction and Logarithmic Memory Scaling
US20260278379.abstract: A system and method for federated thought caching in persistent cognitive machines representing thoughts as geometric structures within dynamically evolving latent manifolds. The system implements distributed thought caches comprising local instance-specific storage and shared cross-instance repositories, enabling knowledge sharing while maintaining autonomy. Inputs are encoded as latent query trajectories, with cache hits determined through geometric similarity matching including geodesic distance and curvature patterns. Privacy-preserving transformations including curvature-preserving deformations and semantic generalization enable secure federation. Received thoughts undergo geodesic registration aligning external knowledge to local manifold geometry. Thermodynamic decay and progressive consolidation achieve logarithmic memory scaling, with low-energy thoughts merged into active bundles. Manifold curvature updates reflect usage patterns, deepening attractor basins for frequently accessed knowledge, enabling persistent adaptive cognition across distributed autonomous instances.

WO2026193481.title: RÉSOLUTION D'ENTITÉ ADAPTATIVE AVEC NOTATION DYNAMIQUE DE L'AUTORITÉ DE SOURCE ET TRAITEMENT AU NIVEAU DES CHAMPS PRÉSERVANT LA CONFIDENTIALITÉ
WO2026193481.abstract: A system and method for adaptive entity resolution process raw records from one or more data sources using an entity resolution engine configured to operate in a privacy mode or a cleartext mode according to field-level processing configurations. Exact-match fields may be processed using hashing, while fuzzy-match fields may be processed using Bloom filter encoding or semantic embeddings. Processed field representations are stored in a vector store and evaluated using similarity scoring to identify candidate matches. A consensus validation unit validates match outcomes using multiple signals, and a source authority feedback system updates field-level source credibility based on validation results. The system may generate enrichment output including recommended canonical values, confidence information, source rankings, and low-confidence indicators. The disclosed architecture supports secure, scalable, and adaptive record matching across single-tenant and multi-tenant environments.
