KR20260135089.abstract: 가블 서킷을 기반으로 한 트랜스포머의 프라이버시 보존 추론의 가속을 위한 풀 스택 프레임워크를 개시한다. 일실시예에 따른 트랜스포머의 프라이버시 보존 추론을 위한 시스템은 각각 하드웨어 가속기를 포함하는 가블러로서의 클라이언트 장치 및 평가자로서의 서버 장치를 포함할 수 있다. 이때, 시스템은 선형 연산을 위한 동형 암호(Homomorphic Encryption, HE)와 비선형 연산을 위한 가블 회로(Garbled Circuits, GC)가 결합된 하이브리드 프로토콜을 통해, 트랜스포머 모델을 계산하는 과정에서 비선형 함수 연산을 추출하고, GC 친화적 회로 생성(GC Friendly Circuit Generation)을 통해 상기 추출된 비선형 함수 연산에 대응하는 2입력 논리 게이트로 구성된 회로를 구성하고, 상기 구성된 회로를 브리스톨 포맷(Bristol format)의 넷리스트로 변환하고, CG(coarse-grained) 스케줄링 및 FG(fine-grained) 스케줄링이 결합된 넷리스트 스케줄링을 이용하여 상기 변환된 넷리스트를 스케줄링하고, 상기 스케줄링된 넷리스트를 입력받으로 받아 처리하는 컴파일러 추정(Compiler Speculation)을 통해 상기 서버 장치 및 상기 클라이언트 장치 각각이 포함하는 하드웨어 가속기에서 실행하기 위한 명령어를 생성할 수 있다.
KR20260135089.assignee: KOREA ADVANCED INST OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY [KR]

US20260268014.title: Privacy-Preserving Domain Integration for Federated Learning
US20260268014.abstract: [0000]    Systems and methods for implementing privacy-preserving aggregation of federated data are disclosed. Clients may share sets of private values encoded in different local domains with an aggregator, where privacy of the local domains is preserved. The aggregator merges the shared sets into an aggregated set that includes non-unique values and derives a global domain for the aggregated set. The aggregator then shares mappings between input sets and the global domain with the respective clients while preserving privacy for the global domain. The clients may then encode private datasets for aggregation using the respective mappings.

US20260262980.title: PRIVACY-PRESERVING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FOR EMPLOYEE DEPRESSION DETECTION
US20260262980.abstract: The disclosure introduces a system that integrates a learnable optical model with a multi-task deep network to detect depression while preserving user privacy. The system utilizes an optimized lens that captures images obscuring identity information while retaining features for depression detection. A feature focus network is configured to extract and analyze facial cues indicative of depression through a progressive learning strategy. This strategy incrementally trains the deep network in stages, focusing first on identity obfuscation, followed by emotional feature extraction, and depression-specific feature extraction. A multimodal transformer fuses emotional and depression features to produce an accurate depression score. The system is co-optimized through an end-to-end joint optimization process, ensuring that captured images are privacy preserving images that are effective for depression detection.

US20260270041.title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PRIVACY-PRESERVING LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL INFERENCE VIA FULLY HOMOMORPHIC ENCRYPTION
US20260270041.abstract: Various methods and processes, apparatuses or systems, and media for providing a fully homomorphic encryption (FHE)-based privacy-preserving large language model (LLM) inference via a graphics processing unit (GPU)-based implementation are disclosed. The method includes: receiving an encrypted query; providing, to an LLM, a GPU-based implementation of a transformer architecture that is configured to accelerate homomorphic operations of the LLM; inputting the encrypted query into the LLM with the GPU-based implementation of the transformer architecture, where the LLM is unable to decrypt the query; receiving an encrypted response to the query from the LLM; and decrypting the encrypted response.

US20260268344.title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR IDENTIFYING COUNTERFEIT PRODUCTS USING LIVE VERIFICATION WITH UNIQUE, PRIVACY-PRESERVING, UNPREDICTABLE, AND TAMPERPROOF QR CODES INTEGRATED WITH BLOCKCHAIN
US20260268344.abstract: The present disclosure relates to a system and method for counterfeit product identification and authentication using blockchain-integrated QR codes. The system generates unique, privacy-preserving, tamperproof, and unpredictable QR codes, which are cryptographically secured and linked to a blockchain smart contract for immutable tracking. The authentication and tracking system enables real-time product verification by manufacturers, intermediaries, retailers, and consumers, ensuring secure interactions within a predefined workflow. The system prevents unauthorized duplication through AES-256 encryption and SHA-512 hashing, ensuring counterfeit detection. Consumers can verify product authenticity through quick and detailed verification, including geolocation-based validation. Ownership transfers and secondary market transactions are securely recorded on the blockchain, maintaining verifiable provenance. The system further facilitates counterfeit reporting by allowing users to submit evidence. By integrating blockchain technology, cryptographic security, and privacy-preserving verification mechanisms, the system ensures robust counterfeit prevention, enhances supply chain transparency, and fosters consumer trust.

US20260260015.title: Privacy Preserving Cognitive Surveillance and Distributed Threat Intelligence System
US20260260015.abstract: [0000]    The Privacy-Preserving Cognitive Surveillance & Distributed Threat Intelligence System (PPCS-DTIS) is a next-generation security platform that enables high-accuracy threat detection without collecting personally identifiable information. It combines AI-driven behavioral analytics with homomorphic encryption, differential privacy, and zero-knowledge proofs to ensure privacy by design. Operating through federated learning, the system processes data locally and shares only anonymized insights. All actions are logged on a blockchain ledger for auditability and regulatory compliance. PPCS-DTIS achieves 99.8% detection accuracy and supports secure, identity-free collaboration across finance, enterprise, public safety, and critical infrastructure sectors—solving the long-standing conflict between surveillance and privacy.

WO2026176072.title: PARTAGE D'INFORMATIONS PRÉSERVANT LA CONFIDENTIALITÉ
WO2026176072.abstract: There is provided an incident reporting method comprising: receiving encrypted attributes of at least one incident; aggregating the encrypted attributes based on an incident taxonomy to provide an aggregated report; and providing access to the aggregated report based on an accessor satisfying an access policy, wherein the aggregated report provides a summary of the encrypted attributes.
claims:
1. Claims
1. An incident reporting method comprising:
receiving encrypted attributes of at least one incident;
aggregating the encrypted attributes based on an incident taxonomy to provide an aggregated report; and
providing access to the aggregated report based on an accessor satisfying an access policy, wherein the aggregated report provides a summary of the encrypted attributes.
2. The method of claim 1 , further comprising encrypting the attributes of the at least one incident using homomorphic encryption.
3. The method of claim 1 or claim 2, further comprising storing the encrypted attributes in a database according to the incident taxonomy.
4. The method of any previous claim, wherein the access policy is an attribute-based access policy.
5. The method of claim 4, wherein the attributes comprise any of time, location, and/or the ability to provide a recognized proof of identity.
6. The method of any previous claim, wherein the access policy is dynamically updated.
7. The method of any previous claim, wherein the taxonomy comprises a formalized definition of the incident.
8. The method of any previous claim, wherein the access policy is based on a key based encryption method.9. The method of any previous claim, wherein the step of providing access is performed within a trusted environment.
10. The method of any previous claim, wherein the incident is any of a security incident, cybersecurity incident, insurance and/or criminal incident.
11. A data storing method comprising;
receiving data related to an incident;
encrypting the data according to a first encryption method;
aggregating the data according to a data type to provide aggregated data; and encrypting the aggregated data according to a second encryption method.
12. The method of claim 11, wherein the data type is defined based on a predetermined incident taxonomy.
13. The method of claim 11 or claim 12, wherein the incident is any of a security incident, cybersecurity incident, insurance and/or criminal incident.
14. The method of any of claims 11 to 13, wherein the first encryption method is homomorphic encryption.
15. The method of any of claims 11 to 14, wherein the second encryption method is key based encryption.
16. The method of claim 15, wherein the key based encryption is based on attributes of an entity accessing the data.
17. A computer readable medium comprising instructions stored thereon such that when executed by a processor cause an electronic device comprising said processor to carry out the method according to the any previous claim.18. An electronic computing device comprising:
a memory; and
at least one processor;
configured to perform the method of any of claims 1 to 16.
WO2026176072.assignee: THE COURT OF EDINBURGH NAPIER UNIV CONSTITUTED BY THE NAPIER COLLEGE OF COMMERCE AND TECHNOLOGY NO 2 [GB]

US20260252734.title: REIDENTIFYING PATIENTS ACROSS SITES IN A PRIVACY PRESERVING MANNER
US20260252734.abstract: [0000]    A system for improving training data for training a machine learning model, comprises: a medical imaging unit to acquire a medical image of a current patient; a crossover detection unit to identify a patient crossover of the medical image and a previous dataset that is stored in a shared database and correlated to a previous patient; and a patient allocation unit to, in case the patient crossover is identified, allocate the medical image to one of a number of database cohorts according to the previous dataset for training the machine learning model.

CN122655331.title: Multi-energy flow failure modeling and supply and demand evaluation method and device for multi-extreme meteorological adaptive offshore electricity-hydrogen-alcohol system
CN122655331.abstract: The invention relates to an offshore electricity-hydrogen-alcohol system multi-energy flow failure modeling and supply and demand evaluation method and device adaptive to multiple extreme meteorology. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a system success flow model based on a GO method, and identifying a key equipment failure transfer chain; the GO graph is converted into a fault tree, and a minimum cut set method and a sequential Monte Carlo method are combined to quantify the system fault probability and the equipment contribution degree; constructing a wind-light hydrogen-alcohol storage power model, introducing an operation control strategy, and dynamically evaluating power and fuel supply and demand reliability indexes; a fault-supply and demand coupling mechanism is established, double correction is performed on wind and light output and equipment fault rate under extreme weather such as typhoon, cold tide and strong wind and rainstorm, and a three-dimensional comprehensive reliability index system is constructed. According to the method, complete causal chain modeling from equipment failure to insufficient supply is realized, the precision and comprehensiveness of comprehensive reliability evaluation of the system in the multi-extreme meteorological scene are improved, and the method can be used for system optimization design, operation and maintenance decision and risk prevention and control.

CN122501387.title: ADAPTIVE SPEED LIMITING BASED ON DRIVER BEHAVIOR DURING FAILURE AND/OR ENABLATION OF
CN122501387.abstract: Adaptive speed limiting based on driver behavior due to failure and/or activation of speed limiting driving modes is disclosed. An adaptive speed limiting system includes a vehicle control module that i) detects at least one of a fault in a host vehicle and activates operation in a driving mode during application of a maximum speed limit, and ii) limits at least one of an output torque of a propulsion system and a speed of the host vehicle based on a current maximum speed limit; and a speed limiting module that i) initiates an adaptive speed limit to apply a current maximum speed limit based on at least one of the detected fault and operation in the driving mode, ii) determines a speed limit window having a respective speed range, iii) determines an average speed of the host vehicle, and iv) initiates an adaptive speed limit to apply a current maximum speed limit based on the average speed and the speed limit window. The current maximum speed limit is periodically reduced until the current maximum speed limit is equal to the target maximum speed limit.

CN122451801.title: Transformer adaptive fault failure threshold differentiation online life prediction method considering degradation information loss
CN122451801.abstract: The invention discloses an online life prediction method for transformer adaptive fault failure threshold value differentiation considering degradation information loss, and belongs to the field of electrical equipment degradation evaluation and operation and maintenance. Comprising the steps of constructing a prediction framework including degradation data analysis, comprehensive degradation data composition, intelligent smooth fitting, degradation model construction and adaptive dynamic prediction. Multi-index weighted fusion is realized through fuzzy logic and a TIME-LLM hybrid model, comprehensive degradation data of different noise features are processed through intelligent adaptive smooth fitting, time-frequency domain nonlinear coupling features are captured based on a TFD-Hformer model, and differential fault threshold correction factors are generated by combining a variational Bayesian neural network with random variational inference. According to the method, reliable prediction can be realized in a historical data missing scene, individual differences of different transformers are adaptively adapted, and large-scale cluster efficient prediction is supported.

CN122297859.title: Adaptive fitting degree adjusting device for non-invasive ventilation mask for ICU (intensive care unit) respiratory failure patient
CN122297859.abstract: The invention discloses a non-invasive ventilation mask fitting degree self-adaptive adjusting device for ICU respiratory failure patients. The device comprises an adjusting mechanism, a control device and an induction type binding belt. A shell, a driving roller, a limiting shaft and a traction belt are arranged in the adjusting mechanism, and gears meshed with each other are arranged at the top end of the driving roller; an end cover, a control mainboard, a servo motor and a lithium battery are arranged in the control device; the inductive binding belt comprises an elastic belt, a breathing mask connector and a tension sensor. The tension sensor detects tension data in real time and transmits the tension data to the control mainboard, the control mainboard adjusts the servo motor to operate according to the data, the driving roller is driven to rotate through gear transmission, the traction belt is contracted or stretched out, the binding force of the elastic belt is adjusted, and the attaching state of the breathing mask and the face of a patient is dynamically matched. The device can dynamically adjust the fitting degree in real time, meets the use requirements of different patients, guarantees the non-invasive ventilation treatment effect, and is suitable for the non-invasive ventilation treatment scene of ICU respiratory failure patients.
CN122297859.assignee: JINHUA CITY WUCHENG DISTR PEOPLES HOSPITAL

CN122263409.title: Landslide prediction method based on landslide deformation failure type adaptive forecasting model
CN122263409.abstract: The invention relates to a landslide prediction method based on a landslide deformation failure type adaptive forecasting model, and belongs to the technical field of landslide prediction and forecasting. The method comprises the following specific steps: judging the deformation and damage type of the landslide through landslide monitoring curve characteristics and formation influence factors; selecting a proper model according to a sudden landslide adaptive Verhulst inverse function model and a gradual landslide adaptive GM (1, 1) power model; and finally, extracting displacement monitoring data in a landslide acceleration stage, substituting the displacement monitoring data into a corresponding model, determining parameters by adopting nonlinear fitting, and finally solving a landslide occurrence time forecast value. The accurate corresponding relation between the landslide deformation failure type and the forecasting model can be established, and the forecasting accuracy of the occurrence time of different types of landslides can be improved.

US20260152194.title: Multi-sensor self-adaptive failure compensation system and method
US20260152194.abstract: [0000]    A multi-sensor self-adaptive failure compensation system comprises multiple sensors and a processor. The processor is electrically connected to the multiple sensors. The processor generates a first fusion result according to the sensor information of the multiple sensors by a fusion module. The processor determines a characteristic relationship among the sensor information of the multiple sensors by a self-adaptive compensation module. The processor determines whether each sensor fails by a failure determination module, and generates a sensor compensation information corresponding to a failed sensor according to the sensor information of a valid sensor and the characteristic relationship by the self-adaptive compensation module. The processor generates a second fusion result according to the sensor information of the valid sensor and the sensor compensation information by the fusion module.

CN122133473.title: Motor adaptive failure prediction method based on digital twinborn fusion intelligent optimization
CN122133473.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical and electrical product intelligent reliability engineering, in particular to a motor adaptive failure prediction method based on digital twin fusion intelligent optimization. Through intelligent modeling driven by physical knowledge, a time-varying coupling coefficient is automatically learned by using a physical information neural network, and organic fusion of data driving and physical constraint is realized; dynamically reconstructing a failure path, identifying a dominant failure mode in real time through a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and dynamically adjusting the weight of a failure propagation chain; predicting, verifying and correcting a closed loop, realizing continuous self-evolution of the model by means of digital twinning and Bayesian inference, and continuously improving the prediction precision; a test scheme is intelligently designed, a multi-target genetic algorithm is used for optimizing an acceleration test condition, and the test efficiency and the failure mode coverage degree are improved; and carrying out probabilistic life prediction, outputting residual life distribution with a confidence interval, and carrying out quantitative prediction on uncertainty.

CN121860809.title: Power grid equipment time-phased power failure strategy self-adaptive generation system and method based on GRPO algorithm
CN121860809.abstract: The invention discloses a GRPO algorithm-based power grid equipment time-phased power failure strategy adaptive generation system, which is characterized in that an agent set, a state space, an action space, a reward function and a state transfer function are defined based on a Markov decision process, and a multi-agent model is established in combination with an objective function; respectively constructing constraint conditions and forming a constraint condition set through a security-guaranteed target, a supply-guaranteed target and a consumption-guaranteed target of power grid operation; based on the constraint condition set, using a group relative strategy optimization algorithm to carry out iterative optimization training on the multi-agent model, and generating a trained multi-agent model; and dynamically adjusting power failure time, power failure duration and maintenance resource configuration of power grid equipment based on actual power grid data through the trained multi-agent model, and generating an optimal time-phased power failure strategy. According to the invention, efficient and adaptive generation of the power grid power failure strategy is realized, the arrangement efficiency is improved, and the operation risk is reduced.
CN121860809.assignee: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

CN121744703.title: MDD-based adaptive competition failure modeling and analysis method for multi-stage task system
CN121744703.abstract: The invention discloses an MDD-based multi-stage task system adaptive competitive failure modeling and analysis method, which comprises the following steps: dividing a system component set, constructing a dynamic fault tree model containing communication mode adaptive switching logic, separating global propagation fault events of non-probabilistic function dependent components, and establishing a multi-stage task system adaptive competitive failure model. Constructing a trigger component fault event space and a fault isolation event set, distinguishing failure competition results, simplifying the model, establishing an MDD model, finally calculating the overall failure probability of the system, and establishing a fault isolation event through a dynamic topology modeling mechanism, a probabilistic competition failure model and an MDD unified modeling structure. According to the method, the dynamic topological coupling and probabilistic competition failure modeling problem and the computational efficiency bottleneck are solved, efficient and accurate analysis of the system reliability under the dynamic task profile is achieved, and the method is suitable for multi-scene task reliability design.

CN121507997.title: Multi-infeed high-voltage direct-current power transmission system based on energy storage and commutation failure self-adaptive suppression method
CN121507997.abstract: The invention discloses a multi-infeed high-voltage direct-current power transmission system based on energy storage and a commutation failure self-adaptive suppression method. The system comprises a first LCC-HVDC direct-current power transmission system, a second LCC-HVDC direct-current power transmission system, an energy storage system and a transient reactive power control system, the method comprises the following steps: establishing a main circuit model, and designing a control circuit of the MIDC according to the main circuit model and a transient reactive power control system; designing an inverter control circuit of the energy storage system based on the main circuit model and related parameters of the transient reactive power control system; on the basis of each model and each circuit design, comparing a voltage value with a turn-off angle value, triggering a corresponding reactive power reference value generator to output reactive power according to a comparison result and a voltage drop interval, and performing self-adaptive suppression when commutation of the multi-infeed high-voltage direct-current system fails through the reactive power. The reactive power of the system is subjected to adaptive coordination control during commutation failure, the advantage of rapidly providing the reactive power by energy storage is combined, and the commutation failure suppression efficiency is improved.

US20260039314.title: FAILURE MODE-ADAPTIVE LOW-DENSITY PARITY CHECK SOFT DECODING
US20260039314.abstract: [0000]    In some implementations, a device may receive a data signal from a memory device. The device may perform a low-density parity check (LDPC) hard bit decoding on the data signal to identify a plurality of hard bit read positions (HBRPs). The device may identify, with a machine learning model using the plurality of HBRPs, a failure mode of the memory device. The device may identify a set of parameters for an LDPC soft bit decoding based on the failure mode. The device may perform the LDPC soft bit decoding on the data signal using the set of parameters.

CN121457281.title: Multi-failure system reliability analysis method based on adaptive concentric subdomain decomposition strategy
CN121457281.abstract: The invention discloses a multi-failure system reliability analysis method based on a self-adaptive concentric sub-domain decomposition strategy, which comprises the following steps: firstly, based on the self-adaptive concentric sub-domain decomposition strategy, dividing a candidate sample space into a plurality of concentric sub-regions, after random variable sampling, screening key samples in each sub-region through a learning function, gradually updating and perfecting the agent model; and estimating the failure probability of the current sub-region by utilizing the updated agent model and important sampling, evaluating a convergence criterion, and finally establishing a collaborative multi-failure reliability analysis framework by integrating a plurality of agent models by adopting a linkage sampling technology, and calculating the failure probability of the multi-failure system. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the number of candidate samples in the proxy model updating process is reduced, the correlation between different failure modes is considered, the complexity and nonlinearity of the model are reduced, and the reliability evaluation of the multi-failure system can be efficiently carried out.

CN223856705.title: Patent Specification CN223856705U
CN223856705.abstract: Patent publication covering industrial methods and systems in CN223856705U.

CN121188871.title: Slope flexible surface layer failure self-adaptive diagnosis system
CN121188871.abstract: The invention discloses a slope flexible surface layer failure self-adaptive diagnosis system, and relates to the technical field of self-adaptive detection, and the system comprises a data collection unit which builds a three-dimensional constraint graph through setting an acceleration collection point at the anchor head of each anchor rod and setting a strain collection point at the geometric center of each grid unit; the constraint iteration sparse diagnosis unit is used for detecting an impact event in an acceleration sequence and a deformation event in a strain sequence on the established three-dimensional constraint graph for each time slice, judging a pull-out type, a stripping type, a tension fracture type or a slippage type failure mode, calculating a mismatch index and generating a failure mode sequence; and the alarm mapping unit is used for mapping according to the calculated mismatch index and the generated failure mode sequence to obtain an alarm level, and generating a protection action suggestion set including anchoring encryption, grid reinforcement, root dredging and drainage optimization. According to the invention, an efficient, reliable and landing technical support is provided for long-term stable and safe operation of the side slope.
CN121188871.assignee: SHANDONG HI SPEED INFRASTRUCTURE CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

CN121143418.title: Self-adaptive limping control method for quadruped robot under leg failure condition
CN121143418.abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive limping control method for a quadruped robot under a leg failure condition. The method comprises the following steps that S1, a system monitors the leg motion state of the robot in real time through sensor data; s2, judging whether the leg motion state is abnormal or not based on a preset key detection index, and if yes, executing the step S3; if not, directly executing the step S4 and the like. According to the method, self-adaptive limp control is achieved through algorithm level optimization in the whole process, a monitoring system can be constructed based on an existing sensor, model parameter adjustment and double-layer optimization control are achieved through software updating, and a hardware structure of the quadruped robot does not need to be transformed. The hardware cost of technology landing is reduced, the method can be adapted to different types of quadruped robots, the compatibility is high, and the method is convenient to popularize in existing quadruped robot application scenes such as emergency rescue and industrial inspection.
CN121143418.assignee: CHENGDU JINFA BIANYUAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

CN121146474.title: Dynamic self-adaptive recommendation strategy optimization method for business handling failure scene
CN121146474.abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic self-adaptive recommendation strategy optimization method for a business handling failure scene, and relates to the technical field of business handling recommendation and intelligent decision making, and the method comprises the steps: firstly collecting various types of data of a whole business handling process, and guaranteeing the integrity and real-time performance at a frequency of 100 milliseconds per time; a decision tree and Bayesian network fusion algorithm is used for attribution, and direct and indirect reasons are clarified; integrating data to construct a user portrait, and mining potential and subsequent demands; generating a recommendation scheme set based on attribution and portraits, and adjusting priorities and forms in combination with scene features; feedback data is introduced, a strategy weight is optimized by using a gradient descent algorithm, and the scheme is updated regularly; a multi-dimensional index weighted evaluation effect is set, and emergency optimization is carried out if the evaluation result does not reach the standard; and establishing a distributed strategy library, and reusing the optimal strategy of the similar scene by using a K-nearest neighbor algorithm. According to the method, failure reason accurate positioning and personalized recommendation are realized, the recommendation effect is continuously optimized along with data accumulation, and the method is adaptive to multiple service types and user groups.

US20250374908.title: IMPLEMENT FAILURE DETECTION AND ADAPTIVE REPLAN FOR AN AGRICULTURAL VEHICLE
US20250374908.abstract: [0000]    An agricultural work system for dispensing agricultural product to a field in a plurality of passes based on a field plan. The agricultural work system includes an implement including a plurality of row units, wherein each of the plurality of row units is configured to dispense the agricultural product to the field in rows across a width of the one of the plurality of passes. A product delivery system is configured to deliver the agricultural product to the plurality of row units. A sensor system directed to the plurality of row units to identify a lack of the agricultural product being dispensed from one or more of the plurality of row units and a controller is operatively connected to the sensor system. The controller is configured to facilitate providing a modified field plan for dispensing the product to the field, wherein the modified field plan identifies a coverage gap.

CN121009674.title: Failure probability evaluation and self-adaptive variable order method for thermal hydraulic program
CN121009674.abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of system simulation analysis, and discloses a thermal hydraulic program failure probability evaluation and self-adaptive variable order method, which comprises the following steps of: simulating N working conditions by using a split-phase model, reading a program output result, adding a state label for data after original simulation data is acquired, and calculating the failure probability of a thermal hydraulic program according to the state label; the method comprises the following steps: randomly disrupting each characteristic value, evaluating the performance reduction degree of a model, calculating importance, sorting and screening characteristic parameters as input parameters of the model, identifying minority class boundary samples, and interpolating between minority class neighbors to generate a synthetic sample to expand data; training a failure probability evaluation model by using a data set subjected to label addition and feature screening, outputting an abnormal probability, converting a format of the trained model, packaging and integrating, inputting parameters through an interface, obtaining a failure probability through model reasoning, and judging automatic switching of a high-order model and a low-order model according to continuous multi-step results. According to the method, the failure probability evaluation of each order model and the adaptive switching of the multi-order model can be realized.
CN121009674.assignee: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION TECHNOLOGY CORP LTD

TWI903753.title: Patent Specification TWI903753B
TWI903753.abstract: Patent publication covering industrial methods and systems in TWI903753B.

CN120822426.title: Secondary side passive residual heat removal system physical process failure analysis method based on adaptive neural network
CN120822426.abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear safety analysis, and particularly relates to a secondary side passive residual heat removal system physical process failure analysis method based on an adaptive neural network. Comprising the following steps: step 1, preparing an initial training set; 2, constructing a meta-model; 3, generating new input; 4, meta-model prediction and sample selection are carried out; 5, performing thermal hydraulic simulation and training set updating; step 6, iteratively updating the meta-model; step 7, carrying out convergence check; and step 8, failure analysis. Compared with the traditional Monte Carlo method, the method disclosed by the invention has the beneficial effects that when the method disclosed by the invention is applied to the secondary side passive residual heat removal system of the steam generator of the nuclear power plant, the required thermal hydraulic simulation times can be reduced to 102 times from 104 magnitude, and the calculation cost is reduced by more than 90%.
CN120822426.assignee: NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION RES SHANGHAI CO LTD

CN120686632.title: Actuator multi-mode failure-oriented distributed driving hovercar self-adaptive fault-tolerant control method
CN120686632.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of aerocar mode switching, and discloses a distributed driving aerocar self-adaptive fault-tolerant control method for actuator multimode failure, which comprises the following steps: constructing a unified six-degree-of-freedom dual-mode state space model; residual signals are generated based on extended Kalman filtering and a sliding-mode observer, and fault types and positions are positioned in real time through a lightweight classifier; the method comprises the following steps: extracting residual time-frequency features, identifying hard faults by using a lightweight convolutional neural network, quantifying soft fault degrees through an incremental support vector machine, fusing multi-source information based on a Bayesian network to output fault types, levels and confidence coefficients, and introducing an incremental learning mechanism to realize self-evolution of a diagnosis model; a virtual control instruction is generated by adopting hierarchical sliding mode control, thrust and torque distribution of remaining actuators is optimized based on a dynamic quadratic programming algorithm, control parameters are adjusted online in combination with a Lyapunov adaptive law, aerodynamic interference and model uncertainty are inhibited, attitude stability and trajectory tracking in air-ground mode switching are guaranteed, and the method has the advantages of being high in reliability and high in reliability. And the fault-tolerant performance and the operation safety of the hovercar in the air-ground mode switching process are obviously enhanced.

MY210115.title: A SYSTEM AND METHOD TO AVOID FAILURE IN COMPLETION OF A FLIGHT PLAN OF A DRONE BASED ON ADAPTIVE FLIGHT DURATION AND BATTERY CONSUMPTION ESTIMATION
MY210115.abstract: The present invention relates to a system and method of avoiding failure in completion of a flight plan of a drone (10) based on adaptive flight duration and battery consumption estimation. Flying drones have been one source of entertainment and artwork production. Many drone operators tirelessly train their drone handling skills and instinct to reduce errors and avoid any accidents or mishaps. However, over the years, a lot of drone crashes and/or gone missing due to miscalculation by its operator, either novice or experienced operator. The present invention provides a method to avoid failure in completion of a flight plan of a drone (10) based on adaptive flight duration and battery consumption estimation comprising a) acquiring flight parameters of previous flight session of said drone (10) from a cloud database; b) acquiring current flight plan distance and current battery level of said drone (10); c) estimating current flight plan duration and current flight battery consumption based on said flight parameters of previous flight session of said drone (10); d) determining whether said current battery level is sufficient to cover said current flight plan distance; e) sending alert if said current battery level is insufficient to cover said current flight plan distance and blocking said drone (10) from flying.

CN120409298.title: Multi-failure domain structure reliability optimization method and system based on adaptive clustering
CN120409298.abstract: The invention discloses a multi-failure domain structure reliability optimization method and system based on adaptive clustering, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the first-stage training of a Kriging agent model through an active learning method based on engineering structure data, and constructing a first-stage Kriging agent model; performing failure domain identification on the first-stage Kriging agent model based on an adaptive clustering algorithm, and constructing an important sampling density; based on the important sampling density, performing second-stage training on the first-stage Kriging agent model through an active learning method, and outputting a second-stage Kriging agent model; and performing failure probability calculation on the engineering structure based on the second-stage Kriging agent model to obtain a reliability calculation result of the engineering structure. According to the method, the potential sub-failure domain of the engineering structure can be accurately identified, so that the calculation efficiency of the failure probability of the engineering structure is improved. The multi-failure domain structure reliability optimization method and system based on adaptive clustering can be widely applied to the technical field of structure reliability optimization.

US20250172954.title: ADAPTIVE RESPONSE FOR MARSHALING FAILURE MODES
US20250172954.abstract: [0000]    A method of broadcasting a signal to marshal a plurality of autonomously operated vehicles including the signal broadcasted to the plurality of autonomously operated vehicles, the establishment of a secure data connection with each of the plurality of autonomously operated vehicles based on the signal, the determination of a disruption in the secure data connection to one or more vehicles of the plurality of autonomously operated vehicles, and the causation of the one or more vehicles of the plurality of autonomously operated vehicles to initiate an action based on the disruption in the secure data connection.

CN119780575.title: High-voltage direct current commutation failure detection method and system adaptive to multiple types
CN119780575.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power, and discloses a high-voltage direct current commutation failure detection method and system adaptive to multiple types, and the method comprises the steps: firstly analyzing a valve side current waveform of a target system through a primary commutation failure criterion obtained through pre-analysis, and accurately obtaining a primary commutation result; the method comprises the following steps: firstly, determining a primary commutation failure time, then determining a two-time commutation failure interval according to the commutation failure time of the primary commutation failure, and finally obtaining two-time commutation results in combination with two-time commutation failure criteria obtained through pre-analysis, can accurately identify different types of commutation results in the high-voltage direct-current power transmission system, accurately judges whether different commutation failure conditions occur or not, and improves the detection accuracy of the high-voltage direct-current power transmission system. And the operation stability of the high-voltage direct-current power transmission system is improved.
CN119780575.assignee: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

US20250097142.title: Traffic protection with predetermined reroute and adaptive failure detection for use of applications hosted on virtual private clouds
US20250097142.abstract: [0000]    Techniques are described for quickly rerouting traffic to an application hosted on a first Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) location. In the event of an error in routing traffic to the first VPC portion traffic can be rerouted to a second VPC portion. The first and second VPC portions can be different portions of the same VPC or could be different VPSs. The techniques include steps for calculating a predetermined route to the second private virtual cloud location. The techniques further include steps for monitoring data for detecting an error in the first cloud location. The steps further include detecting a potential error based on the monitored data, and also verifying that the potential error is in fact a valid error. In response to verifying that the error is a valid error, further steps include performing a fast reroute of traffic to the second cloud locations along the predetermined route.

CN119125949.title: Ratio-adaptive power failure phase judgment method
CN119125949.abstract: The invention discloses a ratio self-adaptive power fault phase judgment method, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring voltage and current sampling values of a cycle before and after a fault point for a to-be-judged line and a sudden change point; according to the voltage and current sampling values, calculating a fundamental wave effective value ratio of a next cycle wave to a front cycle wave of the three-phase voltage fault abrupt change point; if the fundamental wave effective value ratio of the next cycle wave to the previous cycle wave of the i-phase fault mutation point is greater than 1, replacing the next sampling value with the normal value of the sampling value before the fault, and setting the fundamental wave effective value ratio of the i-phase as 1; otherwise, keeping unchanged; fault phase judgment is carried out according to the comprehensive ratio, and if the ratio of the fundamental wave effective values of the next cycle wave and the front cycle wave of the i-phase fault mutation point is lower than the comprehensive ratio, the i phase is the fault phase. According to the scheme, defects caused by too large or too small thresholds and defects caused by zero sequence abnormity are effectively avoided.
CN119125949.assignee: LINXIA POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

CN118964090.title: Adaptive failure recovery and empirical learning type RPA execution Bot system
CN118964090.abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of execution of Bots, and particularly discloses an adaptive failure recovery and experience learning type RPA execution Bot system, which comprises an initial module, a control center sends an execution instruction to an execution end, the execution end transmits the execution instruction to a master Bot and calls the master Bot to execute an RPA task in the execution instruction, and a slave Bot monitors the execution state of the master Bot; and the decision module judges that the execution state is execution failure when the slave Bot monitors failure information, the slave Bot feeds back the failure information to the control center, and the control center carries out intelligent decision making according to a pre-trained AI multi-mode large model to give a processing strategy. Through the design of the master Bot and the slave Bot, even if the master Bot breaks down or is abnormal, the slave Bot can take over the task immediately, and continuity and stability of the business process are ensured.
CN118964090.assignee: HUANYU ZHIXIANG SUZHOU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD
